tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 34 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/

sdeX/sna rdoXrdo ri rje ༵rdo shes / ༷sdi/sgo ji rtsa tsu /ste ji rtsa tsu ste sbyi / da / ༷ spo~XrkaXspo—nyurtehūṃ|skye sgo rke ༵smi~XphyuXlha sgyi sdi~Xsnye snye / snye / snye / snye / snye / snye snye / / / / lto / lto she / snye ji khrimagu tshe dhi : rwa ji jig khri ma tshe ji rmechi dhi di blo dhi / sku ca rnga sna cho dhi rwa rwa tshe rwa khri skya dhiXtshwa / ji~~Xsnye / snye / snye / rdo / snye / / / / rdo / snye / snye / snye / snye / / snye / / snye / / ༷snye / sde / ༷rdortesh+lausgroXspro pho ji snyeng sgo ji sgro 4 ṭi 〉shaṃrdo sum̐ṭ+wārkarkopy-ihūṃshe sgyu tāchi / keng zhe ri ko rme / ri lte~X༄spo— byerte~X 3rme / ri snyoXlha / sna / sna / lnga / / rdo / rdo / rdo rdo rdo sde tho shwashālha rdordohūṃ ltirdo rtul su che mi kyi ge / ༵spyo~XsgriXrdo trer+sha4rni༄༷ hūṃ1snyosnyesnyedū smos waṃ

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/ de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/ dpe thum gsol/ dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/ rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/ srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉 zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang / da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/ de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang / 'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/ nang don rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ lo rgyus/ rtsis rig sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dug pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yin/ —1—

'ad 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las kya go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brdzid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug nye gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'chug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu sbungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / to wid lta bu yo rob dang / a— rdo rdogs su grags wo gyi slob grwa wo mo

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod chen po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhung / /ga ubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ khangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang chabs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khru / gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/ —3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhyen mkhyen/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu'i las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs rta ge 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal rnga5/da/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1 —

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras skrungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon to bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3—

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos chan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rja 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di/ 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5—

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song bi krin sogs kyi rgya'i spyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zho pa / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen hūṃ dhi rdo sgro 1 6 3 'byu / shadang gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang sbyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gzhan yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi spyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

stor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' ri bur// dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug 'e ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhu8 / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhud drug ྅ hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gci ga pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591)la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhus lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bshes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bzhas bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta ga rta nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni khyu ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya —chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa sna/mas kyang gzhan la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sbungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khore bde chen/ rtse chen cho se sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635) la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—10—

slob dpon wo po spyod 'cha dbang po'i rnam thar ngo mtshar snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 1slob dpon spyod pa pa'i lo rgyus kha skong dang ga bor lo sdom pa'i srol 'byed byung tshul bzhugs/ 69grub chen budha gusta'i rnam thar/ 94rgyal bu dga' byed sa skyong gi rtogs brjod bzhugs/ 127jo nang gi gnas bstso/da bzhugs/ 136sgrub gnas skyid phug bde ldan gyi gnas bshad bzhugs/ 154'khyog po ri khrod kyi gnas bshad bzhugs/ 156dga' ldan phun sna yinas gling gi gnas bsha/da bzhugs/ 160dpal ldan shangs pa'i chos skor gyi 'byung khungs yid kyi mun sel bzhugs/ 194dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa'i mdo don cung zad nga khrind pa bzhugs/ 286

ngo mtshar snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba bsdo kyigs/na mo badz+ra satwa ya/ nyi gzhon bye ba phrag brgyas mi dpogs pa'i/ /ye shes gzi 'od rgyas pas 'gro mun sel/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rba rlabs rab g.yos pas/ /bdud dang mu stegs zil gnon gang de rgyal/ /gang las ngo mtshar gtam gyi phul/ /rnam pa sna tshogs grags de las/ yid ches khungs dang ldan pa dag /mdo tsam mchog tu gsal bar sdeb/ /'dir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa'i rjes su mi lo chen po stong dang lnga brgyar nye ba na/ grub pa'i dbang phyug slob dpon nag po spyod pa zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ngo / /de yang slob dpon klu sgrub kyis dpal ldan 'bras sbungs nas spyan drangs pa'i dpal mgon po'i rgyud brgyad yod pa las/ gzhan bdun gyi snying po nag po chen po mngon par 'byung ba zhes pa/ mgon po phyag gnyis pa dang / bzhi pa dang / drug pa dang / brgyad pa dang / bcu gnyis pa dang / bcu drug pa'i dkyil 'khor ston pa/ kha ba can gyi phyogs 'dir rwa lo tsā ba chos rab kyis bsgyur nges pa rgya dpe can de las de ltar yul u ru bi shar yang mtshungs par nges pa'o/ /der skyes bu brtson 'grus chen po dang ldan zhing sbyor ba la brtson pa rā ma ṇa'i bka'i 'jug pa dang mtshu/rdo rdo/ sde tshan dang po'i dang po dbyangs

yig dang pos brgyan pa/ bdun pa'i bzhi pa cung zad na la zhon pa'i ming can rnal 'byor dbang po skyes bu'i mchog gcig po 'dis ral gri la sogs pa'i dngos grub chen po brgyad thob par 'gyur ro/ /dzam bu'i gling du ma byung zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i slob ma rnal 'byor pa drug gis lus kyi dngos po spangs pa'i phyag rgya chen po thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phyi ma 'gyur rnying las/ kha ṭāX ga dang rus rgyan cang te chang snod thogs pa nag po'i ming can 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes lung bstan pa ste/lung dang po'i don ni der zhes pas gang du 'khrungs pa'i yul dang / brtson 'grus dang ldan zhing sbyor ba la brtson pa ni/ rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa rgya cher spyod pa'i don dang / rā ma ṇa'i bka'i 'jug pa dang mthun pa ni lang ka'i gling la sogs par gdug pa can rnams tshar gcod pa'i don dang / sde tshan dang po'i dang po ka yig /bdun pa'i bzhi pa ha yig /cung zad na la zhon pa ni hā yig de nyid na yig dang brtsegs pa ste/ de ltar na ka sna zhes pa mtshan bstan pa yin no/ /nag po'i skad dod mang du yod kyang / ka sna zhes pa slob dpon 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshan te/ ka sna tsaru 'am/ 'phral skad du/ kasni pa zhes grags so/ /ral gri la sogs pa'i dngos grub brgyad ces pas/ thun mong gi grub pa brgyad la mnga' brnyes pa ste gzhan la sbyin nus pa'o/ /ma byung zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhes pa ni/ slob dpon 'di lta bu gzhan dus gsum khegs par bsngags pa ste/ de yang slob dpon 'dis 'gro ba'i don spyad pa na/ gsung gdams ngag dngos kyi khyab pa dang / ma yin kyang de'i mig rkyen la brten pa'i —2—

grong khyer chen po bcu gsum tsam gyi skyes pa bud med khye'u bu mo tshun chod 'jig rten gyi bya ba spangs te rnal 'byor pho mo 'ba' zhig tu gyur pas grong khyer de dag re zhig stongs so/ /de dag kun kyang rab kyis dngos grub mchog dang / 'bring gis thun mong gi dngos grub dang / tha ma rnams kyis kyang phra mo'i las ma grub pa med skad de/ thams cad kyang ting nge 'dzin thob pa sha stag go /de'i slob ma drug ces bya ba ni/ skyes pa'i rten can slob dpon nyid kyi drung du bsnyen cing bzhugs pa'i 'khor rnams kyi nang nas slob dpon nyid sku bzhugs pa'i dus su phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob pa ni drug ste/ e ya la pa dang / ma hi la pa dang / bha dra pa dang / dha ma pa dang / dhu ma pa dang / tshim bu pa rnams so/ /lus kyi dngos po spangs ba zhes bya ba ni 'chi srid kyis lus bor ba'i don ma yin te/ rnam par smin pa'i lus 'di gnas gyur nas/ 'ja' lus rdo rje'i skur song ba'o/ /lung phyi ma'i don ni/ kha ṭāX zhes phyag mtshan dang rgyan bstan pa ni/ slob dpon 'dis spros bcas kyi spyod pa gtso bor mdzad pas/ phal cher lha'i chas su zhugs par ston/ nag po zhes pa'i mtshan yang bstan to/ /spos ā tsar+ya zhes pa yang slob dpon 'di'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin mod kyi/ kriṣ+ṭha pa'i mtshan can gzhan yang shin tu mang ngo / /slob dpon 'di la karmā tsar+ya ste slob dpon nag po dang / kriṣ+ṭha tsar+ya pa yang slob dpon nag lnga'o/ /ka sna kriṣ+ṭha dang thung ja'i mthar tsar+ya pa sbyar na/ ka sna tsar+ya pa spos tsar+ya pa ste nag po spyod pa ba zhes dang / yang tsa rgyu tsar+ya pa ste slob dpon spyod pa ba dang / de bzhin du tsar+ya badz+ra te spyod pa'i rdo rje dang / ā tsar+ya tsar+ya dha ri pa ste slob dpon —3—

spyod 'chang dbang po la sogs par grags so/ /de yang 'phags yul shar phyogs go ra'i rgyal khams kyi nang tshan o ru bi sha zhes bya ba/ bha spyo la dang cung zad nye ba'i phyogs shig yin/ yul der mi rigs chen po bzhi las bram ze'i rigs su sku 'khrungs so/ /bod kyi lo rgyus rnying pa 'ga' na/ rje rigs su 'chad pa yod kyang / slob dpon nyid kyi do ha las/ reg gin reg gin 'gro ste bram ze'i bu/ zhes gsungs pa/ de la mtshon don rdzogs rim la sbyar ba'i bshad pa yod kyang / mtshon byed brda de yang kun rdzob dngos po dang 'grig dgos pas/slo ba dpon bram ze'i rigs yin par lung des grub/ rgya gar na sngon nas da lta'i bar du yang slob dpon 'di phyi nang thams cad la grags che zhing / thams cad mgrin gcig par bram ze'i rigs yin par kun la grags so/ /yang slob dpon 'di bod du ma byung rgya gar du byung ba yin la/ 'di'i rigs la cha rgyus yod du rung ba'i yul rgya gar du kun la mthun par grags pa de bkag nas/ cha rgyus med pa'i rgyal khams bod lta bur de dang 'gal bar smra ba dag la 'di ni bden te/ smra ba po de skyes bu bzang po yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes smra ba ni legs pa ma yin te/ g.yem ma mu cor gyi rgyal lo zhes pa'i don dang mtshungs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas chung 'a dus nas blo rno ṣ+ka sgra dang / sman dpyad dang / bzo'i gnas thams cad la mkhas par byas/ der sngon gyi las 'phro sad pas/ ye shes kyi rnal 'byor ma du mas zhal mngon sum du bstan/ de nas rim gyis yul dbus ma ga dha'i cha shas/ dpal na len+d+ra zhes bya ba/ paṇ+ḍi ta lnga brgya gnas shing chos grwa shin tu dar bas der byon te dge slong mdzad cing lo mang du —4—

bzhugs nas sde snod gsum dang / rgyud sde bzhi'i thos bsam gyis rgyud byang bar mdzad cing / sngags dang bsam gtan yang ci rigs pa grub par gyur to/ /der dben pa bstan te/ bsgom zhing bzhugs pa'i skabs shig /grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma chen mo lcam la l+lī ka ras zhal bstan rgyud byin gyis brlabs ting nge 'dzin khyad par can brnyes so/ /der rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma 'ga' zhig gis nam mkha' nas gsung gi snang ba phyung ste/ byang phyogs kyi grong khyer dza lan dha ra na/bla ma dza lan+ta ri pa zhes pa yod kyi/ khyod kyis de bsten na 'dod pa'i dngos grub tu 'gyur ro/ /zhes grags pas bdag nyid gcig pu yul dza lan dha rar bzhud do/ /der grub thob dza lan dha ri pa dang mjal/ slob dpon de ni rang byung gdod nas grub pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug ches che ba yin cing / sku lus kyi bkod pa ya nga cig car mang du ston pas yul tha dad sna tshogs na sku du mas dus gcig tu bzhugs shing / slob ma dngos grub thob pa'ang mang mod kyi/ yul der dus skabs gdul bya 'dul ba'i dbang gis/ dmangs rigs kyi rnal 'byor pa rtag tu slong mo la spyod pa phal pa'i tshul 'dzin pa cig yod skad/ der mkhas pa'i nga rgyal spangs nas zhabs la gus pas bshud de rjes su gzung bar gsol ba btab pas/ skal ba dang ldan par mkhyen nas/ yang dag par dbang bskur zhing gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa mtha' dag bstsal to/ /de nas dza lan dha ra'i yul de'i phyogs gcig tu rdo rje theg pa'i don bsgom zhing bzhugs pa'i tshe/lan cig 'dod na rtsig pa la yang thogs med du 'byon nus pa dang / brag ri la yang zhabs bying zhing bzhed na thal byung du bzhud nus pa dang / nam ting nge —5—

'dzin bsgoms pa'i tshe bdag nyid dpal he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor du gsal bar gzigs shing / lha de rnams kyis dri lan mdzad pa'i tshul gyis slob dpon nyid kyi the tshom gcod pa dang / bstod pa dang rdo rje glu nam blangs pa na/ sa g.yo ba'am/ me tog gi char 'bab pa'am/ sgra 'byin pa'am/ 'od snang bar byed pa 'byung ngo / /der spyod pa bya ba'i dus yin nam dgongs pa na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma 'ga' zhig mngon sum du byon te 0zlog par mdzad do/ /yang bsgom zhing bzhugs pa na/ phyugs 'tsho ba'i byis pa 'ga' zhig rtse mo rtse zhing song ba'i shul du shing a sho ka la ral gri'i gzugs byas pa 'ga' zhig dag bor te 'dug pa la/ gcig phyag tu bsnams te byon/ shing drung zhig tu de mdun du bzhag ste ting nge 'dzin bsgom zhing bzhugs pa na/ ral gri de las me rang 'bar bar gyur te/de phyag tu thogs pa na nam mkha' la 'phags shing mngon shes dang ldan par gyur to/ /der dgongs pa bla ma'am lhag pa'i lhas bkas ma gnang bar dngos grub kyi rol pa mi bya'o dgongs te/ re zhig mi snang bar sbas so/ /yang lan cig lam du bzhud pa na brag ri'i khongs na grub pa'i dngul chu'i gter yod pa gzigs shing / de'i sgo yang rang bye ba dang / yang sa gzhi la rin po che'i gter yod pa gzigs shing sgo yang bye ba dang / yang sgrub pa po gcig gis nags kyi mthongs shig tu mi gzhan med do snyam dben pa'i 'du shes kyis ril bu lcags gsum gyis dkris pa zhig bcos te/ ljon shing cig gi rtsa bar sbas so/ /de nags gseb na gnas pa'i g.yo can zhig rtswa'i gseb na yib nas bsdad pas mthong / sgrub pa po de grong khyer du song ba na/ g.yo can des ril bu de brkus te —6—

song ba na/ gzhan la btsongs kyang ma brin/ rang la mkho med nas/ 'di su dang phrad pa la sbyin no snyam tsa na/ slob dpon 'di lam gyi gzhi mdo na bsgom zhing bzhugs pa dang phrad de/ sku mdun du bor te song ngo / /de la spyan gyis gzigs shing thugs brtad pa na/ chu skrudi gcig tsam na sgra dang 'od zer byung ngo / /de zhal du bcug pas lha dang gnod sbyin gyi gnas rnams kyang gzigs shing / bzhed na skad cig la der 'byon pa'i nus pa thob/'on kyang snga ma bzhin du dgongs nas/ re zhig mi snang bar sbas so/ /yang lan cig lam du bzhud pa na sa 'og gi 'jig rten du 'gro ba'i dpal gyi sgor rang bye bar gzigs nas/ lam de la zhugs nas yud tsam zhig gis sa 'og gi 'jig rten rnams gzigs shing nyams 'og tu chud par byas/ slar rang nyid kyi sgrub gnas su 'khor ro/ /de dag la sogs pa thun mong gi dngos grub mang po ched du ma sgrubs kyang rang gi ngang gis grub par gyur to/ /der dgongs pa da ni nges par spyod pa bya ba'i dus la bab po snyam nas/ bla ma dza lan dha ri pa la snang ba zhus pas/ kye ma mig 'phrul mkhan khyod de tsam ngo mtshar ci che/ da lta khyod kyis spyod pa bya bar mi nus kyi/ de bas 'di nas byang phyogs na dpag tshad lnga brgya tsam na/ yul pre ta pu ri yod/ de na mkha' 'gro ma skal ba bzang mo zhes bya ba yod/ de gsang rgyud mtha' dag 'dzin pa yin pas/ de'i lag nas gsang ba kun bsdus pa zhes kyang bya/ kha sbyor thig le zhes bya ba'i rgyud yod pas/ de spyan drongs la shog sems can mang po la phan par 'gyur/ de yang khyod kyis gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis mi ster gyi/ ngas len du btang ba yin byas na ster —7—

bar 'gyur ro gsung / de nas de'i nang par nag po spyod pa byang phyogs su bzhud pas/ nyi ma de nyid kyi thun tha ma la bab pa tsam na/ bye ma'i thang skya bo zhig gi dbus gad pa'i khugs shig na/ khyim ngan pa re chus 'dra ba zhig 'dug /de dang nye bar phyin pa na/ bud med ngan ma zhig chu len du byung ba dang 'phrad nas/ de nub gnas g.yar dgos byas pas/ de lan cig nang du song nas slar yang 'bod du byung / de nas slob dpon khyim gyi nang du byon tsa na/ de na bud med gzhan zhig 'dug pa dang / des rnal 'byor pa gang du 'gro zer/ slob dpon gyis sngar gyi gtam bshad pas/ de na re/ yul pre ta pu ri yang 'di ka yin/mkha' 'gro ma skal ba bzang mo yang nga yin zer/ slob dpon gyi dgongs pa la/de rang min las che dgongs te/ de'i nang par byang phyogs su gshegs pas/ nyi ma nub la khad tsa na sngar gyis de kar 'khor/ de'i yang nang par bzhud pas kyang sngar bzhin da nang 'ongs pa'i gnas de nyid du 'khor/ de nas slob dpon gyis mkha' 'gro ma de la phyag 'tshal te/ khyed kyi phyag na dpal sa spru ṭa kha sbyor thig le'i rgyud yod pa 'dug pa/ slob dpon dza lan+ta ri pas rgyud de len par bdag btang ba yin pas/ rgyud de'i gleg bam yang bstsal bar zhu/ gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa yang gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ gnas khang de yang khang bzang rgyan gyis brgyan par gyur/ bud med de yang gzi brdzid 'od du 'bar ba rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gser gyi khri la 'dug pa cig tu gyur nas/ sa sbu ṭa'i rgyud kyi glegs bam ni gto/ dza rdo ri pa ni 'di mi 'dod de 'ong / 'on kyang skal ba dang ldan pa 'ga'i don gyis shig ces gnang ba bstsal lo/ /'dir —8—

bod rnying pa rnams las mkha' 'gro ma skal ba bzang mo yin ces rwa ba dang lo chung ba'i phyogs rnams zer ba legs par mngon te rgya gzhung 'ga' rer bla ma brgyud pa la de ltar bgrangs pas so/ /de rdo rje phag mo dang / bdag med ma'i sprul par 'dod pa sna tshogs yod de don la mi 'gal lo/ /mar do lugs kyi lo rgyus na/ mkha' 'gro ma 'gro ba bzang mo yin zer ba yod de/ 'gro bzang mo zhes pa de ni mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin par grags so/ /de la'ang 'gal ba med do/ /sngon bod du byung pa'i 'di skabs kyi lo rgyus rnams na/ dbang bskur zhing gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa mtha' dag bstsal ces pa ni/ so so'i skye bo'i slob dpon gyis slob ma phal pa cig la byed pa bzhin du/ rdul tshon bzhengs/ dbang rdzas bsags/ chog 'don btang /nyin mo bsgrubs mtshan mo bskur/ deb cha sgrog pa dang / gzhung gi 'bru bshad 'dzug 'khrid byed pa dang / 'dzin chos btang ba ma yin gyi/ slob dpon nag po skal ldan gyi gang zag de la/ sprul pa'i sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma des/dgongs pa brtad de thugs rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa tsam gyis/ skad cig de la ye shes khyad par can brnyes/ rgyud don ma lus pa thugs su chud/ bka'i snang ba bstsal pa tsam gyis sems can gyi don rgya cher spyod pa'i nus pa thob pa de ka dbang bskur ba dang / gdams ngag rjes gdams bla na med pa yin no/ /'dis mtshon pa'i sngon gyi grub thob chen po rnams kyi rnam thar na/ gcig gis gcig la gdams tshul yod pa rnams/ phal cher de bzhin yin la/ rang cag bod 'di na go ba 'di tsam la yang mtha' gnyis gang rung gcig tu lhung bar snang ste/ blun —9—

po rnams dang / blun po'i rjes 'brang mkhas 'dod yod pa phal cher zhig ni/grub thob rnams la de ltar yin pa'i go ba rab rib cig shar ba rgyu mtshan du byas nas/ da lta'i bla ma dang / slob ma phal ba lam sna tsam yang ma zin pa sgab sgob rnams la yang grub thob gyi rigs 'gre 'gran 'dod byas te/ dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag thams cad rtsa bas bcad/ po ti mgo la 'jog pa dang /dgongs pa brtad pas chog pa sogs mi shes pa dang / ma lcogs pa la bzang bzang mo dang dpa' dpa' mo byed do/ /de rigs la bla mas ma bshad/ slob mas ma go dpon slob gnyis kar gyis ci yang mi shes pa la/ shes pa dag byed pa las mi yong bar 'dug pa 'di chad pa'i mtha' yin/ yang sngags gzhung dang /cho ga la rtsis su byed pa rnams kyang / da lta las dang po pa gang byed pa'i rgyas bkab ste/ 'phags pa dang / grub thob dang / sgrub pa po mchog rnams la'ang byed pa ni/ sgrigs bkod dam dam mo dang mkhas 'dod byas pas ti thug tu song ste/ 'di ka la ltos pa'i rtag pa'i mtha' yin no/ /des na las dang po pa la brgyud pa khungs la thug pa'i chos bka' ma chad pa cig dgos/ cho ga lag len byang la ma nor ba zhig dgos/ bsnyen sgrub la sogs pa tshad du phyin pa cig dgos/ rang rang gi gzhung bshad the tshom chod nges/ blo rtse brtad 'tsham yong nges shig dgos man ngag rnams lag len du btab na thebs res pa cig dgos so/ /grub pa thob pa rnams kyi spyod yul ni g.yin yin pas/ de 'dri'i nges khrigs med kyang / de la log lta dang the tshom mi bya/ gus pas gsol ba thob cig—10—

da ni dkyus la 'jug par bya ste/ de nas slob dpon gyis tshur lam yang yud tsam zhig gis bgrod nas/ rgyud kyi glegs bam mkha' 'gro'i phyag nas spyan drangs pa de slob dpon la phul bas/ khyod kyis mkha' 'gro ma de la rtog dpyod med par gsol ba btab na/ de nyid du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba yin pas de'i don du btang ba yin kyang / rnam par rtog pas bsgribs kyi/ da nga la glegs bam gyi dgos pa med pas khyod nyid khyer zhig ces bor nas/ gzhan la'ang ston cig /'di sngon nyid ngas shes gsung / rgyud de'i tshig don mtha' dag skad cig de ma la bla mas gsungs so/ /de nas kyang bsgom zhing bzhugs pa na/ mi ring pa'i skabs shig 'byung po gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang / gser gyi phug na gnas pa'i gnod spyin mo la sogs pa/ gnod spyin mo mang po dag 'ongs nas/ rang rang gi sngags dang / rgyud kyi sbyor ba dang dngos grub dag 'bul bar byed do/ /'on kyang rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyad nas/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par bzhed nga/ yin pas/ re zhig de dag bor te bzhugs so/ /de rjes yang lan cig bla ma dza lan+ta ri pa'i gsung las/ khyod dpal o rgyan gyi gnas su song la/ phyag rgya drug po 'di rnams la rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i byin rlabs zhus la myur du shog cig /de yang o rgyan gyi gnas de na/rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma mang po yod pa rnams kyi nang na/ gzhan rnams dang rnam pa mi 'dra ba zhig yod pa de la zhus gsung / spi rus kyi rgyan drug phra mo ngan don zhig slob dpon la gtad do/ /yul dza lan+ta ra nas o rgyan gyi bar la dpag tshad brgya dang nyi shu yod skad/ de yang nyin zhag gcig gam gnyis kyis bcad —11—

nas/ o rgyan gyi gnas der byon zhing / dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa dang mjal/ de rnams kyi cho 'phrul ya mtshan can mang po yang gzigs/lan cig mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i bkod pa rgya chen po'i grwar zhugs te/ lhan cig tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i dga' ston nyams su myong bar mdzad pa na/ kun gyi gral bsham na gnas pa'i mkha' 'gro ma zhig bzhin mi sdug pa/ mig shel mig tu 'dug pa/ so mi mnyam pa/ lus kha dog ngan zhing rtsub pa/ gos hrul ba zhig 'dug go /slob dpon gyis lung bstan pa'i mkha' 'gro ni de yin par mkhyen nas/ bdag slob dpon dza lan+ta ri pas btang ba yin/ rus rgyan 'di byin gyis rlob par zhu zhus pas/ des kyang sngags btab ste re re bzhin mdud rgya re byas te/ slob dpon nag po pa la tshur gtad do/ /de nas slob dpon tshur byon te/ lam dben pa zhig tu thugs tseg tseg byed de/mkha' 'gro ma'i mdud rgya bkrol te/ rus rgyan de sku la gsol bas/ srid pa gsum mthong ba'i mngon shes skyes/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla gsum la thogs med du 'gro ba'i nus pa thob bo/ /yang rgyan rnams bkrol te snod du bsnams nas/'di 'dra gda' zhes slob dpon la phul bas/ mkha' 'gro'i rgya de bshig tu mi rung pa la/ zhes cung zad ma mnyes pa'i tshul mdzad skad de/ don la mkha' 'gro'i rgya ma bshig par bla ma la phul na/ rus rgyan de bla mas de ma thag gnang bar 'gyur zhing / de sku la gsol ba tsam gyis mchog brnyes par 'gyur rgyu yin par snang ngo / /de nas gnas der ci rigs par bzhugs te/ sngar mkha' 'gro ma skal ba bzang mo dang / bla ma dza lan+ta ri pas bka'i gnang pa yod pa la brten —12—

nas/ skal ldan gyi slob ma ci rigs ci rigs tsam gyis 'dus pa la/ rdo rje theg pa'i chos dag bstan to/ /slob ma de rnams kyis kyang ting nge 'dzin re la bstan pa thob cing / nus pa sna re yang byung ngo / /de nas slob dpon nyid kyis/ ri lu mig sman ral gri dang / /rkang mgyogs bcud len gnod sbyin mo/ /ro langs dang ni sa 'og ste/ /grub pa rnam pa brgyad yin no/ /zhes pa ltar gyi rdzas kyi dngos grub de dag /sgrub pa'i cho ga cung zad tsam res tshegs med par grub pa mang du mdzad nas/ slob ma de dag rnams la'ang skal ba dang 'tshams par dngos grub re re byin/ de rnams kyis kyang cho ga lhag ma sgrubs pas dngos grub phra mo sna re thob ste/ de'i tshe slob ma bdun cu rtsa gnyis yod skad la/ sum cu so bdun rnal 'byor ma yin/ rnal 'byor pa sum cu so lnga yod skad/ de nas skabs shig na slob dpon rang nyid kyis drod tshad gzigs te/ brag de'u cig la lta stangs byas pas zhig pa dang / gso ba'i lta stangs mdzad pas 'byor ro/ /yang shing n+ya gro dha'i sdong po la lta stangs mdzad pas bskams shing tshig /yang gso pa'i lta stangs mdzad pas sngar bzhin sos so/ /de nas gzhan thams cad kyang ci 'dod 'ong bar 'dug nas/ da ni nges par rig pa rtul zhugs kyi spyod pa bya'o dgongs nas/ bla ma dza lan+ta ri pa'i drung du da ni bdag gis spyod pa la 'jug par nus pas/ bla mas cis kyang bkas gnang bar zhu/ bdag gi 'khore 'di kun gyis kyang nus pa sna re thob lags pa/ 'di dag kyang khrid du rung ba'i gnang ba stsole zhes zhus pas/ bla ma na re/ da dung khyod la nus pa med pa 'dra/yod na ston cig gsung / stag la rengs pa'i lta stangs mdzad pas de ma thag —13—

shing bzhin du rengs/ ljon shing 'bras bus rgyan pa la lhung ba'i lta stangs mdzad pas/ 'bras bu thams cad sa la lhags/ ri dwags kriṣ+ṭha sa ra la dgug pa'i lta stangs mdzad pas/ skad cig la drung du rgyugs te zhabs la ldag par byed/ yul gan+ta ra'i rgyal po la dbang du byed pa'i lta stangs mdzad pas rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa der 'ongs te zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ slob dpon gyi bzhed pa ji lta bu bka' stsol cig ces zhu'o/ /gzhan yang gong bu dgug pa dang / rkang pa dgug pa sogs mang du bstan to/ /gan+ta ri'i rgyal po ma gtogs gzhan rnams la bla mas da ni khrol zhig ces gsung pa la/ slob dpon spyod pa pa nyid kyis 'grol bar brtsams pa la/'a sa 'a zhig cung zad tsam re ma gtogs dgrol ma nus/ de yang bla ma dza lan+ta ri pas zil gyis mnan pa yin/ de rjes khong nyid kyis slar gsos nas/ khyed kyis da dung spyod pa sngas/ gso nus pa dgos pa yin gsung / de nas kyang cung zhig bzhugs shing bsgoms nas skabs der ljon shing la 'gags te dpyangs pa'i mi ro mtshan ldan zhig la/ lta stangs mdzad pas 'gags thag chad/ sa la lhung pa la thugs brtad pas ro langs chen po phebs te/ slob dpon gyi drung na 'dug cing g.yog byed do/ /skye bo phal gyis lan re tsam mthong phal cher mi mthong ngo / /der snga ma las kyang nus pa cher 'phel bas/ 'khor rnams kyi nang du dril bsgrags te/ kho bo ni rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyod pas/ khyed nus pa thob pa rnams kyang nga dang lhan cig rgyu bar bya'o gsung / de rjes bla ma'i drung du phyag 'tshal nas/ sngar ni bla ma'i nus pas zil gyis mnan pa lags/—14—

yong nas bdag gis tshar bcad rjes gzung gnyis ka nus pa lags pas/ nges par gnang ba zhu zhes zhus pa la/ slob dpon dza lan+ta ri pas/ mkha' 'gro mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i rus pa'i rgyan drug de yang / slob dpon nag po la gnang nas/ 'o na da khyod rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa gyis shig /'on kyang yul de wi ko zhir ma 'gro zhig /lhag ma dur khrod brgyad dang / yul chen gzhan thams cad du ci bder rgyur bar gyis zhes bkas gnang ngo / /de nas brtsams te slob dpon spyod pa pa ni lam gyi spyod yul du rgyu ba'i tshe/ gdugs bdun ni 'dzin pa med pa rang 'khor/ ḍā ma ru bdun ni 'khrol ba po med par rang 'khro tshol/ res 'ga' ni zhabs khri gang gi sa la mi regs par bzhud/ res 'ga' ni ro langs me tog gi 'phreng ba can la chibs te 'byon/ lta stangs brgyad dam bcu'i sgo nas nyin re bzhin sems can mang po'i don mdzad do/ /dus la na 'ga' ni gdugs bdun bdun brgyar 'phel ba dang / ḍā ma ru bdun yang bdun brgyar 'gro ba dang / 'khor tshogs rnams kyang rang rang gi cho 'phrul dang bcas te bzhud pa dang bzhugs par yang mdzad do/ /de nas yul mā la pa dang mahā sna ni dang / ka ta li slo tra ste chu shing gi zhing zhes pa rnams su yang ci rigs par bzhugs shing sems can gyi don mdzad/ yul der grub thob go rak+ṣa dang mjal te/ de na re/ khyod dza lan+ta ri'i slob ma yin na/ dza lan+ta ri pa ni/ shar phyogs kyi rgyal po go bi tsan+t+ra sa sa dong du sbas nas lo bcu gnyis kyang lon na zhes 'phya ba ltar byung bas/ slob dpon spyod pa 'khor stong bzhi brgya dang bcas pa shar phyogs su byon nas/ rgyal po go bi tsan+t+ra'i pho brang gi sgo drung du bzhugs —15—

so/ /der grong khyer gyi rta dang glang po che rnams rtswa mi za/ bu chung rnams kyang ma'i nu zho mi 'thung / rol mo thams cad la yang sgra ma byung ngo / /der rnal 'byor pas nus pa bstan par shes nas/ rgyal po de spyom chung ngus phyir phyung / slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag byas te/ nang bar slob dpon 'khor bcas bdag gi khyim du 'byon par zhu gdan non par bgyid zhus pas/ nga la 'khor stong dang bzhi brgya yod pas/ khyod kyis tshim par bya mi nus gsung ba la/ ngas dmag mi 'bum phrag mang po la rtag tu zan sbyor na/ slob dpon 'khor bcas la ci'i phyir mi nus zhus/ slob dpon na re/ 'o na dang por nga'i slob ma gnyis tshims par gyis shig de tshims na nged gzhan rnams kyang rim pas 'ong ngo gsung / de nas de'i sang nyin snga dro mi stong dang bzhi brgya tshims par nus pa'i kha zas khyad par rnam pa mang po dag sbyar ba na/ rnal 'byor pa ma hi la dang / bha da la gnyis der byung ngo / /der de gnyis kyi ku ba'i lhung bzed du kha zas de dag yongs su rdzogs par blug kyang / snod kyang ma khengs la/ rnal 'byor pa de gnyis kyis thams cad gsol kyang da dung ma tshim mo zhes gsungs/ der nus pa'i rtags bstan par shes nas/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis slob dpon 'khor bcas rnams la mchod pa du mas mchod/ zhabs la gshugs te rjes su bzung bar zhus pas/ spros pa dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur zhing / gdams pa dang /rjes su gdams pa yang bstsal nas/ mthar rdza'i bum pa stong pa lag par gtad pa'i brda thabs kyis/ de kho na nyid 'chi ba med pa'i lam bstsal pa na/rgyal po na re/ 'di ni sngar gzhan la thos zin no zhus/ su la thos gsungs/ ha —16—

ḍi ba la thos zhus pas/ de ni grub thob dza lan+ta ri pa yin na/ khyod kyis sdig bsags pas khyod la 'chi ba med pa'i lam ga la 'ong / 'khor bcas thal bar 'gyur grang gsungs/ der rgyal po 'gyod pas gdungs shing shin tu skrag la/spyod pa ba'i slob ma rnams kyis ni dong gi sa dang nyal nyil rnams bsal nas/aṣ+ṭa bhā tu la rgyal po'i gzugs brnyan gsum byas te/ re re bzhin grub thob dza lan+ta ra'i zhabs la gtugs pa na/ smod pa mdzad pas thal bar song / de mthong pas rgyal po ches 'jigs shing skrag nas/ dran med du rgyal zhing 'gyel lo/ /de ltar bsdigs pas rgyal po'i sems kyi dri ma byang / phyis bzod pa gsol du bcug nas rjes su gzung / slob dpon grub brnyes dpon slob rnam pa gnyis kar gyis gdams pa bstan pas/ dus gzhan mi ring pa zhig na rgyal pos kyang grub pa thob bo/ /de skabs bha ṅga lar tshul de ltar bstan mod/ yul dza lan+ta ra na ni sngon bzhin bzhugs pa kho na'o/ /de nas slob dpon spyod pa ba/ yul shar lho o ḍi bi sha dang / de dang nye ba ka ling ka'i yul du ci rigs par bzhugs nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ de nas sing ga la'i gling du gshegs par bzhed nas/slob dpon rang nyid rgya mtsho'i steng du zhabs bzhag nas mi bying bar bzhud do/ /'khor nus pa thob pa rnams kyang rang rang gi 'phrul gyis 'gro ste/ kha cig ni rgya mtsho la lpags gdan bting nas 'gro/ kha cig ni rgya mtshor mkhar ba bsgyur pa la rkang pa bzhag nas 'gro/ kha cig ni byi'u zul byed cing 'gro kha cig ni nya'i steng du 'dug cing 'gro kha cig ni chu la ma reg par bar snang la 'gro ba sogs sna tshogs pa dag go /ka ling ka nas sing gha la'i bar la rgya mtsho kha zheng —17—

dpag tshad brgya phrag du ma yod pa/ chu tshod gcig gam gnyis kyi bar la spyad nas sing gha lar phebs so/ /der rgyal po ra tha ba la zhes bya ba yod de/ de 'khor dang bcas pa cho 'phrul gyi bkod pa de mthong bas lhag par dad de/zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing / mchod pa rgya chen pos yun ring du mchod do/ /gling de na de'i sngon du gsang sngags gyi theg pa ma dar pa las/ skabs der rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa dar bar mdzad/ grub pa thob pa yang mang du byung ngo / /rgyal po dang / blon po dang / khyim bdag /tshong dpon la sogs pas lha khang gsar du bzhengs pa mang po dag la byin rlabs rab tu gnas pa mdzad do/ /de nas rgyal po la yang dbang bskur zhing / gsang sngags kyi lha khang yang bzhengs/ de la kriṣ+ṭha bi ha ra zer/ da lta'i bar du byin rlabs che/ rang gi skal ba dang 'tshams par zhag bdun nas zla ba gcig gi bar du sa the btsugs nas gsol ba 'debs nus na/ long bar gyur pas kyang mig skyon med pa thob pa dang / bud med mo gsham yang dus ldan mar gnas 'gyur ba sogs yod do/ /gling der de sngon du tshangs pa'i srin po zhes bya ba'i gdon gyis 'tshe ba rtag tu yong zhing / de yang nyin bar gyi dus 'tshub ma sgor rlung gi rnam par 'ongs nas/ byis pa pho mo dang /rta dang glang po dang phyugs sogs la des skor ba tsam gyis skad cig la mang po 'chi bar 'gyur ba dang / mtshan mo'i dus na khyim skyod cing 'od 'byin pas mi phyugs dag gsod par byed pa dang / skabs 'gar bram ze dang btsun pa'i gzugs su bsgyur nas mi'i srog 'phrog pa dag yod de/ der slob dpon gyis de dag bskrad cing dam la bzhag pas gnod pa de da lta'i bar du rgyun chad cing /—18—

yang mkha' 'gro srin mo'i rigs kyi gnod pa sna tshogs pa 'byung ba yang de phyin chad med do/ /de nas gling ḍa mi to zhes bya ba gdug pa'i mkha' 'gro ma mang pos gang ba'i gnas shig na/ mkha' 'gro'i rigs kyi srin mo chen mo/ bi shwa ru bi te/ sna tshogs gzugs can ma zhes pa 'khor ra srin mo lnga brgya dang bcas mi mo'i gzugs su bsgyur te gnas la/ de rnams kyi sprul pas nyin re bzhin du/'dzam bu gling dang gling phran rnams kyi mi dang dud 'gro brgya stong du ma za bar byed pa cig yod do/ /de 'dul ba'i don du slob dpon 'khor bcas rgya mtsho la cho 'phrul sna tshogs pas bzhud de/ gling de'i 'gram du phebs pa na/ gtso mo sna tshogs gzugs can nyid lha mo dang 'dra ba'i bud med kyi gzugs su bsgyur nas lam kha na 'dug go /slob dpon der byon pa na/ de na re/ rnal 'byor ba gang gi phyir 'gro zer/ bi shwa ru pi ni 'dul ba'i phyir ro gsungs pas/ de na re/de ni gzugs dang yan lag mchog dang ldan pa/ yid gzhungs pa/ sems can mang po la phan par byed pa yin na/ de la gnod pa byar mi rung ngo zer/ slob dpon na re ma yin te/ nyin re bzhin skye bo brgya stong du ma la 'tshe bar byed pa'i phyir nges par 'dul lo/ /yang de ni rdzu 'phrul che ba yin na/ khyod kyis 'dul bar ga la nus zer/ slob dpon gyis de mthong bar 'gyur ro gsung pas/ skad cig de nyid la srin mo'i 'khor lnga brgya po yang snang bar gyur/ gtso mo rang yang 'jigs 'jigs ltar snang ba shin tu che ba'i gzugs su gyur te rngams pa'i tshul gyis 'ongs pa na/ slob dpon gyis de rnams la sdigs 'dzub bstan pas srin mo'i gtso mo de sgo thams cad nas khrag lhung bar gyur/ lhu tshigs thams —19—

cad zhig dran med du brgyal zhing myos/ 'khor thams cad kyang brgyal bog tshor ba drag pos gnad du gzir ro/ /der slob dpon gyis bka' bsgos shing dam la bzhag /sems can la 'tshe ba mi byed par mna' dor/ srin mo sna tshogs gzugs can ma nyid kyis slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ slob dpon lam du bzhud pa'i tshe bzhed na skye bo kun gyis mthong bar bdag gzhon pa chibs kyi tshul du 'gro bar bgyid/ bzhugs pa'i tshe gdan gyi tshul du yang gnas par bgyid/ phal cher du mi snang ba'i tshul gyis rjes su song ste/cho 'phrul sna tshogs pa ston pa dang / ma rung pa rnams tshar bcad par bgyi'o/ /zhes zhus shing slob dpon gyis kyang gnang ngo / /de nas lho phyogs kyi rgyud du yul tuṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍal te/ bya mchu'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba na/ lha mo sing ga la te/ dmar ser ma'i rdo sku rang byung zhig byung ste mi ring ba'i dus yin/ der mu stegs kyis rnal 'byor ma 'phrul dang ldan pa rnams 'dus te/ nub re bzhin du rigs sngags kyi mthus mi re bkug ste tshogs su za bar byed do/ /der lan cig mi mang po zhig dus gcig tu bzung nas dus ston la za bar byed 'dod pa la/ slob dpon der byon te rnal 'byor ma rnams lta stangs dang phyag rgyas gzir bas/ thang la mi ro bzhin du 'gyel/ rdo sku yang kha bub tu gyur pa la zhabs kyis bsnun pas/ phyed 'khyogs par song / de rnams dam la bzhag ste srog chags la gnod pa mi byed par byas so/ /'di 'dra'i rigs kyi ma mo'i sku rang byung du grags pa phal cher skye gnas kyi phyag rgyar yod zhal phyag gi rnam pa can nyung yang / 'di zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du grags/ yang lho phyogs ta spa la zhes bya —20—

ba'i yul du brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas bzhugs pa na/ phyogs de na mu stegs kyi rnal 'byor pa kriṣ+ṭha bhi ma zhes bya ba grub par grags pa cig yod de/ des slob dpon dang nus pa 'gran no zhes byas pa na/ rgyal po la sogs pa skye bo dpag tu med pa 'dus so/ /de na sangs rgyas pa'i lha khang gnas gzhi tsarla bi ha ra zhes bya ba gcig dang / mu stegs pa'i gnas gzhi su ka nā tha mā thu ra zhes bya ba zhig yod pa/ bar thag rgyang grags tsam mo/ /der kri ni bhi mas nang ba'i gnas gzhi de'i lha khang la rdzas kyis gtor zhing sngags btang pas khrum gyis zhig la khang pa la/ slob dpon gyis lta stangs mdzad pas slar 'byor te 'dug go /slar yang mu stegs kyis rdzas sngags btab kyang ci yang ma gnod do/ /mu stegs kyi gnas gzhi de ni drung cig na yod pa de'i ltag gi brag ri la/ slob dpon spyod pa pas lta stangs mdzad pas/ ri'i rtse mo nyil nas mu stegs pa'i lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad non no/ /des slob dpon la lta stangs dang / sdigs 'dzub dang / khu tshur la sogs pa rnam 'gyur sna tshogs byas kyang gnod pa med la/ slob dpon gyis de la phar lta stangs mdzad pas/ de nyid zhag gcig tu lus rengs te 'jims gzugs ltar song zhing 'gyel/ ngag rengs te smra ma thub/ yid rengs te dran med du brgyal zhing myos so/ /de nas skye bo thams cad rab tu 'jigs shing ngo mtshar bar yang gyur/ mi mang pos gsol ba 'debs par byed cing / slob dpon gyis slar yang gso ba'i lta stangs mdzad pas/ kriṣ+ṭha bhi ma yang rnal du gnas par gyur/ ta spa la'i yul du re zhig mu stegs rgyun chad de sangs rgyas pa 'ba' zhig —21—

tu gyur skad/ yul der sngon 'phags pa sha na'i gos can gyis byon/ skye bo mang po bden pa la bkod/ bar du mu stegs kho nar song / yang klu sgrub kyi dus su nang pa dang / yang nub pa la chos kyi grags pa'i dus su dar ro/ /skabs der phyi nang gnyis ka yod pa la/ des nang pa kho na dar/ da lta'i bar du'ang sangs rgyas pa yod de yul 'di ni grong khyer bi du na ga ra dang nye ba na yod do/ /yang yul bi ra dza pu ra zhes bya ba/ 'bigs byed kyi ri bo'i khongs kyi grong khyer de ba gha ṭa zer ba cig na/ log par lta ba'i rgyal po pad+ma dza zhes pa zhig yod do/ /slob dpon 'khor bcas der byon zhing / skye bo mang po dag gis mchod par byed pa na/ rgyal po de rab tu khros nas nyin mo slob dpon grong khyer du gshegs pa'i lam gyi g.yas dang g.yon du glang po che gtum po mche ba lcags kyis g.yogs pa gsum gsum bzhag ste slob dpon byon pa na rbad do/ /der glang po che re re'i mdun du slob dpon re re byung glang po che'i snas bsnyabs shing mche bas bsnun par brtsams pa na/ de na gang yang med par glo g.yas g.yon nam rgyab kyi phyogs su slob dpon 'dug par mthong ngo / /yang de phyogs su gdong ltas te sna zhal gyis 'ching ba'am mche ba brnun pa'am brdzi bar brtsams na/ yang glang po nyid kyi rgyab bam g.yas g.yon du bzhugs par snang ngo / /rgyab na bzhugs pa la rkang pas 'phras na de na med par mdun du bzhugs so/ /tshul de lta bu'i dus 'das te glang po che rnams ngal zhing thang chad nas sa la 'gyel lo/ /de nas rgyal po des zhabs la gshugs shing bzod par gsol nas lta ba log pa yang dor ro/ /yang yul kong ka nar gshegs/ der zhing gi rnal 'byor ma mang ngo/ yang —22—

'dus te tshogs kyi 'khor lor spyod pa na/ nub cig ḍā ma ru la sogs pa mchod pa'i rol mo'i sgra rnams las/ sgra shin tu snyan pa dag cher grags par gyur te yul de khyab bo/ /de thos pas grong khyer gyi mi rnams sgra des yid dbang med du drangs te/ slob dpon bzhugs pa'i phyogs der 'dus shing sgra de nyan cing 'dug go /de bzhin du phyugs rdzi rnams dang ri khrod pa rnams kyang ngo / /rta dang glang po dang ma he la sogs pa yang de nyan cing 'dus so/ /de bzhin du ri dwags dang bya sna tshogs dang gcan gzan sna tshogs pa dag kyang de nyan pa'i phyir 'dus shing 'dug go /de bzhin du lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa mi ma yin pa dag kyang 'dus te/ sems can de rnams thams cad sgra snyan po des 'khrul zhing myos pa'i ngang la mtshan mo de 'das te/ nang par nyi ma shar ba na slob dpon gyis snod chung ngu zhig nas ro mchog dang ldan pa'i kha zas sna tshogs pas mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad tshims par mdzad de/ khyed rnams rtag tu dge ba la spyod cig gsungs pas/ mi ma yin rnams na re lo lnga brgyar de ltar bgyi'o zer ro/ /de ni yul der de tsam nas bzung nas/ phyis mkhas pa sgo drug gi bar du mu stegs ngang gis nub cing nang ba 'ba' zhig rang shugs kyis dar ba la lta ba yin skad/ yang dus gcig na yul tsa ri tra zhes bya ba/ grong khyer tse t+ya pā ṭa na te mchod rten grong zhes bya ba na bzhugs so/ /gnas de ru rdo rje phag mos srid pa gsum gyi chang 'gugs par grags te/ chang tshong ma'i grong bdun brgya la sbyar ba'i chang rnams chang snod du rdzas sbyor thengs re dang / 'bru chang rnams 'bru btsos pa phabs dang sbyor thengs re la ji srid du chang lan mang du bsings nas mthar rdzas kyi tshigs ma'am/ 'bru'i sbang ma bcud med par —23—

song ba'i tshe/ chu tshod re tsam kha bsdi rma sa rte bzhag pa na/ slar yang gsar par log yong ba de 'dra ba lan bdun gyi bar du 'byung ba yin par 'dug /deng sang yang grong re re tsam la 'byung nges pa dang / dus bzang la lung pa thams cad myong gi dris khyab pa yong nges yin par 'dug /de'i rgyal po in du mā la zer ba zhig /nyi ma 'ba' zhig lhar 'dzin la lta ba log pas gnas pa'o/ /de tshes bcu gnyis kyi ma sna te pa zhig la/ lcags ri rim pa bdun gyis bskor ba'i nang / nyi ma'i lha khang du srog chags brgya stong du ma bsad pa'i mchod pa byed do/ /de'i dus la bab pa cig na/ lcags ri rim pa bdun gyi sgo ni bsdams/ phyi rol tu bsrung ba du ma bzhag /mchod pa byed pa'i bram ze dang / rgyal po 'khor bcas nang na yod de/ srog chags rnams kyang bcings te bzhag go /der slob dpon spyod pa ba gcig pu sgo drung du phebs nas/ sgo zung lnga brgya tsam la lta stangs mdzad pas/ thams cad dbang du gyur te 'dzum dmul zhing 'dug go /sgo rim pa thams cad rang bye ste mchod pa'i gnas su byon/ mchod sbyin gyi don du bcings pa'i mi dang dud 'gro'i tshogs pa la lta stangs mdzad pas thag pa rnams rang chad la song / bram ze'i mchod pa'i sbyin sreg gi thab la lta stangs mdzad pas/ me de skad cig gis cher mched nas phyogs de thams cad mes khyab pa'i snang ba shar te rgyal po 'khor bcas 'jigs te bros so/ /de nas rgyal po dang bram ze de dag slob dpon gyis mthu bstan par shes nas/zhabs la phyag btsal zhing gsung bzhin sgrub par khas blangs/ de dag kyang sangs rgyas la dad pa la bkod nas yul g.yin du bzhud do/ /yang lho phyogs ma blo ra'i yul dang nye ba/ ha ri ke la zhes bya bar bzhud de/ yul de na gnas chen du byed pa ri shin tu che ba zhig yod/ deng sang ni tsan+d+ra ku ma ra zer gyin —24—

'dug go /ri de'i drung du tshogs khang bcos der tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i rol pa rgya chen po mdzad pa'i skabs shig sgo drung na ma he mo phru gur btsas pa 'jogs gin yod pa las/yul de'i mi dpon zhig gis rnal 'byor pa nus pa yod med blta'o byas nas/ nyi ma gung gi dus zhig tshogs kyi khang pa'i sgo bsdams te 'dug pa las/ ma he mo ma smad gnyis brkus nas song ngo / /der gom pa lnga bcu tsam song nas phyi mig bltas pas/ ma he mo phru gur bcas pa sngar gyi shul na 'dug ste/ phan tshun du bltas na shin tu 'dra bar mthong /yang mi zhig btang ste de yang brkus so/ /yang sngar bzhin phyi mig bltas pa na/ sngar gyi shul na snga ma bzhin 'dug ste/ de yang brkus pa sogs lan bdun gyi bar du de bzhin du byung ngo / /de nas ma he mo bdun dang phru gu bdun thob bo snyam na/ ma bu gnyis las gzhan mi 'dug go /sngar gyi shul la phyi mig bltas pas/ sngar gyi shul na ma bu gnyis 'dug go /des bsams pa da ci'i ma he mo dang be'u de 'di yin nam cig shos de yin/'di las gang zhig bden gang zhig rdzun mi shes so snyam ste/ lhan cig tu khrid pa de yang bor te song ngo / /de nas des rnal 'byor pa'i rnam 'phrul dang mngon shes 'jug tshul ngo mtshar bar shes nas/ rang nyid rgyal srid phyed kyi 'byor pa spangs te/ slob dpon gyi 'khor du rnal 'byor ba byas so/ /de ni la bā yi pa yin par grags/ yang yul tri ling ga'i rgyal pos slob dpon 'khor bcas mchod par byas pa'i skabs shig phyogs de dang nye ba'i dur khrod a sna spyo ha sa te ha ha sgrog par khyon/ der tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i spyod pa yun ring du mdzad/ yo byad 'byor pa dpag tu med pa rgyal pos phul zhing / yul gyi bram ze dang / rgyal rigs kyi bu dang / tshong dpon dang / zhing pa dang / gdol pa la sogs pa skye bo mang po dang / bud med lnga brgya tsam mchod pa'i don du 'dus pa las/ tshogs kyi —25—

bza' ba'i khyad par las kha hūṃ dza ste shing thog rgyal mo ga gon re gcig yod pa brgya stong du 'phel te kun la stsal ba/ de rnams kyis zos pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ dbab pa'i lta stangs mdzad pas thams cad la ye shes phebs te/ lus ngag gi rnam 'gyur dang rdzu 'phrul/ cho 'phrul sna tshogs pa bstan to/ /rjes su de thams cad rnal 'byor pho mor gyur te/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po 'ba' zhig thob pa stong phrag mang po byung zhing dngos grub thob pa'ang mang po'o/ /yang yul daṇ+ḍa ka ra khyo zhes bya ba lho phyogs ji na'i yul dang nye ba zhig na bzhugs te/ gnas de na mtsho rdzing bzang po zhig yod/ skye bo rnams kyang de las 'thung ba la der nag phyogs kyi klu gdugs pa can gnyis glo bur du 'ongs te/ dug sbrul gyi gzugs kyis dngos su chu 'thungs pas kha'i dug gi mtsho de ma rungs par byas so/ /de na nang pa'i gnas gzhi zhig yod pa'i dge slong dang / dge bsnyen 'ga' res mtsho rdzing de las chu 'thung pas dug sprul gyi kha chu 'dres pa'i dug gis de ma thag shi'o/ /de slob dpon gyis gsan nas mtsho 'gram der byon pas/ mtsho 'khrugs pa'i gseb nas gdug pa'i klu de gnyis byung ste/ slob dpon gyi sku la 'ching bar sems te 'khril yang der gnod pa ni ma nus/ slob dpon gyis dgongs pa brtad de/ sku lus bgang bas gdug pa'i klu sprul gyi gzugs can de gnyis kyi lus dum bu brgya phrag brgya phrag tu chad/ yun ring du sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba drag pos gzir du bcug go /slar gus pas gsol ba 'debs pa na/ sems can la gnod pa mi byed par dam la bzhag nas/ yang gso ba'i lta stangs kyis rjes su gzung chu'i dug kyang bsdus/ sngar gyi mi shi ba rnams kyang thal mo brdab pa'i sgra mdzad pas gsos so/ /der slob dpon ni gdug pa'i sbrul 'dul bar byon song zhes slob ma rnams kyis thos te bltar 'ongs bas yul de'i skye bo phal cher de —26—

na 'dus/ klu btul zin nas klu de dag dang klu sprul gyi gzugs can dpag tu med pa 'dus nas/ khang bzang gi rnam par byas pa'i dbus na slob dpon bzhugs so/ /skye bo thams cad de la blta zhing ngo mtshar du byed par gyur/ de nas sprul de dag mi snang bar song zhing skye bo'i tshogs de dag kyang gyes so/ /yul der sngags kyi theg pa bshad pas kyang skye bo mang pos dngos grub thob par grags so/ /de dag gi skabs shig dpal o rgyan gyi gnas kyi rgyal po dig de ba ste phyogs kyi lha zhes pas slob dpon spyan drangs te yun yang ring du bzhugs shing / phyogs de na gnas pa'i mu stegs kyi rnal 'byor pa dang / mkha' 'gro ma nus pa thob pa mang po zhig lta stangs dang / cho 'phrul gyis btul/ de'i shugs kyis phyi ba'i phyogs 'dzin pa'i rgyal phran dang paṇ+ḍi ta nyi shu tsam nang par gyur skad/ re re bzhin gyi lo rgyus rgyas par ma bris kyang / la la dbang du byed pa'i lta stangs kyis dbang du bsdus/ la la rengs par mdzad pa sogs kyis bsdigs/ la la gcig dang du ma dang 'bar ba la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul bstan/ la la sems shes pa'i mngon shes sogs bstan pas dad pa bskyed pa yin no/ /der dur khrod chen po sto ra an+ta kar tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ dpal he ru ka 'khor lo sdom pa rig pa'i lha mor bcas pa mngon sum du byon pas slob dpon nyid rab tu dgyes te ro langs mang po dang lhan cig tu sngags kyi bstod pa dang bcas te gar dang skor ba mdzad pas/ keng rus dang ce spyang rnams kyang gar byed do/ /mi bzad pa'i lus can mang pos kyang mchod par byed do/ /de'i tshe dpal he ru kas sngags kyi sgra dbyangs sngon du 'gro bas/ kyai 'jig rten ma rig 'thibs po'i smag gis mun par sprul pa la/ /mtshan mo sprin rus stug po'i nang nas glog 'gyu gsal 'bar bzhin/ /rab tu —27—

gnyen gshin 'jam pa'i blo gros phyogs grol ltar yang las/ /nyi ma bye ba phrag brgya las lhag 'od kyis snang bar gyis/ /gang las rnam pa drug gi ngag tshig dpyod gsal bas/ /bde dang ye shes rnam shes thar ba'i don ldan pa/ /sna tshogs spyod dang nus pa snying la 'jug 'gyur ba'i/ /skye bo'i rab rib sel byed mngon par sbyor bar gyis/ /zhes dbugs phyung zhing snang ba byin no/ /de nas slob dpon gyis/ srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags dul bar ldan/ /sogs kyis bstod pas/ ha ha he he la sogs pa bzhad pa brgyad kyis bzhad de mi snang bar gyur to/ /yang phyis dza lan+ta rar yang bzhud de/ sa 'og nas rdo rings chen po dpangs su 'dom brgyad/ rgyar 'dom gang pa cig bton te phyag ya gcig gis bsnams nas/ ko ne dzo'i grong khyer gyi mthar btsugs so/ /rdo rings de da lta yang yod do/ /gnas der yang rdo rje theg pa'i zab mo'i don ci rigs pa gsungs/ yang yul ra dha'i rgyal pos gsol ba btab nas/ so ma pu ri'i lha khang zhig la rab gnas mdzad/ skye bo thams cad kyis mthong bar lha khang nam mkha' la lan gsum du 'phags shing / lha rnams gar byed par snang ngo / /'di so ma pu ri rnying pa yin/ phyis byung ba cha gsum gyi gtsug lag khang ni so ma pu ri gsar ba ste/ rgyal po de ba pā las so ma ru ra'i gnas gzhi dang grong rnams sa yul gsar par dpos pas snga ma'i ming de ka gsar pa la'ang grags so/ /yul bi ra dzar byon pa'i lo rgyus nas de dag gi bar gyi gtam rnams 'dir bshad pa'i go rim yin gyi/ dus snga phyi sna tshogs yod par snang la de dag ni slob dpon ku sa li chung bas mdzad pa'i gnas kyi sgron me zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos kyi thog mar bshad pa'i gtam rgyud ltar bris pa'o/ /spyir yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang dur khrod brgyad de sum cu rtsa gnyis su ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa bstan pa'i lo rgyus dang / rgyas pa la gnas —28—

bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad dang / dur khrod bcu drug du byon pa'i gtam rgyud kyang yod par snang zhing / tsar+ya pa rnams kyi sde na de dag gi glegs bam yang yod ces thos so /de nas phyis shig na/ yul chen po shar phyogs bha ṅga la na sngar gyi rgyal po go bi tsan+t+ra'i tsha bo rgyal po rol pa'i zla ba rgyal srid skyong zhing / de'i blon po ni dge ba'i mgon po'o/ /der rgyal po la sogs pa yul khams kyi skye bo gzhan thams cad mu stegs byed kho na la mos shing / blon po dge ba'i mgon po 'khor bcas nyid nang pa'o/ /slob dpon nag po spyod pa 'khor stong bzhi brgya dang bcas pa/ gdugs bdun brgya dang / ḍā ma ru bdun brgya dang / 'khor tshogs thams cad la yang cho 'phrul sna re dang bcas bhaX ga la'i grong khyer du byon no/ /de dus kyi grong khyer ni he ma da la yin par 'dug da lta de stongs nas nags su yod zer/ der skye bo thams cad ngo mtshar du 'dzin bzhin pa las/ blon po dge ba'i mgon pos mchod par byas shing / grong khyer gyi dbus dang phyogs bzhi thams cad du khyab par nyul bar mdzad/ rgya gar gyi grong khyer chen po rnams la phyogs mtshams brgyad kar du dur khrod yod pas/ phyogs mtshams kyi dur khrod brgyad rnams su nges pa med par bzhugs shing skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la zab mo'i don gyi bka' drin yang mdzad do/ /der blon po dge ba'i mgon pos yo byad bzang la gya nom pas mchod bzhin pa la dus ring tsam song ba na/ lan cig dge ba'i mgon po drung du 'ongs ba zhig la/khyod kyis nga la mang du sbyin pa ni gang gi don du yin gsung / bdag gi skyed mos tshal na/'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang zhig bzhengs yod pas/ de la slob dpon gyis rab tu gnas pa mdzad par zhu zhug pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas 'o na deng nyid tshes dang gza' dang skar ma dang sbyor ba dang byed pa mtha' dag bzang bas/ da lta rang bya —29—

gsung / yo byad ji lta bu 'tshal zhus pas/ gang yang mi dgos gsung / lha khang du bzhud pa'i lam nas me tog cig bsnams/ lha khang du byon nas sku gzugs kyi spyi bor me tog bldan ste/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha gsungs nas rab gnas tshar ro gsungs/ der blon po dge pa'i mgon po yid ma ches pas/ slob dpon na re/ khyod yid ma tshes na ngas rab gnas brtul te 'gro'o zhes gsung / dbu thog tu bzhag pa'i me tog de blangs te slob dpon bzhud pa na/ spyan ras gzigs kyi sku gzugs de yang bkag ste bzhengs nas slob dpon gyi phyi bzhin du thegs/ slob dpon bzhugs pas dur khrod du khyon no/ /der blon po 'gyod de dur khrod der song / sngar yid ma tshes pa la bshags pa phul te/ da ni yid tshes pas rab gnas mdzad par zhu zhug pas/ sngar bzhin me tog sku gzugs kyi spyi bor bzhag /sku gzugs 'od 'phro zhing gzi brjid dang ldan par song / de nas blon po dge ba'i mgon pos spyan ras gzigs kyi sku gzugs de spyan 'dren par brtsams na/ mi gnyis dang bzhi dang brgyad dang bcu drug nas brtsams te/ lnga brgya'i bar gyis kyang g.yo 'gul byed ma nus te gnas de nyid du lha khang bzhengs/ de la ni rga snya pa na zhes grags/sngar gyi lha khang der yang mchod rten lha can zhig byas so/ /sngar bod na yod pa'i lo rgyus gyen/ 'dir rgyal po'i chad pa byung gi dogs pas lha dbang phyug chen po'i rnam pa dang 'dra ba'i spyan ras gzigs bzhengs zer ba 'dug /'on kyang sku 'dra de phyis kla kle'i 'jigs pas/ gang ga swā ga ra zhes pa rgya mtsho'i de'u cig la spyan drangs nas da lta yod 'dug pa/mthong ba rnams zer ba ltar na 'phags pa ha lā ha lwa zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa de yin yod 'dug pa de ni gdod nas dbang phyug zhi ba dang rnam pa phyogs 'dra ba yin gyi/ mu stegs pa'i lha dang 'dra bar rdzus te bcos pa min no/ /de nas blon po dge ba'i mgon —30—
