pos gsol ba btab pa la/ de skal ba dang ldan par mkhyen nas/ dbang bskur zhing gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa yang stsal lo/ /spyir btang la/ dpa' bo'i dbang phyug mi 'bri zhing / /gang gi thad du'ang mi gdon no/ /zhes 'byung ba yin kyang / skabs der mkha' 'gros lung bstan te/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bris sku zhig blon po nyid kyi yi dam du bzhengs so/ /de shin tu gsang shing mtshan mo bsgom bzlas dang mchod gtor byed kyin yod pa las/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bsgrags te/ blon po dge ba'i mgon pos rgyal po'i lha gdan du btang ba'i lha sku bzhengs yod par 'dug ces grong khyer ba kun la grags so/ /der blon po'i nye du dang grogs po 'ga' zhig na re/ khyed kyis 'di lta bu bzhengs 'dug pa/ de yul gzhan zhig tu brdzangs na legs/ gal te rgyal pos khyim g.yengs btang ste snyed na khyod kyi mgo gcod par 'gyur zhes zer/ der blon po skrag ste bris sku de snod du bcug gos mang pos g.yogs te mi ro yin pa ltar rdzus te khyogs la bteg /lto sgo nas brdzangs pas sgo de'i sgo srungs pa the tshom zos te bzung nas bltas pas bris sku der 'dug de dbyug pa'i rtse mor btags te rgyal po'i drung du khyer/ grong khyer ba rnams smra ba ni bden te blon po dge ba'i mgon po'i 'di lta bu bris so zhes byas/rgyal pos blon po gzhan dang bros pa rnams bsags te gros byis pas/ dge ba'i mgon po gsal shing la bskyon nam/ mgo chod cig ces thams cad mgrin gcig tu smra'o/ /rgyal po na re/ khyed rnams ma brtags pa kho nar smra'am/ rgyal po zhes bya ba brtags shing dpyad nas byed dgos pas/ ngas brtags par bya'o zhes dge ba'i mgon po bos so/ /de la bris sku bstan nas nga'i lha mnan pa'i sku 'bri ba 'di/ khyod kyis dran nam/ khyod rang gi slob dpon gyis dran/ sus dran pa de la chad pa gcod gsung / blon po —31

na re/ 'di bdag gis dran pa yang ma yin/ slob dpon gyi dran pa yang ma yin gyi nang pa sangs rgyas pa rang gi gzhud nas bshad zhus pas/ rgyal po yid ma ches pa la khyim nas glegs bam blangs te bstan pas/ rgyal po na re/ de na bden mod kyi gzhung lugs 'di gnyis gang bden nus pa 'gran no zhes gsungs nas/ rgyal pos kyang he ru ka gdan du byas pa'i bris sku bzhengs so/ /ri mo'i bya ba zin pa na/ rgyal po na re/ khyod kyi bris sku dang / nga'i bris sku gdan mtho dma' med pa cig la bzhag sgo bsdams te khyed dang nged kyi mi su yang mi 'gro/ mchod pa rgya chen po yang mnyam por 'bul/ gsol ba yang mnyam por 'debs/ de ltar zhag bdun song nas rang re gnyis kar phyogs mi dang bcas pa mnyam por 'ongs te ngo mtshar pa'i ltas kyi nus pa blta ba yin no/ /de rjes gang nus pa dang ldan pa de'i rjes su cig shos nus pa med pa de 'jug dgos so/ /zhes byas nas bris sku gnyis lha khang gsar ba cig gi nang du bzhag theg bdun du de ltar byed pa las/blon pos rgyal po'i bka' 'gong bar ni mi nus pas de ltar byas kyang / khong 'dar bas lan cig slob dpon gyi drung du song nas/ 'di ltar byed dgos byung bas slob dpon gyis nus pa bstan par zhu byas tsa na/ slob dpon gyi gsung na re/ khyod sems las chung ngur 'dug cing / don 'di la ngas nus pa ston mi dgos kyi/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka phyugs bdag gis brji bar ga la nus gsung ste/ dur khrod rnams su glu dang gar la sogs pa rol ba sna tshogs pas bzhugs so/ /de nas zhag brgyad pa'i nyin par rgyal po dang blon po gnyis/ sangs rgyas pa dang mu stegs byed kyi phyogs 'dzin rnams dang bcas te/ lhan cig lha khang der zhugs nas bris sku gnyis dus gcig tu zhal phye'o/ /der bris sku snga ma dpal he ru ka ni sngar bas kyang tshes gzi brjid 'bar bar 'dug /rgyal pos —32—

bzhengs pa'i bris sku de yang snga ma las rang 'gyur nas/ dbang phyug chen po dang lha mo u ma mnan pa'i dpal he ru ka'i sku brnyan nyid du gyur ro/ /der thams cad kyis bris sku la mchod cing / rgyal rnga chen po yang brdungs te/ da phyin chad rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa sangs rgyas pa byed do zhes dril bsgrags so/ /de nas rgyal pos kyang slob dpon spyod pa pa'i zhabs la gtugs/ dbang bskur zhug shing gdams pa nod/ phyis dus gzhan na rgyal blon 'di gnyis kyang dngos grub thob/dus der re zhig rgyal blon bram ze tshong dpon khyim bdag sogs thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa kho na mchod de yul lha mchod pa dang / gsangs te mchong/ pa'i rigs ma gtogs/ bha ṅga la ba ril gyis sangs rgyas par gyur/ yul gru chen po de de ltar gyur pas/shin tu ya mtshan pa'i dbang du byas nas/ sku gzugs rnam par 'gyur ba'i gtam zhes lo rgyus 'di rgya gar na grags che'o/ /yul der yang sngags kyi bstan pa shin tu dar bar gyur/ slob dpon 'dis kyang de skabs yun ring du bzhugs so/ /de nas lan cig da ni dur khrod chen po brgyad dam bcu drug dang / yul chen gzhan thams cad ni bgrod zin pas/ da ni de bī ko ṭar yang 'gro'o dgongs so/ /de nas bha ṅga la'i yul bsgral te bar gyi yul khams ba ren+d+ra zhes bya bar byon/ der yang dus ci rigs pa song ba na/ nyin gcig grong khyer du gshegs pa'i lam ka cig na/ chu shing dang / dzaskru dang / a rma la sogs pa'i 'bras bu can gyi shing sna tshogs pa'i tshal cig gi 'gram na/ de bsrung ba'i bu mo zhig 'dug nas/ slob dpon gyi 'khor lhan cig rgyu ba'i rnal 'byor ba dag gis de la shing 'bras slongs so/ /bu mo de na re/ khyod rang rnams nus pa dang ldan par rlom gyin 'dug pa/ nus pas shing thog phob la zo zer/ slob dpon gyis lhung ba'i lta stangs mdzad —33—

pas shing thog thams cad nyil gyis byung / sa la ma reg tsam la bu mo des rdzi ma gyen du bskyod pa'i lta stangs byas pa tsam gyis/ yang shing thog de rnams gyen la yar song nas rang gnas su 'byar te 'dug go /de nas slob dpon gyis lta stangs kyis mar la phab/bu mo'i lta stangs kyis yar la 'byar ba de gnyis/ re mos 'ba' zhig gi tshul gyis ring zhig thogs so/ /mthar bu mo de na re/ nus pa cung zad tsam la nga brgyal bar mi bya la/zhing mtha' dag rang du rgyu bar yang mi bya'o zer nas mi snang bar song ngo / /bu mo de ni rdo rje phag lnga'o/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na/ slob dpon nyid 'khor dang bcas pa/ yul kasnro wo'i mda' bod kyi ri dang nye ba'i phyogs yul de bī ko ṭar byon no/ /der rnal 'byor pa'i gnas gzhi gcig kyang mdzad/ da ni 'dir yang 'ongs pas/ dzaskru gling gi dur khrod chen po rnams dang / yul chen po rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas bgrod par bya ba'i zhing thams cad bgrod zin gyi/ phyin chad gzhan du mi 'gro bar 'dir 'dug go gsung ngo / /der dus ring zhig song ba na 'phra men ma chen mo mu stegs kyi mkha' 'gro ma zhig rigs bar ma'i khyim du mi'i skye ba'i gzugs bstan pa'i ming ni pa hu rī zhes zer ba zhig yod do/ /de don du ni ma mo spyi'i pho nya mo kā la daṇ+ḍi bha rta kā li nyid yin skad/ de lo bcu drug ma tsam du gyur pa na/ yul de'i rten gyi gtso bo sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel can gyi mchod rten gcig bzhugs pa'i rtse mor phra men ma des ma mo'i skye gnas kyi phyag rgya bzhag go /de yun ring du de khar bzhag na yul de'i nye skor gyi sangs rgyas pa thams cad brlag par 'gyur par slob dpon gyis mkhyen nas gsungs pas slob dpon gyi slob ma rnams kyis skye gnas kyi phyag rgya de blangs te/ chu bo chen por dor ro/ /de la des 'khon du bltas nas 'dug go /lan cig slob dpon grong khyer du bzhud —34—

pa'i lam gcig na/ gdug pa'i mkha' 'gro ma de gshun shing thogs nas 'bras brdung zhing 'dug go /de dang nye bar slob dpon 'khor bcas byon pa na/ lus kyis slob dpon la ma gus pa'i rnam 'gyur ston cing sangs rgyas pa spyi la kha zer ro/ /der slob dpon gyis lta stangs mdzad pas 'bras kyi gtun dang gtun bu tshal par gas/ des kyang slob dpon la lta stangs byas mod cang ma gnod do/ /yang des slob dpon gyi 'khor rnams la lta stangs yang yang byas pas/ phal cher la ma gnod kyang / kha cig la gos tshig pa dang 'gyel ba dag byung ngo / /slob ma de rnams kyis zhus nas yang slob dpon gyis lta stangs mdzad pas/ phra men ma de kha bub tu ltung ba dang / lag pa gnyis sa la lhung ngo / /der slob dpon thugs snying rje cung zad skyes pas lag pa gnyis gso ba'i lta stangs kyis 'byar bar mdzad do/ /des sngags bzlas shing slob dpon la lta stangs byed do/ /snying rje'i shugs kyis thugs yengs te bsrung ba g.yel ba'i rnam pa cung zad cig byung ba yin nam zer/ slob dpon rang gi gnas gzhir phebs pa na/ shin tu bsnyung par gyur te/slob dpon na re/ 'di lta bu ni bla ma'i gsung las de bī ko ṭar ma 'gro zhes gsung na/bka' de bcag pa'i nyes pa yin gyi/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / dur khrod brgyad du dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams la tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang bshags pa gyis shig de nas kyang lang la shog zhag bdun gyi khongs su 'khor bar gyis gsung / de nas slob ma rkang mgyogs kyi grub pa thob pa mang pos/ skad cig la myur bar de rnams byas te/ tshur log 'ongs pas/ tshan gcig gis sman thogs te 'ongs pa la/ lam dang nye ba na bud med mang pos pad+ma'i mtsho la khrus byed de/ de rnams na re rnal 'byor pa khrus gyis zer/ slob dpon bsnyung bas long ba med do byas pa na/ de rnams na re/ bsnyung ba gdangs zer/—35—

sman rnams chu 'gram du bzhag nas khrus cung zad byas pas/ sman de dag bud med de rnams kyis khyer nas gar song cha med do/ /de nas nang du 'ongs nas slob dpon dang mjal ba na/ bud med de dag sngar gyi mkha' 'gro ma des sprul pa yin gsung / de nas slob ma'i mchog rnal 'byor pho mo bdun 'byu rtsa gnyis bos te/ sku'i drung du gnas pa la/slob dpon na re/ da res bla ma'i bka' bcag pa'i chad pa zlog tu med pa yin/ da bar dor mchog gi dngos grub bsgrubs te slar 'ong ba yin pas de bar du 'dir yang ma yong zhig gsungs nas/ sgo bsdams te bzhugs so/ /der slob ma rnams kyis shin tu gsang bar byas kyang gdug pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis de slar byung na bdag cag phung bar 'gyur zhes 'gros nas/ sku 'das so shes bsgrags pa'i rkyen gyis bram ze dang rtsis mkhan rnams kyis tshor nas rgyal po la zhus te/ de dag rgyal po'i mi dang bcas pa 'ongs nas/ zhag lnga ba'i nyin mo sgo phye bas slob dpon sku 'das par mthong / slob ma 'ga' dang bram ze dang rtsis mkhan rnams kyis tsan+dan la sogs pa'i bud shing khyer te/ dud khrod chen por sku gdung spyan drangs pa na/ skad cig de nyid la ral gri la sogs pa'i dngos grub brgyad cu rtsa bzhi las re re ster bar byed pa po/ gdod nas grub pa'i grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi 'khor mang po dang bcas pa gang nas byung cha med par 'ongs pas/ bram ze la sogs pa mi de rnams de dag gi gzi brjid ma bzod gdung bas tshig par gyur te/cung zad bros nas rgyang ring po nas skye bo'i tshogs rnams dang lhan cig lta ba las gdung la nye bar 'gro ma thub bo/ /grub thob de rnams kyis bar snang la dkyil 'khor bris pa'i dbus su sku gdung bzhag ste/ rang byung gi me 'od kyis sbyangs so/ /dus der mya ngan gyi shugs yod pa ltar ston pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa de dag blta bar 'ongs pa'i rnal —36—

'byor pho mo stong phrag brgya cu rtsa bzhi dang / glo bur du lhags pa gzhan 'bum phrag du ma 'dus te gnas pa la/ zhag bdun pa'i tha mar slob dpon nyid sngon bzhin du gdugs bdun brgya dang / ḍa ma ru bdun brgya dang / snang ba'i 'khor bdun brgya dang / mi snang ba'i 'khor bdun brgyar bcas pa mngon sum du byon byung ba na/ rnal 'byor ba thams cad ngo mtshar skyes nas bsu ba byas shing / sa phyogs mtho ba cig la slob dpon bzhugs te/ so so la chos kyi bka' mchid mang du mdzad do/ /de'i mthar nga'i lus ga re zhes gsung ba la/ bsregs zin to zhes zhus pas/ do ha rdo rje glu dbyangs mchog dang bcas pas sku'i snang ba de dang 'khor stong bzhi brgya yang mi snang bar gyur ro/ /gdung zhugs la phul ba'i gnas skabs der/ sa g.yo ba dang / 'od kyis khyab pa dang / spos kyi dri ngad phyogs thams cad du ldang ba dang / nam mkha' nas rol mo'i sgra dang / me tog gi char chen po byung ngo / /de nyin yar ngo'i tshes bcu gnyis yin/ de bī ko ṭar da lta yang zhag dus de la sgra 'od me tog gi char sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas re rtag tu 'ong ba yin par 'dugader gdung zhugs la zhen pa de mi legs pa chen po byung zer nas/ da nas brtsams te da lta'i bar du rgya gar ba'i rnal 'byor pa rnams phung po bsreg sbyang mi byed do/ /de nas re zhig shar phyogs kyi rgyal khams de bī ko ṭa dang / ba ren+d+ra dang / kā ma ru pa dang / he ra spa dang / shrī ha spyo dang / bha ṅga la dang / o ḍi bi sha dang / ra dha la sogs pa'i ljongs rnams su yul phyogs grong khyer thams cad rnal 'byor pho mos khyab pa lta bur yod pa la/ ji zhig ltar nas 'di 'di na 'di ltar gnas/ 'di ltar song zhes brjod du med par phal cher mi snang ngo / /dus de skabs shig ma ru'i yul gyi pu sku ra zhes pa'i yul du slob dpon 'di nyid phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa mngon sum du byon/ nub phyogs kyi yul sna tshogs su —37—

phebs/ skal ldan gyi skye bo mang po gnas lugs rtogs pa la bkod/ zla ba 'ga' re bzhugs nas mthar gar gshegs cha med do/ /lho phyogs kaṇ+ḍa ṭa kar ni bar dor mchog bsgrubs te sngar gyi sku lus de nyid la zhugs nas mngon sum du byon pa yin ces 'gro ba mang po la bcud len sogs gnang ste phan 'dogs pa dang / dbul 'phongs dang nad pa mang po'i sdug bsngal bsal/ 'ga' zhig la gdams ngag kyang cung zad bstan par mdzad de zla ba bzhi tsam bzhugs par grags/ yul de'i phyogs gcig she ya gi ri zhes bya ba na/ de ltar byon pa'i dus kyi mchod pa da lta yang yod do/ /byang phyogs ga ṅga dang ya mu na'i bar mtshams ma la bu ri zhes bya bar sngar gyi sku lus la zhugs te der byon pa yin gsungs nas sngar brtul zhugs spyod pa'i dus la ma sleb pas nyes/ da spyod pa'i dus la bab na lus la rang byung gi phyag rgya drug 'gyung bar shog ces gsungs nas/ zla ba drug tu rtse gcig tu bsgom pa ltar mdzad/ de nas sku la rus kla 'i rgyan drug rang byung du yang byung /zhag bdun du spros bcas kyi spyod pa mdzad par kun gyis mthong ngo / /de nas zung 'jug gi sku bsnyes te mi snang bar gyur skad/ yang ma ga dha dang nye ba lho phyogs dza ri khaṇ+ḍa ra gtogs pa'i de ba gha ṭa zhes bya ba'i grong khyer du bram ze'i rigs su gtogs pa cig gi khyim du skye ba bzhes te/ sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug rang byung du yod par sku bltams/ de ma thag nga sngon gyi slob dpon nag po yin gyi lam lhag ma rnams lus 'di la rdzogs par 'gyur gsung nas/ btsas ma thag nas bsgom par mdzad/ zla ba gcig tsam na sku lus kyi bskyed rdzogs shing / de nas kyang mnyam bzhag 'ba' zhig la bzhugs zla ba drug gi mtha' yang zer/ lo gcig la yang zer/ sgra dang 'od dang me tog gi char sogs cho 'phrul dang bcas te mi snang bar gyur te zung 'jug gi sku brnyes pa'o/ /yul de na yang —38—

mchod pa dang / dus ston gyi rnam grangs re da lta'i bar du yang yod do/ /tshul de lta bus phyi rjes su yang cho 'phrul mtha' yas pa bstan to/ /de ltar na rnam thar gtam rgyud de dag ni/slob dpon grub thob ku sa li pa'i gsung lo rgyus kyi sdoms la srogs shing bcol te/ rgya bod kyi lo rgyus gzhan yid ches yod nges rnams las kha bskang ste bris pa yin pas shin tu rnam par dag pa sem mo/ /slob dpon 'dis dang po yul dza lan+ta ra nas byon pa'i dus nas/ phyis de bī ko ṭar phebs pa'i bar la slob dpon nyid kyis chos bstan pa dang /gzhan yang mig ltos kyi bdag rkyen la brten nas skye bo dpag tu med pa cig sngags kyi theg pa la zhugs te rnal 'byor pho mor gyur pas/ grong khyer bcu gsum tsam stongs skad pa'i grong khyer ni byang phyogs ma la'i grong ste 'phrog byed sgo dang / nub phyogs arba rnyi ste/mā la pa dang / kan+ti ste lto phyogs kha na'i yul dang / bi rā dza ste lho phyogs bi dza pu ra dang /puṇ+ḍa brta ste shar phyogs li kha ra shing 'phel dang / ka na ka ste lto phyogs ma ra ha ṭa'i nang tshan cig dang / grong khyer ka ra n+ya te khyo phyogs go dha ba ri dang nye ba dang / tsi ti pa ṭa na ste lho phyogs tsa ri tra dang / he ma da la ste shar phyogs bha ṅga la'i khyad par dang / yul byang phyogs gan+dha ra ste deng sang ṭi lar grags pa dang / de bā gha ṭa ste lho phyogs dza ri khaṇ+ḍa'i bye brag cig dang / shar lto grong khyer ga ling ka dang / yul dbus ro da si dang / nub phyogs grong khyer pu kā ra rnams so/ /de dag kyang skor tse skor tse stongs pa rang min gyi/ grong khyer de dang de'i cha lag yul khams thams cad nas/ skyes pa bud med khye'u mi bu mo rnams rnal 'byor pho mo byas pa'i grangs rnams bgrangs na/ phyi lcags ris bskor ba'i grong khyer tshad ldan gcig gi grong mi'i grangs su longs pa re'i dbang du byas pas grong de tsam bse ba tshegs su stongs pa ste/ de yang rgya gar gyi grong khyer re re la yang mi grong khri phrag mang —39—

po'am/ 'bum phrag bgrang pa yod do/ /yang rtag tu rjes su 'brang ba'i 'khor stong dang bzhi brgya ni/ dngos grub kyi rnam grangs re re thob pa 'ba' zhig ste/ de'i phyed bdun brgya ni dgos pa yod na mi rnams la ston par byed la/ de yang sprul pas ston par byed kyi lus dngos mis mthong ba min no/ /gzhan gnas skabs thams cad du mis mi mthong ba'i phyir mi snang ba'i 'khor zhes grags la/ phyed lhag ma bdun brgya ni/ shing lham dang /gter gyi bum pa dang / ral gri dang / gnod sbyin mo la sogs pa dngos grub gzhan thob kyang mi snang ba ma bsgrubs pas/ lus dngos de nyid mi rnams kyis mthong ba'i phyir/ snang ba'i 'khor zhes bya/ 'di dag kyang 'dod na lus sbas pa'i mi snang ba ni yod do/ /rnal 'byor pho mo bdun cu rtsa gnyis su grags pa ni/ gnas chen thams cad du yid kyis bsams pa kho nas bgrod cing / slob dpon chen po nyid dang rig pa'i brtul zhugs lhan cig tu spyod pa'i grogs yin pa dang / slob dpon nyid dang rtogs pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs so zhes grags so/ /stong bzhi brgya po rnams rtogs pa mnyam par ma nges kyang /slob dpon chen po skad cig gis yul chen rnams su 'byon pa na/ lhan cig tu rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro bar nus shing / rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyod pa'ang yin no/ /grong khyer bcu gsum gyi mi rnams rnal 'byor par gyur pa la/ rnal 'byor pa 'bum sde bcu gsum zhes grags te/ 'phags yul gyi sa phyogs thams cad nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i gsang sngags pa rnal 'byor pho mos khyab pa ltar gyur te/ rab kyis mchog 'grub pa dang / gzhan mang pos thun mong gi dngos grub mchog 'bring tha ma ci rigs pa 'grub pa dang / tha ma rnams kyis kyang ting nge 'dzin sna re ma thob pa dang / phra mo sna re ma grub pa med skad do/ /yang bshad pa/ spyir grub pa'i slob dpon rnams kyis bstan bcos mdzad pa ni/—40—

do ha mgur du bzhes pa kho na mang / sgrub thabs che chung dang dbang chog dang / rdzogs rim gyi gzhung che ba'am/ chung ba mdzad pa'ang ci rigs pa yod pa der gda'/ 'grel ṭīka gi rigs sogs bshad chos mang po dang / dgag sgrub mang po'i rtsod chos dang / sgra sogs tha snyad kyi gtsug lag gi rigs ni/ grub thob dngos kyis gsungs pa cher mi 'byung la/ de 'dra'i rigs grub thob des mdzad do zer ba na/ slob dpon de dang de'i gsung rgyun nam bzhed srol bskyang ba'i phyir du phyis brtsams pa ste/ de dang de'i lugs yin pas lugs srol de slob dpon des mdzad ces pa'i don yin gyi/ dngos su ni paṇ+ḍi ta dag gis brtsams pa'o/ /des na grub thob kyi rtsom pa rnams dpe tshogs tshen po'i rigs can nyung ngo / /slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa la he ru kas lung bstan pa/ gang las rnam pa drug gi ngag tshig dpyod gsal ba/ /zhes 'byung ba dang / sngar bod du grags pa ltar na/ gzhung drug rtsoms shig ces lung bstan pa'i gzhung drug gi ngos 'dzin la/ slob dpon ku sa la bha dra chung ba na re/ dang po bsam gtan gzhud yin te/ /ye shes kyi ni de bzhin gnyis/ /gsum pa rig pa'i brtul zhugs te/ /gzhan la gsang sngags spyin byed pa/ /bzhi pa yin te gzhud gi rim/ /de bzhin rab 'byams rtog pa ni/ /blo ldan rnams kyis lnga bar bshad/ /gang yang dam pa'i don gsal ba/ /rnal ma'i sbyor ba drug pa ste/ slob dpon gyis ni de rab bstan/ /nyi shus lhag pa'i brgya phrag gi /rab tu sbyor ba bdag gis mthong / zhes 'chad de/ dang po bskyed rim/ gnyis pa dbang gi ye shes/ gsum pa spyod pa/ bzhi pa dbang chog lnga pa las tshogs/ drug pa rdzogs rim ste don sde tshan drug ston pa'i gzhung drug yin gyi/ spyi do ha phra mo sogs bstan bcos mtha' dag sdom pa la/ brgya —41—

dang nyi shu tsam khong rang gis gzigs gsung ngo / /yang 'phros don 'di go dgos te/ rdo rje'i glu bya ba dngos su rgyud las gsungs pa'i glu kho na la 'jog kyang grub thob yin nges rnams kyi nyams shar thol byung gi do ha rnams la'ang rjes mthun gyi dbang las rdo rje'i glu zhes zer bar snang ba'ang mi 'gal lo/ /yang jo bo nā ro pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa ni/dpal 'khor lo sdom pa nyid kyi bkas gnang ba'i phyir 'khor lo sdom pa kho na'i dgongs 'grel drug yin mod/ 'on kyang cha shas phra mo tsam nas rtsi dgos pa ma yin pas gzhud gi gtso po drug go /de yang dbang chog dang / sgrub thabs dang / sbyin sreg dang / dpyid kyi thig le dang / rim pa bzhi pa dang / gsang ba'i de kho na nyid de drug go gsung ngo / /da lta bod na yod pa'i spyin sreg gi cho ga 'di/ slob dpon chen po'i gsung dngos ma yin par/mar do lo tsā ba bzhed pa ni de bzhin yin te/ sngon slob dpon gyis sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhig mdzad kyang / bar skabs su dpe nub pas phyis rjes 'brang gi slob dpon gzhan gyis de'i tshab tu rtsams pa'o/ /dper na slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes kyis kyang / lung dang mthun pa'i chos bcu bzhi mdzad/ de'i nang na dbang chog yod kyang kha che'i yul du khyer nas dpe nub pas/ de'i dod du mar me mdzad kyis bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa brtsams pa lta bu'o/ /yang paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra ni/ gzhung drug ces pa rdzogs rim gyi gzhung ste/ sdom pa bshad pa/ snying po bsdus pa/ phyag rgya thig le rnam kyang bgrangs nas/ sdoms/ drug gi tha snyad mdzad do/ /'on kyang gzhung phyi ma gsum po de slob dpon chen po 'dis mdzad pa min pas/ gzhung drug la bgrong pa mi 'thad mod/ nag po pa'i rjes 'brang gi chos skor ngo mtshar can ni yin te/ mdzad pa po yang slob dpon grub thob spyod chung ba nyid do/ /spyir slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa'i bsnyan bcos gzhan mang po yod pa ni bden no/ /yang sngar —42—

pham thing pa mal lo sogs nas brgyud pa'i lo rgyus la/ bha ṅga lar rgyal po rol ba'i zla ba 'dul bar byon pa'i skabs de'i sngon du/ yul dbus nas shar phyogs la 'byon pa'i lam ka rnams su/ rdo rje phag mo mdze mo'i rnam pa dang / shing thog bsrung ba'i bu mor sprul pa dang / dpal he ru ka thod mkhan dang / glog dar mkhan du sprul pas spyod pa'i dus ma yin zhes bzlog pa dang / bha ṅga la phebs nas rgyal blon gyis bris sku la zhag bdun mchod pa'i bar der/ slob dpon dur khrod du tshogs 'khor la byon pa na/ tirti ka ste mu stegs pa'i tshul mi sngon po thod pa 'dzin pa cig byung nas/ ngas tshogs dpon byed zer ba la khyod kyis mi drang byas pas/ de dpal he ru kar gyur nas nam mkha' la 'phags te/mdze mo de yang mdze mo ma yin rdo rje phag mo'i rnam 'phrul te/ zhing rmod de yang zhing rmod ma yin he ru ka yi rnam sprul lo/ /bu mo de yang bu mo ma yin rdo rje phag mo'i rnam sprul lo/ /klog mkhan de yang klog mkhan ma yin he ru ka yi rnam 'phrul lo/ /thod pa can yang thod pa can min he ru ka yi sprul pa'o/ /tshe 'dir mchog min gzhung drug rtsoms shig bar dor mchog gi dngos grub thob/ /ces gsungs pa la/ slob dpon gyis/ khyod kyi zhabs gnyis mnyam par mnan na 'og gi klu yang 'jig 'gyur zhes te thugs rjes zhabs g.yon bskum par mdzad/ /dbu yi gtsug tor drang por bsrangs na tshangs pa'i 'jig rten 'jig 'gyur zhes te dbu ni cung zad yo bar gnas/ khyod kyi phyag rnams drang por bsrangs na phyogs skyong rnams kyang skrag 'gyur zhes te thugs rjes phyag rnams cung zad bskum/ /rje btsun khyod kyi sku yi gar ni dgos pa dang ldan mthong bas dad de mchog tu gus pas 'dud/ /ces bstod pas mi snang bar gyur/ ces zer bar snang / tshig bcad rting ma 'di rgya gar ba'i ngag sgros cig yin par 'dug bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs —43—

par byed pa'i tshig snga ma drug bo rnams bod tshig tu gsal/ sngar bshad mdze mo sogs kyis de bī ko ṭar bgrod pa las bzlog pa yin na mi 'gal mod kyang / brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa las bzlog pa ni mi bden te/ grub pa'i slob dpon mchog gi bkas gnang nas/yi dam mam mkha' 'gros bzlog pa ni 'gal zhing / ci ste bzlog dgos kyang / spyod pa la ma zhugs pa'i sngon rol nas bzlog pa 'os kyi/ skabs der spyod pa spyad nas yun ring lon zin pa la bzlog kyang dgos pa med pa'i phyir ro/ /thod mkhan dang / klog mkhan dang / thod pa can rnams kyi lo rgyus 'di sgrub pa po gzhan la byung ba yin gyi/ slob dpon 'di'i lo rgyus min no/ /yang bshad pa/ spyir dngos grub chen po khyad par can brnyes pa'i grub thob rnams/ grub pa'i sa de brnyes phyin chad/ yi dam lhag pa'i lha thams cad 'grub pa yin la/ rgyud thams cad kyi dgongs pa'ang rtogs pa yin pas/ lha so so dang rgyud so rbe'i phyogs rigs su bcad pa mi 'byung bas/ slob dpon 'di yang lha dang rgyud kun gyi bdag po yin mod kyi/ sngon dngos grub ma thob pa'i dus/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa nyid kyi sgrub pa po yin cing / phyis dngos grub brnyes nas kyang bstan bcos mdzad pa grags che ba rnams/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i dgongs 'grel shas che bas 'di nyid rgyud de'i lugs la grub pa thob pa yin par thams cad 'dod pa mthun/ de'i steng du lhag chos la/ rgya gar ba'i dgyes rdor ba rnams dang / gsang 'dus pa rnams dang / gshin rje gshed nag po mkhan rnams kyang rgyud de dang de'i sgrub pa po yin no zhes/ slob dpon 'di la su thob kyi tshul du byed mod kyi/ don la de thams cad yin pas 'gal ba med de/ rgyud de dag gi chos rgyun la/ slob dpon 'di bzhugs pa'ang mang du yod cing / gzhan yang mahā mā ya'i —44—

dkyil chog rim pa gsal ba dang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dkyil chog sa ra has mdzad par grags pa sogs kyang slob dpon 'di'i rjes 'brang gi gzhung yin par dngos su grub pas mtshon te mtha' yas par dag go /slob dpon 'di'i slob ma sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan pa dag gi dang po/ e ya la pa ni/ slob dpon chen po yul dza lan+ta ra nas spyod pa la mi 'byon tsam gyi dus shig rgyal po zhig gi glang po che skyong ba'i bu gcig rnal 'byor pa byas shing bsgoms pas/ mi ring bar lus shin tu yang ba thob ste/ zhabs sa la mi reg par gshegs so/ /phal cher bla ma'i phyag g.yog tu yod pa'i ngang nas rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad de/ yang phyis sdom pa'i rgyud las bshad pa'i las kyi phyag rgya chen po grub ste/ de'i rtags su yul gyi bud med ngan ma mang po dag la ye shes phab cing bsgrubs pas thams cad gzugs dang skal ba mchog dang ldan cing 'bar snang can du song / de 'dra brgya nyi shus tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor yang byas/ yang yul a la ka na log lta'i rgyal po ma hu ba zer ba cig gi sar byon/ khyed kyi chos la yid ches ci yod zer/khyod nyid gang 'dod byas pas/ gser la dga' zer/ slob dpon 'dis snod chen po gcig nam mkha' la bzed pas gser gyis gang / rgyal po de ya mtshan skyes nas chos la zhugs so/ /phyis slob dpon spyod pa ba taX ba la'i yul du bzhugs dus gcig phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob ste 'ja' lus su gyur to/ /'di ni dpyid kyi thig le kho na bsgoms pas grub pa thob pa'o/ /gnyis pa ma hi la pa ni/ yul ni ma la bar 'khrungs zer/ rigs dmangs rigs lus stobs shin tu che ba zhig yod de/ lag pa ya ris go yu dang / na ri ke la'i shing sdong rtsa ba nas 'byin nus zer/ der skye bo thams cad lus stobs kyis pham par byed pa cig 45—

yod pa las/ lan cig slob dpon spyod pa pa las zhig la phebs pa la/ lus stobs 'gran no byas nas 'ongs pa na slob dpon gyi phyag g.yon pa'i sor mo gcig reg pas/khong gi lus stobs thams cad nyams te der 'gyil lo/ /de nas nga rgyal chag ste rnal 'byor pa byas/ kha zas nyung dza'i dka' thub spyad de/ lo bcu gnyis 'khor lo sdom pa bsgoms pas mchog gi dngos grub nyams 'og tu chud/ yul so ra : ra mu stegs kyi gnas cig na bram ze dang kun tu rgyu lnga brgya tsam yod pa la/ der byon nas slong mo byas pas de rnams kyis bzhad gad byed cing 'phya'o/ /der ni tra a bo li zhes pa ste gnyid shog cig pa lan mang du gsungs pas/ de rnams thams cad gnyid du song / zhag bdun gyi bar du ma sad do/ /der gzhan rnams kyis nus pa dkrol bar zhus pas/ phyag se gol gtog pas thams cad gnyis sad do/ /de nas ngo mtshar skyes nas de rnams slob dpon ma hi la'i zhabs la gtugs/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs shing / de dag gi nang nas dngos grub thob pa yang mang du byung ngo / /gsum pa dha ma pa ni/ yul mahā mun ba/ dang po bram ze'i rigs mang du thos pa zhig yin/ de nas slob dpon gyi drung du byon bla mas kyang dbang bskur zhing rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ 'dis thog ma bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed zhal gzigs/ nus pa cung zad thob nas slob dpon spyod 'chang dbang po'i 'phral gyi rim gro pa mdzad/ bla ma phan tshun du gshegs shing bzhud pa na/ dha mā ma ste rnga zlum brdung ba po yun ring du mdzad pas dha ma par grags so/ /de nas yun ring zhig lon pa na/ lan cig bsgom zhing bzhugs pa'i dus/ rang gi mdun du thod pa dkar tser re ba cig byung / de phyag tu blangs pa na de'i nang na mi gtsang ba ljan ljin sna tshogs kyis gang ba 'dra ba zhig 'dug rnam rtog med par —46—

de gsol bas/ rtsig pa la thogs pa med pa dang / dpag tshad brgya phrag mang po yud tsam gyis bgrod nus pa byung / phyis phyag rgya chen po mchog 'grub bo/ /bzhi pa dhu ma pa ni/ yul skad du shar phyogs ra ra zer/ legs sbyar skad du ra dha'i yul te der 'khrungs/ rigs ni tshong dpon gyi bu yin/ gnas gzhi cig tu rab tu byung nas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rnal 'byor ba zhig la dbang zhug nas bsgom zhing 'dug go /slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rje 'khor bcas lam la 'byon pa mthong nas/ dad pa skyes nas phyi bzhin 'brangs so/ /lan cig slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal du phyin pas/khyod kyis spyan ras gzigs bsgoms sam gsung / bsgoms zhus pas/ 'o na zhal blta bar 'dod dam gsung / 'dod zhus pas/ 'o na 'di la ltos zhes mdzub mos ston par mdzad de/ bltas pas nam mkhar 'phags pa lha lnga 'od lam me mthong / shin tu dga' bas bro 'khrabs/ zhag mang por ting nge 'dzin thun gcig la gnas pa byung / de sad tsa dzu / rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub thob skad/ 'di yang slob dpon chen po'i rim gro pa go re long byas te/ rnga pa ṭa ha brdung ba dang / 'bud dkrol gyi bya ba mang du mdzad pas/ rol mo'i sgra las brtags te mtshan dhu ma par grags/ 'di rdo rje bdag med ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pas mchog thob pa yin yang zer/ gang ltar rgyud dgyes rdor la brten nas grub pa thob skad/ slob dpon chen pos rgyal po go bo tsan+d+ra btul ba'i dus de tsam nas gzung /dha ma dhu ma 'di gnyis kyis lo mang po zhig tu nye gnas rim 'gro pa kho na mdzad/ lan cig o rgyan dang nye ba'i yul chung zhig na/ lta ba log pa'i rgyal po skye ba snga phyi med par 'dod pa cig yod pa la/ khong gnyis rgyal po de'i drung du phyin pas/ de na re/ skye ba snga phyi med pa la khyed rnal 'byor pa byed pa 'khrul zer/ slob dpon gnyis na re/ skye ba snga ma —47—

yod de rgyal po khyed rang skye ba snga ma zhig gdol bar skyes pa'i dus/ rabs chad pas gser yod pa rnams ri 'di'i mtshan rtags 'di lta bur sbas 'dug pa/ de thon zhigade dus kyi skye ba dran 'ong gsung / des kyang de bzhin du byas pas skye ba dran/ rgyal po de chos la bcug go /thog mar dug sprul dang / gcan gzan dang / choms po la sogs gdug pa can rnams rengs pa dang / dbang du byed pa la sogs pa'i lta stangs 'grub pa cig yin pa/ de nas phyis bha ṅga lar slob dpon chen pos rgyal po rol pa'i zla ba btul ba'i skabs shig na/ dha ma dhu ma gnyis ka 'ja' lus su gyur/ de yang thun mong tsam min mchog 'grub pa'o/ /yang phyis slob dpon chen po sku 'das dus/ de gnyis mngon sum du byung nas gdung ba'i glu dbyangs kyang blangs/ de rjes rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi mya ngan bsal ba yang byas/ skal ldan mang po la gdams ngag bstan pas/ rgyud grol ba yang mang du byung / mi rnams kyis mthong bar lo 'ga' bzhugs so/ /lnga pa bha dra pa ni/ slob ma kun gyi mchog tu gyur pa ste/ slob dpon nag po pa yul ka ling kar phebs pa'i dus/ yul de'i rgyal po'i bu gzhon nu ming bha dra zhes bya ba zhigaslob dpon 'khor bcas la lhag par dad de/ slob dpon gyi slob ma zhig dang 'grogs nas phyi bzhin du song / gru gzings la zhugs nas rnal 'byor pa mang po dang lhan cig sang gha lar song ngo / /gzhon nu des rig pa'i gnas thams cad ni sngar nas shes/ slob dpon gyi zhabs la gtugs te rjes su 'dzin par zhus pas skal ldan du mkhyen te dbang bskur zhing rjes su gdams/ dbang bskur ba tsam gyis ye shes dang ldan par gyur mod kyi/ phal cher bla ma'i drung du bzhugs shing / bla ma bsten pa'i sgo nas dka' ba spyod cing yun ring lon no/ /lan cig lam du song ba na/ mu stegs kyi rnal 'byor pa mang pos khyod —48—

slob dpon tsar+ya pa'i slob ma yin na nus pa yod dam zer/ kyal ka'i tshul du cung zad yod ces gsungs pas/ de rnams kyis rdo dang dbyug pa dang tho ba la sogs pa brgya stong bsnun pas sku lus dar bal gyi phung po 'dra ba bsgyur/ chu gri la sogs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnun tsa na rdo ngar ma dang thug pa bzhin du me stag khrom khrom pa byung / de ltar chu tshod gcig gnyis song ba na/ sngo tsam pe li zhes kyang zer/ me tog ma li ka'i sdong po cig phyag tu bsnams nas/ de rnams nyid la bsnun pas thams cad thang la ro bzhin du 'gyel te shi ba ltar song ngo / /zhag gcig lon pa gzhan rnams kyis gsol ba btab ste slar gsos so/ /dang por dbang bskur thob ma thag ye shes skyes kyang / 'di lta bu'i rtags ma bstan gyi bar du/ nus pa thob par sus kyang ma shes pas/ gu hra pa ste gsang ba pa zhes grags/ de'i go ba ni sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa'o/ /de nas mi ring ba na/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub nyam 'og tu chud pa yin/ 'on kyang re zhig bla ma bzhugs kyi bar/ mi snang bar gyur pa'i cho 'phrul ma bstan slob dpon spyod pa pa sku 'das nas/slob ma rnams kyis sa phyogs der mchod rten dang lha khang zhig kyang bzhengs so/ /de dag gi bya ba yang mi phal ba bzhin du mdzad/ de nas bla ma'i sku tshe la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gdug pa'i mkha' 'gro ma de gang na 'dug ces 'tshol bar bzhud de/ rdzu 'phrul gyis gnas chen gzhan thams cad dang / dur khrod thams cad du btsal yang ma rnyed do/ /de nas mngon shes kyis ring du brtags pas/ de bī ko ṭa'i gnas de nyid na/ si mi li zer ba'i shing zhig gi khong stong na srin 'bu la sogs lus gzhan sna tshogs su bsgyur nas yib cing sdod pa gzigs so/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin gyis sprul pa'i ral gris shing sdong de gzhags te/ mkha' 'gro ma de'i co to nas bzung ste/ phyi mi mo'i lus kyi dbyibs —49—

de ral gris dum bur gtubs nas/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams la bza' bar sbyin/sprul gzhi lha srin mo de ye shes sprul pa'i me 'od kyis bsregs te tshar bcad do/ /de nas rdo rje'i glu blangs shing / ched du brjod nas re zhig mi snang bar gyur to/ /slad kyi lo 'ga' lon pa na/ yul dza ṭa sa sgo ṭar byon/ de na rgyal po ardzu na dat+ta zer ba phyi ba cig yod/ des spyod pa pa'i slob ma mchog cig byung zer ba thos nas/ rgyang ring po nas bltas na/ sgra dang / 'od dang / sa g.yo ba dang / 'tshubs ma dang / me 'bar ba sogs kyi ban bun las ma mthong nye bar sleb pa na de'i gseb nas rnal 'byor pa cig byung ngo / /rgyal po ngo mtshar skyes/ mchod gnas mu stegs pa rnams kyis bkag kyang ma nyan par/ pho brang gi phyi rol tu song nas slob dpon gu hra pa'i zhabs la gtugs so/ /yun ring du mchod par byas shing / skabs shig 'jig rten pa'i lha khang zhig tu tshogs 'khor mdzad gsung tshogs rdzas bsnams te bzhug sgo bsdams te su yang mi gtong bar 'dug pa la/ lan cig sgo gseng cig byung / rgyal pos bltas pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' lha sum cu rtsa bdun du bzhengs par mthong skad/ der rgyal pos mthong ba dang mthun pa'i lha khang bzhengs par zhug pas/ de lta bu skal med kyi bltar mi rung bas/ bkod pa de lta bu la chags bral gyi sku bzhengs na legs gsung / gtso bo bco / pa ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shāka thub kyis mdzad pa'i lha khang cig bzhengs/ de la ming bzhi sna pa na ste/ sangs rgyas gnas gzhi zer ba yin/ yul de na lha khang gzhan thams cad mu stegs pa'i yin pas de la sangs rgyas kyi gnas gzhir thogs pa'o/ /lha khang 'di'i ngo dod da lta yang yod/ yang lan cig kha che'i yul du tu ru ska ma na zhes bya bar/ rgyal po kla klor gyur pa cig gi dmag byung ste/ kha che'i yul mtha'i mi rnams thams cad bros/ rgyal po snyen ra bcas kyis —50—

'khrugs kyang thub par dka' ba la/ slob dpon 'di nye skor na bzhugs pa la gsol ba btab pas/ ri dwags ru dra'i rwa dung zhig la sngags kyis bzlas shing byin gyis brlabs nas/ rgyal po la gtad de/ phan tshun g.yul bshams pa'i tshe/ 'bud dkrol dang lhan cig 'di bus shig gsung de nas de bzhin byas pas/ kla kle'i dmag mi mang po ni brgyal zhing myos/ phal cher ni rna ba 'on/ rta thams cad sus kyang bzung mi thub par rgyug cing bros so/ /der kla kle'i dpung rmeg med par gyur/ kha che'i rgyal po'i dmag gis yul de yang mnan te chos dbu 'phang mtho bar mdzad do/ /de skabs kyi kha che'i rgyal po ni yi de ba yin par grags/ blon po'i bu shin tu rmongs pa blo zhan pa rdul ba zhig gis/ rwa dung de blangs te 'ga' rer bus pas skad cig de la skad dang bstan bcos mtha' dag shes pa cig byung ming la swā de ra dza zer te/phyis kha che'i yul gyi klog dang yi ge dang brda sprod phal cher de la thug pa yin/ smra ba ches mkhas pa cig byung bar snang / gzhan yang slob dpon 'dis yul der/ digs pa brgya tsam la byin rlabs mdzad pas mkhas par song bar grags/ yang lan cig dpal o rgyan gyi gnas su bzhugs te/ de'i tshe o rgyan dang nye ba'i byang phyogs shig tu/ sngon med pa'i mtsho gsar ba brdol/ klu gdugs pa can o rgyan pa rnams la gnod cing / chos la sdang ba zhig byung / des rgyud bskul nas/ ma kha pa'i chom po'i 'tshe ba yang yang yong ba zhig byung ba na/ slob dpon 'dis de 'dul bar dgongs nas/ 'khor 'ga' zhig dang bcas te mtsho dang nye bar bzhugs so/ /der thog lhung ba dang / lce 'bab pa ji tsam bstan kyang / slob dpon 'khor bcas la gnod pa med par ma zad/ phyag gis blangs nas zhal du gsol lo/ /char drag po mi bzad pa'i shwa brgal khru nyi shu'i dpangs tsam byung —51 —

ngo / /'khor bcas de lta bu'i rba rlabs kyi steng du byon nas/ mtsho de'i steng du bzhugs so/ /der srog chags gdug pa can mi zad pa dpag tu med pa 'dus nas byung yang snang ba med pa la mnyam par bzhag pas/ la las ma mthong / la las mthong yang reg thogs med de/ 'ja' tshon bzhin du gyur pas ci byar yang ma byung ngo / /ji zhig ltar na/ slob dpon gyis dgongs pa brtad pas mtsho khol/ 'gram phyogs gcig gi sa sgangs rnams dral te/ chu rnams phyir pho bas ma kha ba'i rta ba mang po'ang khyer/ mtsho bskams shing / klu gdug pa can yang rdzu 'phrul nyams te grags pa med par gyur skad/ de nas lo lnga brgya tsam gyi bar du/ o rgyan du ma kha sogs yul gzhan gyi gnod pa ma byung skad/ de dag la sogs pa lo mang du 'gro ba'i don mdzad nas/ slar yang sku lus mi snang ste/ zung 'jug gi skus mkha' khyab tu bzhugs pa'o/ /slob dpon 'dis kyang 'khor lo sdom pa'i phyogs la bstan bcos ci rigs mdzad cing / dgyes rdor gyi dgongs 'brel yang cung zad mdzad do/ /spyir bde mchog snyen ra lo'i grub brnyes su kun la grags so/ /drug pa dge tshul tshim bu pa ni/ ma gha dha'i rgyal rigs kyi bu cig na la sder dge tshul byas chos kyang legs par shes pa cig yin/ slob dpon spyod 'chang dbang po yul koṅka nar bzhugs pa'i skabs shig grogs 'ga' zhig gis bskul nas gnas der song ste slob dpon dang mjal/ rjes su bzung bar zhug pas/ yang dag pa'i dbang bskur te/ gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pas skyong bzhin du lo bdun gyi bar du 'dug go /de nas nang cig sprin kha dog sna lnga pa dang / nyi ma'i 'od dang / char zim dang /'ja' tsho ni thams cad tshogs pa cig 'dug nas/ de la lta zhing lhan cig skyes pa'i don bsgoms pas de rnams sgyu ma lta bur shar/ de'i rkyen gyis yang dag pa'i ye shes phyin ci ma —52—

log pa rgyud la skyes so/ /de nas lta stangs brgyad la sogs pa yang rim pas grub/ yang lan cig drod rtags dang / mig sman la sogs pa'i dngos grub sgyu mas sgyu ma bslu ba 'dis ci phan byas ste/ lhan cig skyes pa 'ba' zhig bsgom zhing / shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa spyod do/ /de nas dus phyi zhig na slob dpon spyod pa pa 'khor bcas shar phyogs la gshegs pa'i skabs/ chu bo gang gā'i 'gram gyi lam 'phrang dog po 'dzur sa med nga cig na mdze mo lus thams cad rnag khrag dang rma shus gang / sor mo rnams chad pa cig 'dug go /de na re khyed rnams kyis nga chu bo 'di las bsgral nas grong khyer zhig gi 'dabs su skyol zer yang g.yin rnams kyis len mkhan ma byung / der tshim bu pas rgyab tu khur te/ chu bo gang gā la rkyal zhing song / gang ga'i dbus su sleb pa tsam na/ mdzi mo de rdo rje phag mo'i sku'i rnam par dngos su gyur te/ tshim bu pa'ang bde mchog he ru ka'i rnam pa 'dzin par gyur pa/ rdo rje phag mos tshom bu pa'i phyag nas khrid de nam mkha' la 'phags so/ /der rnal 'byor pa gzhan rnams la/ rdo rje phag mo'i zhal nas/ rnal 'byor pa bya ba snying rje dang ldan pa dgos pa yin/ de med par dngos grub ga la thob gsung /tshul des tshim bu pa mkha' spyod du bzhud do/ /'di bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi le'u so bdun pa nas/ ha har rgod pa'i dngos grub tu bshad pa de yin par snang bas/ de dus dngos su thun mong gi dngos grub chen po yin yang / de nas mi ring par mchog dngos su 'grub pa'o/ /slob dpon 'di sngon dge tshul yin pas/ dge tshul tshom bu pa zer yang / phyis cha byed rnal 'byor pa ka yin par 'dug tshim bu'i go ba ni phyags dar khrod gyon pa'i ming yin/ kha cig ma.ā+oṃ dngos ma ṇi bha dra sti nor bu bzang po bya ba yin zer ro/ /slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa'i do he'i rigs ni ci rigs pa yod/ gzhan des mdzad pa'i bstan —53—

bcos dang / chos rgyun gyi rigs ni cher ma byung ba 'dra zhing / rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa'i lo rgyus kyang / spyir mang du yod dgos kyang gzhan ma rnyed do/ /de ltar slob ma drug po de dag ni/ slob dpon chen po nyid dang lhan cig tu rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa spyad pas mchog thob pa'o/ /slob dpon chen po ka sna pa'i slob ma bud med grub pa thob pa la/ slob dpon chen po lto phyogs mahā mā9/ byon pa'i dus/ yul de na rgyal rigs kyi bu mo sprun gnyis las che ba'i ming ni me kha la zhes bya/ chung ba'i ming ni ka na kha la'o/ /de gnyis lo bcu'am brgyad lon pa na/ bram ze'i khye'u gnyis dang gnyen du bsgrigs yod kyang / khye'u de gnyis ches gzhon pas lo 'gar bag ma la ma song ba na/ yul mi thams cad kyi de dag la kha zer bar byed do/ /de yang las kyi mthu yin gyi nyes pa ni med skad/ de nas mdun ma de dral lo/ /slob dpon 'khor bcas rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul ba can mthong pas/ yid la ya mtshan cher skyes nas/ bdag cag 'khor ra bas 'jigs pa lags kyi/ 'khordo ra ba las thar ba'i thabs cig 'tshal zhus pas/ snod dang ldan par mkhyen te dbang bskur bas ye shes mchog phebs/ gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pas bskyangs pa na/ mi ring bar lta stangs brgyad la sogs pa'i nus pa yang thob/ rtsig pa dang / ri dang / chu la thogs pa med/ mngon shes la sogs pa'i yon tan mang po thob bo/ /de nas kyang tshogs pa de nyid du gtso bor gnas shing / rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa can no/ /lan cig de gnyis lam du song ba na/ go rak+ta'i rjes 'brang rnal 'byor pa phal pa mang po lam na 'dug pa rnams kyis co 'dri zhing / nag po pa slob mar bcas pa sgyu ma ston par byed do zhes smra ba la/ dzo gir grags pa de rnams nyid kyi gnas gzhis phyogs yid du 'ong ba —54—

cig na 'dug pa las khang pa thams cad lta stangs kyis drangs nas ma zhig pa kho nar bye ma'i thang skya bo yid du mi 'ong pa la bzhag go khyed rnams kyang sgyu ma 'di lta bu gyis shig byas nas song ngo / /de nas dus gzhan zhig na de dag gis bzod pa gsol bas/ khang pa rnams sngar gyi gnas su bskyal lo/ /phyis slob dpon chen pos bha sge lar/ rgyal po rol pa'i zla ba btul ba'i dus skabs shig na skye bo mang po 'dus pa'i dbus shig tu de gnyis slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas bla ma'i drin gyis bdag cag gnyis kyis don chen po bla na med pa thob pa lags pas/ da ni mkha' spyod du 'gro na/ thog mar slob dpon gyis gang bka' stsol ba de bgyid zhus pas/ 'o na mgo bo bcad de nga la phul zhig gsung / der ye shes kyi ral gri rno ngar dang ldan pa re kha nas byung ste/ rang rang gi mgo bo thogs pa med par bcad de bla ma'i phyag tu phul nas/ phyi ltas su gar byed cing nam mkha'i lam las je mtho sde mthor song nas 'ja' 'od du yal lo/ /sngon lha mo dpal gyi blo gros las kyang 'di dag dang 'dra pa'i cho 'phrul bstan 'dug /srin po dang mkha' 'gro ma phal pa'i gzugs la yang / 'di lta bu mang du yod pa yin 'dug /de'i gnyen por rdo rje phag mo dbu bcad ma sogs 'gyung ba ltar/ rdo rje phag mo'i grub thob rnams kyi cho 'phrul la yang / 'di 'dra mang dag byung par gda' 'o/ /slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i slob ma bud med kyi rten can grub pa thob pa thams cad kyi mchog rnal 'byor ma brnye pa'am/sing gha gling gi rnal 'byor ma'am/ ḍom+bi rnal 'byor mar grags pa de ni/ gling khyad par du 'phags pa sing gha lar/ toX pa zhes pa rigs ngan g.yung po'i rigs la bu mo zhig btsas pa ni pad+ma can mchog gi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa zhig go /cher skyes pa na blo gsal zhing rig pa dang ldan pa dang tshul bzang ba zhig yod pas yi ge sogs rig pa —55—

kun yang byang ngo / /slob dpon spyod ri/ kla 'khor bcas gling der phebs nas mi ring ba zhig na/ de rnams kyis ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos mthong ste/ shin tu dad par gyur kyang / rigs kyi dbang gis chos spyod pa'i skal ba med snyam pa dang / 'di dag dang nye bar yang mi nus snyam tsa na/ rnal 'byor pa kha cig /'di na rigs dang rigs min med/ /'gro ba 'di dag thams cad la/ /rang byung ye shes yang dag gnas/ /de phyir kun la brnyas mi bya/ /zhes sogs glur len pa thos pas rang nyid chos kyi skal ba yod par shes nas/ mchog tu dga' ba skyes so/ /de nas lan cig slob dpon 'khor dang bcas pa mchod ston rgya chen ngo/sa tshims par byas nas/ yang dag pa'i lam stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas zhal gyis bzhes so/ /de nas dus gcig na slob dpon 'khor bcas dur khrod cig tu bzhugs pa'i sar/ phag gi sha gcig dang myos byed bum pa gang khyer te phul pas/ tshogs rdzas de kho nas rnal 'byor pho mo stong phrag mang po 'byung po dang thams cad tshims par mdzad de ḍom+bi ni la dbang bskur bas/ de nyid du ye shes mchog dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor ma chen mor gyur/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo de yang zhag bdun gyi bar du zad pa med par longs spyad do/ /de nas dpyid kyi thig le'i rnal 'byor 'bad pas bsgoms pas/ dus ji zhig ltar na/ nyin zhag bdun du sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba shin tu mi bzad pa'i nyams lus brgya stong du 'thor pa 'dra ba byung / des gtum mo 'bar ba'i me tshad rdogs/ rtsa mdud thams cad zhig ste lhan cig skyes pa'i don ji bzhin du rtogs nas/ ting nge 'dzin thun gcig la zla ba drug 'das skad/ de sad tsa na grub pa'i dbang phyug mar gyur te/ yang dag pa lhan cig skyes pa'i don rtogs pas/ zhor byung gi yon tan gzugs bsgyur ba'i cho 'phrul dang / dpag tshad brgya stong du 'jug pa'i mngon shes dang /—56—

lta stangs la sogs pa'i nus pa dang / rkang mgyogs la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul rnams kyang rang shugs la thob bo/ /de nas yun ring po'i bar du slob dpon wo po'i 'khor gyi tshogs pa der bzhugs nas rtag tu tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'byung ba'i tshogs kyi gtso mo'i bya ba bsgrubs pas rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad do/ /de nas phyi zhig na 'ja' lus brnyes shing bar skabs der mi snang par gyur pa las/ slob dpon spyod pa pa'i 'das mchod kyi dus mngon sum du byon te/ sa g.yo ba la sogs pa cho 'phrul du ma bstan de skabs yul ka ma rū par/ lha khyab 'jug chen po rta'i gdong can gyi rdo sku khru gang pa cig rang byung du byung / cho 'phrul shin tu che/ ha ri gi ri mā tho zhes grags shing / phyogs der de la mchod pa po bram ze cho 'phrul can sngags grub pa mang pos kyang bskor nas yod/ der sangs rgyas pa'i phyogs 'dzin pa rnams la/ 'bog nad gdong thug mang po dang / me lce 'bab pas gnas khang dang yo byad sreg pa sogs gnod pa mang du byung zhing /skye bo gzhan rnams la yang gnod pa cher byung ngo / /skabs der de byung nas lo mang ma lon pa'i skabs yin/ de 'dul bar rnal 'byor ma 'dis byon/ lam du cho 'phrul gyi rta ba mang po mtshon cha thogs te byung / yi dam gyi phyag mtshan gri gug cig yod pa de/ phyar ba tsam gyis de rnams thams cad sil bur zhig go /de nas lha khang de'i drung du byon pa na/lha de khros pas phyi nang thams cad tu me 'bar bar bstan pas/ rnal 'byor mas de nyid du char chen po phab kyang zer/ sngags kyis btab kyang zer/ mi bskyod pas gtor yang zer/ gang ltar yang de ma thag me shi'o/ /de nas nang du byon pa na sku de nyid rta gdong khros pa mi bzad pa 'jigs pa'i cho 'phrul can du song nas/ za za 'cha' 'cha' ltar rgol du byung / bram ze sngags mkhan rnams kyang srin po mi gdug pa'i gzugs su bsgyur te/—57—

mtshon cha sna tshogs dang / dbyug pa dang / rdo ba chen po dag brdeg tu byung ngo / /der rnal 'byor mas thugs g.yo ba med par thal mo brdabs pas/ khyab 'jug gi sku de'i sku gzugs ma de thal bar zhig rta mgo sa la lhung / bram ze rnams khrag tu skyug cing 'gyel lo/ /de dang nye ba na spyod pa khyab 'jug de nyid lhar 'dzin pa'i mi thams cad kyang myos shing rod rod bor song ngo / /de'i lha khang dang gnas gzhi thams cad kyang la la rtsa ba nas zhig /la la shag shig tu song ngo / /de ltar nyin zhag gnyis 'das pa na/ rgyal po la sogs pa skye bo rnams 'ongs te/ zhabs la gtugs nas gso bar zhug so/ /der bram ze la sogs pa'i skye bo rang rod du gyur pa rnams gsos so/ /de rjes rnal 'byor ma brnye pa yul de'i u ma gi ri zer ba'i ri la bzhugs nas/ skal ldan rnams la chos cung zad ston no/ /de nas mu stegs de rnams kyis kho rang tsho'i gnas zhig pa rnams gsos/ ha ri gi ri mā tho'i sku 'dra bzhengs pa na/ bzhengs pa'i bya ba dang / zhal bsro byed pa la glang po che rgyugs pas thams cad bcom mo/ /yang bskyar nas bzhengs zin pa na/ khyim rdib ste zhig go /yang bzhengs zin pa na dum bur gas te rang zhig go /de nas rgyal po dang skye bo de dag dang bram ze de rnams kyang rnal 'byor ma'i drung du 'ongs te/ rin po che du mas sku la gtor zhing bzod par gsol nas sems can rang rang gi lugs 'dor bar mi nus pas/ thugs brtse bar mdzode ces lha khang bzhengs par gnang ba zhus/ phyis khong rnams kyis lha khang bzhengs pa na 'jigs pa ni ma byung / 'on kyang dus de nas gzung ste yul phyogs der lha khyab 'jug la mchod pa ni nyung ngo / /de rjes kyang yul sna tshogs su skal ldan 'ga' re smin cing grol ba la bkod de lo yang ci rigs par mi rnams kyis mthong bar bzhugs par grags so/ /'dis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thor bu dang / do hā 'ga' —58—

re da lta'ang yod do/ /de dag ni slob dpon spyod pa pa nyid sku bzhugs pa'i skabs nyid du mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i slob ma/ skyes pa'i rten can drug dang / bud med gsum ste shin tu grags che ba rnams yin no/ /gzhan slob dpon bha dā li pa ni/ shar phyogs bha ga lar 'khrungs pa/ slob dpon spyod pa pa yul dza lan+ta ra nas spyod pa la 'byon khar sleb zer/ phyis slob dpon sku 'das pa'i rjes su/ shar phyogs o ḍi bi shi'i yul du bzhugs/ der tshong dpon zhig gis dge 'dun la sa gzhi phul te/ gtsug lag khang zhig rtsig pa'i grabs byas pa na/ sa phyogs de dang po nas mu stegs rnams dbang zer nas/ nang pa'i gtsug lag khang bzheng du mi ster te/ slad kyis rgyal po la zhus nas/ bram ze zhig gis der mu stegs byed kyi lha khang ling ga can chung ngu zhig brtsigs so/ /yang slad kyis dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan gyis rtsod pa bslangs te/ phyi nang gi skye bo mang po der 'dus/ der slob dpon bha dwa li byon te/ re zhig rtsod pa 'di ma zhi'i bar du lha khang 'di pha gir bskyal lags kyi byas/ lha khang de thag pas 'ching tshul byas rgyab khur du thogs nas/ bram ze de rnams nyid kyi grong gi 'dabs su bskyal lo/ /der grub pa'i rtags la ya mtshan skyes te/ sa phyogs der rang shugs kyis dge 'dun la byung nas/ aX k+ṣa sna pa na zhes bya ba'i gtsug khang brtsigs so/ /'dis kyang phyis phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub brnyes par grags so/ /grub thob la bā yi pa ni/ gong du smos pa ltar yang yin la/ phyis ma ga dhar rnal 'byor pa nus pa cung zad thob pa mang po 'dus nas/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bsgrubs pa'i tshogs 'khor byed par byas/ slob dpon la bā yi pas tshogs kyi gtso bo byed par khas blangs so/ /der tshogs kyi khang par zhugs tsa na/ mu stegs can mdog —59—

nag po dbang phyug pa'i cha byad 'dzin pa/ u tsi gi pa ste gtsang sme med pa'i spyod pa can thod pa thogs pa cig byung nas tshogs dpon ngas byed zer ro/ /der slob dpon gyis khyed mu stegs pas nged sangs rgyas pa'i tshogs dpon mi rung byas pas/ 'o na khyod rang tshogs kyi gtso bo'i khri la 'dzegs zer/ khri'i dpangs khru do tsam yod pa de'i rtsar song na/ khri de mtho ru ma song / slob dpon gyi lus chung du ma song yang / slob dpon gyi lus kyis khri de'i bzhi cha tsam las ma sleb/ thabs gzhan gang gis kyang khri'i steng du 'gro bar ma nus so/ /de nas thod pa can de sprul pa'i sku yin par shes nas/ slob dpon la bā yi pas nyes pa bshags shing gsol ba btab pas/ de dpal he ru kar gyur te nam mkhar bzhugs nas/ khyod kyi dang po nyid nas nga rgyal spangs te gsol ba btab na da res ka 'dod pa'i dngos grub thob pa la nga rgyal gyis nyes/ da sems can gyi don gyis zer mi snang bar gyur/ de nas slob dpon 'dir grong khyer a dzo ju ru byon/ de na lta ba log pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po bi dz+nya sti zer ba zhig yod/ de 'dul ba la dgongs nas/ yul de'i phyogs gcig brag cig gi khong na/ phug pa khong stong cung zad yod pa la/ bu ga sor brgyad tsam gyi tshad can brag srab thug khru brgyad tsam yod pa la bu ga de dod pa cig yin/de min sgo med pa'i brag gi khong seng der bzhugs/rgyal po de'i blon po dang nang g.yog 'ga' zhig gis don 'dra spyod pa'i lam du der song tsa na/ phug pa'i sgo shin tu yangs pa dang / phug pa de yang shin tu che bar 'dug cing / zas nor sna tshogs pa'i dbus na rnal 'byor pa de 'dug par mthong ngo / /de dag gis rgyal po la bsnyad pas nang par rgyal po lings la 'gro ba'i tshul gyis der bltar 'ongs pa na/ slob dpon phyir byon te rgyal po wo po 'dir cis kyang 'byon par zhu —60—

gsung / der phug gi sgo yangs ba'i 'du shes kyis 'khor 'ga' dang bcas pa zhugs shing / bza' bstung gya nom pa mang pos tshims par byas so/ /de nas rgyal blon gnyis 'dug g.yog de phyir song ba'i skabs shig slob dpon gyis cho 'phrul bsdus pas khong gnyis phug pa dog mo der chud/ phyi rol tu 'gro sa'i sgo med cing / bu ga phra mo de'i phyogs kyang brag shin tu 'thug par shes/ ya mtshan yang skyes la shin tu skrag go /de nas slob dpon gyis de gnyis sngar gyi lta ba log pa de spangs/ dge ba byed par dam 'cha' ru bcug nas brag gi bu ga chung ngu de nas ka gnod pa med par phyir bton no/ /rnam 'phrul de lta bu bstan pas rgyal po de chos la bkod pa'o/ /rgyal po rol ba'i zla ba dang / blon po dge ba'i mgon po'i gto rgyud kyi 'phros ni/ rgyal blon gnyis kas nyin mo ni rgyal srid kyi bya ba chos bzhin du skyod/ mtshan thog thag ni rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa las/ lo 'ga' zhig 'das par gyur pa na/ blon po la dngos su tsan+d+ra li 'bar ba'i gsal snang byung / dang por khyim nye 'khor dang bcas pa rtsig pa sogs kyis sgrib thogs med cing / nyin mtshan kun tu mthong / de nas rim pas rgyang grags tsam dang / dpag tshad tsam dang / go ra'i yul tsam yang mthong mi ring bar mtha' med du 'phel lo/ /de bzhin du sgra skad thams cad kyang thos shing shes/sngar ma thos pa'i bstan bcos thams cad kyang rang shes nas/ lan cig rgyal po'i drung du phyogs kyi rgyal po mang po'i 'phrin yig dus gcig tu 'dzom/ 'phrin yig de dag yul so so'i paṇ+ḍi tas brtsams pa/ sdebs sbyor dang snyan ngag gis bcings pas go dka' zhing /skad rigs dang yig rigs tha dad pa dang / lta grub tha dad pa'i shis brjod mi 'dra ba du ma yod pas/ yig mkhan dang / mdun na 'don bram ze paṇ+ḍita mang po 'dus te dpyad —61—

kyang / shin tu go dka' bar gyur pa la/ blon pos de dag thams cad bkrol zhing don rgyas par bshad/ lan rnams kyang so so dang mthun par byas pas rgyal po dang 'khor rnams na re/ sngar khyod kyis 'di lta bu shes su mi bsha' pa la/ 'di ltar yod pa ci yin dris pas/ ngas na ning bar la bslabs pa yin zhes kha bsgyur ro/ /de nas mi ring ba zhig na nam phyed cig gnyid du song ba'i gnyid sad pa na/ bud med rgan mo ches mi sdugs pa/mdze skyas thebs pa cig gshed nas langs nas/ mkhar ba la brten cing blon po'i mdun du 'ongs nas/ bkres so zhes zer ro/ /de bcom ldan 'das ma'i rnam 'phrul du shes nas/ tsham tshom med par phyag byas nas/ bza' btung 'bru bcud gya noms pa thams cad phul/ bdag rjes su gzung bar zhu zhug pas/ des phyag spyi bor ba theg cing byin gyis rlob rlob ltar mdzad nas/ blon po nyid kyi spyi bor thim pa snyam byed pa na mi snang bar gyur skad/ der gnas lugs kyang rjes su rtogs/ phra mo rnams dang / dngos grub sna tshogs nyams 'og tu chud pa'i grub thob tu gyur kyang / re zhig sbas te tha mal ba'i tshul gyis rgyal srid kyi bya ba byed cing / mi rnams kyi bsam pa dang skal ba shes pa'i sgo nas spyod do/ /lan cig rgyal po'i drung du yod pa la/rang gi skyed mos tshal gyi lha khang na/ 'o ma dang zho dag yod pa la/ byi la 'ga' zhig gis bldag pa mthong nas/ yengs tshul gyis de skrod pa'i brda byas so/ /rgyal pos ci yin dris —pas/ dus la bab par shes nas/ rang gi dngos grub thob tshul rnams bshad/ de nas blon po'i bya ba bor te rnal 'byor pa'i spyod pas bzhugs shing sems can gyi don mdzad/mthar phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob par grags so/ /grub thob ku sha la nā tha 'dis/ do ha dang zab don gyi bstan bcos ci rigs par —62—

mdzad do/ /sngar gyi 'phros la der rgyal pos bsams pa/ grub pa'i slob dpon gyi gdams ngag thob nas yun de snyed lon yang / dngos grub ma thob pa nga brtson 'grus chung snyam ste/ rgyal srid kyi bya ba blon po dang mdun na 'don dag byed du bcug ste/ nyin mtshan kun tu 'bad pas bsgoms so/ /de nas lo gcig gam gnyis tsam song ba'i dus na/nyin mo cig gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun rnams mchod/ de'i mtshan mo gsangs te dur khrod la mchod par byon/ de na bud med kyi ro sha thams cad btogs pa'i keng rus ma 'thor ba zhig 'dug pa la mchod pa byas pas de langs so/ /de la bcom ldan 'das ma bzhugs par shes/ sngags kyis gsol ba btab pas/ keng rus kyi gzugs gar mdzad cing chos bstan/ skad cig de nyid la rgyal pos nyams rtogs phun sum tshogs pa yang brnyes/ las phra mo sna tshogs pa grub bo/ /de nas gzung keng rus ta ra ṇa'i gdams ngag byung pa yin zhes grags/ bar der blon po rnams dang bram zes khrims 'chol bas yul mi bde bar gyur pa la/ rgyal po nyid kyis sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis bskul nas yul khams bde bar spyod do/ /lan cig mu stegs pa'i rgyal phran bco lnga tsam gyi dmag gis mtha' bskor ba la/ rgyal pos sngags kyis bsngags pa'i me tog gtor bas/ pha rol po thams cad shes pa 'gyur te dbang du 'dus/ rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag byas so/ /bhang ga la pa la gnod pa mi byed par mna' bor/ dam bzhag mang po byas te song ngo / /mthar rgyal po des kyang mi snang ba'i rig pa 'dzin pa thob skad/ spyir rgyal blon 'di gnyis las blon po grub thob che bar byed do/ /gzhan yang rnal 'byor ma kang ka nā pa zhes bya ba rang gi lag gdub la sems zin pas de la brten nas gnas lugs kyi don mngon sum du gyur/ rnal 'byor pa dhu ma pa dang lhan cig tu rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi —63—

spyod pa mdzad/ 'phral phal cher du shing a mra'i ljon pa'i 'bras bu rnams dzaskru'i shing la spo/ de'i 'bras bu ke la'i shing la spo ba sogs ljon shing rnams kyi me tog 'bras bu lo ma dag phan tshun du spo ba'i rol rtsed kho na mdzad skad/ mthar 'di yang mi snang ba'i dngos grub 'grub bo/ /rnal 'byor ma dza la ha ri ni/ rje rigs kyi bu mo zhig lo gnyis sam gsum du tshogs can ma byas so/ /de nas dad pa rnyed nas sngags kyi sgor zhugs te/ slob dpon chen po'i dngos slob kyang yin/ slob dpon gu hu pa ring du bsten cing / gtso4 mo bsgoms pas grub pa thob/ lo mang du 'gro ba'i don mdzad de/ de dag gi skabs phal cher du kha zas kyi bya ba mdzad pa na/ rang gi mdun du thod pa re bzhag nas/ khyim gcig gam gnyis sam gsum sogs nas/ gong bu dgug pa'i sbyor ba byas te/ la la nas 'bras chan dang khur ba bkug la la nas myong bkug la la nas zhun mar sogs dgug ste snod khengs par mdzad de gsol lo/ /de'i skabs su yud cig khyim de dang de'i zas dang skom rnams bcud med par 'gyur/ /de nas khong rang tshims tshul mdzad nas se gol gtogs pa na/ slar yang khyim de dang der chang khugs pa dang / dar ba las mar skye ba sogs 'byung ngo / /'dis sna tshogs ri mo zhes bya ba'i gzhung zhig kyang mdzad de rdzogs rim ston/ 'di yang 'ja' lus su gyur par grags/ de dag la sogs pa dngos grub dang nus pa thob pa'i slob ma bgrang bar mi spyod do/ /yang nying slob rnams kyi rnam par thar pa ni spyir bri bar mi lang yang / slob dpon gu phya pa la slob ma grub pa thob pa mang du byung ba'i gtso bo lhag par grags che ba ni/ slob dpon arnyar pa ste arnyar tsar+ya zhes zer/ de nyid bod skad du bsgyur ba bar ma'i slob dpon no/ /ma.ā+oṃ dngos bi dza ya rak+ṣi ta rnam —64—

rgyal srung ba ste/ de la zhes sbyar bas rnal rgyal zhabs zer ro/ /slob dpon 'di ni dpal nā lan dar/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas par byas shing / gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde yang mang du shes pa cig go /de nas slob dpon gu phya pa la dad pa rnyed nas/ de'i drung du rnal 'byor pa mdzad/dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i don bsgom zhing bzhugs/ lan cig lam cig la bzhud pas/grong khyer zhig gi mtha' na sngar gdol pa'i khyim zhig yod pa/ skabs der khang bzang rgya dpangs chen po yod pa cig tu song 'dug /de'i khang thog mda' yab kyi phag nas bud med bzang mo zhig rib tsam rib tsam blta zhing / yul o tre zhes pa na chang 'tshong ma nag mo zhes bya ba'i khyim na/ chos kyi glegs bam zhig 'dug pa khyod kyis long zhes zer ba gsan pas/ de ma thag chas nas rim gyis yul o trer byon no/ /de na myong 'tshong ma nag mo bya ba yod dam byas pas yod zer/ khyim rtsad bcad de der zhugs nas glegs bam yod med dris pas med zer/ khyim de yang chung ngu ngan pa cig la steng 'og kun tu btsal yang ma mthong ngo / /de nas de'i sgo drung du bzhugs te zhag shas shig song ba na/ nyin cig chang 'tshong ma te phyir song / rang nyid chang mang po 'thungs pas ra ro ste/ srang khar gnyid du song / ji zhig na de blo rdol gyi tshul du khro bo chen po sgo gong na yod zer/ der sgo steng brus te btsal bas gtum po khro bo chen po'i rgyud kyi glegs bam byung ngo / /de nyid sprul par shes nas gsol ba btab kyang / dngos su lan cang ma byung / rmi lam du lo bdun nas ston par 'gyur gsung ba byung bas/ glegs bam spyan drangs te ma ga dhar byon/ phyis lo bdun na rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma mngon sum du byon nas byin gyis brlabs shing rgyud de yang gzhan la ston pa'i snang ba stsal lo/ /de nas lan cig dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du —65—

bsgoms pas he ru ka zhal gzigs shing / nus pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen por gyur to/ /de ltar rim pas bsgoms pas/ rgyud dang / sngags dang / ye shes kyi rim pa'i rtogs pa rdzogs/ 'khor mang po dang bcas nas bhang ga la dang / ma ga dhar phar 'gro tshur 'gro mdzad cing / spros bcas dang / spros med kyi rig pa'i brtul zhugs ci rigs pa mdzad pa na/ dus lan cig ma ga dhis yul gyi mtha' grong khyer kha ba tsa zer ba cig tu/rgyal po'i blon po zhig gis lha khang bzhengs shing / de la rab gnas zhus pas zla ba nya ba zhig la rab gnas mdzad/ nyi ma de ka la nub phyogs si rgyu'i yul du kla kle'i rgyal po btul pa yin/ sku lus kyi bkod pa gnyis dus gcig tu bstan pa'o/ /de yang si rgyu'i yul du kla kle'i rgyal po zhig gsar du bzhugs/ yul de na dge slong lnga brgya tsam gnas pa'i gtsug lag khang nor bu sbas pa'i ming can zhig yod/ rgyal po des de 'joms par 'dod pa na der gnas pa'i dge slong phal cher ni bros/ nang par kla klo'i rgyal po de ring yong rgyu'i de'i nub mo khyim chung zhig na phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i rnal 'byor pa cig 'dug /nam phyed na der rol mo'i sgra byung bas/ der sdod mkhan btsun pa cig gis sgo gseng nas bltas pas/ bud med gzugs dang rnam 'gyur sna tshogs can mang po rnal 'byor pa de la mchod pa byed par mthong ngo / /de la khyed nus pa thob par 'dug pas ma drangs pa'i rgyal po 'dul bar zhu zhus pas/ ngas de 'dul ba'i skal ba med/ slob dpon a dhar pa spyan drangs kyi zer/ rgyal po sang lpin 'ong na des mi phan byas pas/ ngas da lta sleb 'ong zer/ de rkang mgyogs grub pa yin/ de nas nams langs pa nyid na slob dpon arnyar pa 'khor bcas der byung ngo / /de nas nyi ma shar ba na rgyal po glang po che la zhon 'khor dang bcas pa der 'ongs/ slob dpon gyis glang po che la lta stangs mdzad/ glang po —66—

che'i sna dang mche ba sa la lhung / glang po che'i 'brogs pas kla klo'i rgyal po yang sa la lhung / yang lta stangs mdzad pas rgyal po dang dmag mi dpa' bo thams cad lkugs shing rengs par gyur/ dpung gzhan rnams bros so/ /de nas dmag mi dpa' bo de rnams kyi nang nas/ phal cher gyis slob dpon grub pa thob par shes/ gus pa byas pas rengs pa las grol lo/ /yang lta stangs mdzad pas glang po'i sna dang mche ba 'byor/rgyal po ni gso ba'i skal ba med gsung ste dus las 'das so/ /de nas mi ring bar rgyal po gshin rje zhes bya ba chos dang ldan pa cig gis rgyal srid de blangs so/ /slob dpon 'dis phal cher 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgo nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad/ grub thob ti snyi pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma yang 'di yin/ mthar shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa spyad pas gsang rim mthar phyin/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'o/ /gzhan yang slob dpon nag po spyod pa chung ba dang / bhu ba ri pa dang / bhu pa blo ldan la sogs pa dang / ku sa la bha dra chung ba nas brtsams te/da lta'i bar du yang tsar+ya pa'i sde ma stongs par yod do/ /de dag gi lo rgyus ci rigs pa ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ bla med bde bas srid gsum khyab mdzad pa/ /dngos grub mchog brnyes rnams kyi gtam 'di mtshar/ /rang bstod tsam gyi rdzu rlabs 'phreng ba la/ /rdom brjid chen por rlom pa bzhad gad gnas/ /spyod pa'i rdo rje slob ma'i tshogs bcas pa'i/ /gtam rgyud yid ches rung ba 'dir bshad kyi/ /'di las bsod nams phung po ci thob pa/ /des ni he ru ka dpal gnas thob shog /slob dpon chen po spyod 'chang dbang po'i rnam par thar ba ngo mtshar ( —67—

snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di yang / rang dang lhan cig spyod pa kun dga' dpal bzang gis yang yang bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas bar skabs su nges par brjod pa'o/ /rang lo nga brgyad pa la bris pa yin/ gcig zhus/maṅga laX// //bdag bis dge ba gang bsags 'di yis ni/ /sems can thams cad bde zhing skyid pa dang / /gnas skabs mthar thug phan bde mchog spel ba'i/ /bla na med pa'i rgyu tshogs nyid gyur cig/ //

sdom pa'o srol 'byed byung tshul bzhugs/na mo gu sa slob dpon tsar+ya pa chen po'i gtam rgyud kyi skabs su gol sa gcod pa dang nyer mkho 'ga' zhig bshad na/ slob dpon chen po de nyid kyi skabs nas gzung rjes su lo brgya'am nyis brgya'i bar mtshams tshun chad du slob dpon nyid kyi rjes 'brang dang / rjes 'brang slob rgyud ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzhan yang rung ste/ dbang po rnon po rdzogs rim kho na bsgoms pas ye shes mchog skyes pa/ 'bring po bskyed rdzogs gnyis kar la bslabs pas rim pas brtan pa thob pa dang / tha ma bskyed rim tsam la brtan pa thob pa shin tu mang bar byung zhing / phal cher slob dpon spyod pa pa chen po'i mig ltos la brten nas/ spros bcas sam spros med kyi rig pa'i brtul zhugs 'jig rten pa'i mngon du spyod pa'i srol ka mang po dang / dus la ma bab pa ci rigs tsam ma gtogs/ spyod pa la zhugs pa rnams mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub gang rung re thob pa kho na'o/ khyad par du yang slob dpon wo po ka sna pa'i slob rgyud ches mang zhing / de dag rnams rim gnyis la rtogs pa skyes shing / cung zad brtan na shin tu brtan pa rang ma thob kyang / rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyod pa'i srol ka shin tu dar zhing / thams cad la 'dod don grub 'bras kyang 'byung ste/brtul zhugs spyod pa'i bstan pa dar ba'i dus la bab pa gcig dang / slob —69—

dpon ka sna pa nyid kyi byin rlabs kyi stobs kyang yin par grags/ de yang slob dpon des brtul zhugs kyi 'phro bsdus nas/ rang gi mdzad dgos rgyu'i bya ba lhag ma rnams/ slob rgyud rnams kyi don du bsngos pa las byung ba yin zer/dus de tsam na spyod pa pa'i slob rgyud phyogs kun tu khyab la/ dus tshod de'i rjes shig nas tsar+ya pa'i sde shar phyogs su gtso bor dar bas/ bar skabs der 'phag yul gyi kha skad la/ shar phyogs nag po pas 'dul bas tsar+ya pa mang / lho phyogs klu sgrub kyis 'dul bas dharma pa mang / nub phyogs lwa ba pas 'dul bas ba la rnyi pa mang / byang phyogs go rak+tas 'dul bas a te sa pa mang zer te phyi ma 'di da lta dzo gir grags pa rnams so/ /tsar+ya pa'i sde la grub thob che chung dpag tu med pa byung / da lta yang bhang ga la dang bhā ṭi dang / her sba dang / sil ha ṭa dang / ko ki sogs na sde cung zad tsam yod de/ mi grangs mang po med kyang dus la ltos pa'i nus pa thob pa mang po yod do/ /sngon bod kyi lo rgyus gzhan rnams na'ang sna tshogs snang zhing / do he'i ngag sgros ras chung pa nas brgyud pa/ rje rgya ras kyis yi ger mdzad pa cig na/bla ma'i bka' chad byung ba'i tshul bstan pa'i nag po pa de/ nag po spyod pa chung ba yin/ che ba min gsung ba cig kyang 'dug de yang ti pu'am/ a mo gha badz+ra gyi gsung bgros cig ni yin par snang / u rgyan pa rin chen dpal yang de dang mthun par gsung zhing / khong rang nag po pa'i rnam 'phrul yin tshul slob ma rnams kyis bris 'dug khong gis mdzad pa'i gtan tshigs nyung ngu cig na/ rgya gar ba rnams slob dpon nag po spyod pa da lta ka spro dza'i gling na 'khrungs yod/—70—

ma 'ongs pa na ral gri la sogs pa'i dngos grub mang po sgrubs te/ wā rā ṇa sir byon nas chos bstan pas rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa ches dar te/ grub thob gnam gyi skar ma tsam 'byung bar 'dod do/ /zhes bris 'dug yi ge de na rgyal po go pā las 'grub pa'i yi dam yang lha mo tsun da yin par bshad pa dang /skabs 'di'i 'dod tshul bskyar ba de gnyis rgya gar ba'i ngag sgros su 'dug /bod rkyang pa'i rig gras dang mi 'dra'o/ /rgya gar phyogs na'i slob rgyud bod pa rnams kyi do he'i lo rgyus kun na/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa yang / slob dpon nag po spyod pa'i rnam 'phrul yin par 'chad cing / 'bar ba'i gtso bo nag po spyod pa'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs su 'chad do/ /yang ji skad du/ brtul zhugs spyod 'chang bla med pa/ /'bar ba'i gtso bo'i bka' drin gyis/ /zhes slob dpon a mi ta badz+ra gyis bshad/ dpyad de mig zur la thogs nas phyis kyi kha cig spyod 'chang nag po dang / 'bar gtso gcig yin/ de dang nag po spyod pa tha dad do zhes smra ba ni/ gling chen ras pa dang / gling ras mi gcig zer ba dang 'dra'o/ /yang 'bar ba'i gtso bo'i skye ba gsal bar dran pas spyod pa nyid la'ang 'bar ba'i gtso bo'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs 'byung ba ni mi 'gal lo/ /da ni gtam rgyud 'ga' zhig brjod de/ tsar+ya pa'i rnal 'byor pa kā li zer ba cig yul ra dha'i tshong 'dus dang nye bar sgom byed do/ /de'i grogs mched bi kā li zer ba cig grong khyer li khar shing 'phel dang nye bar bsgom mo/ /gnyis kar gyis ting nge 'dzin cung zad brnyes/ bi kā li grong khyer ra dhar song na/ ka li dang 'phrad/ 'o skol rnams tshogs 'khor bya'o zhes bgros nas/—71—

tshogs khang du rnal 'byor pho mo gzhan yang spyan drangs/ bi kā li na re/ dur khrod nas mi ro bkug la gdan bya zer/ khong gnyis kar dur khrod du phyin/ mi ro rnams la lcag rgyab pas thams cad langs te/ tshogs khang du sleb nas so so'i gdan dgos par 'gyel te song ngo / /der g.yas gral gyi 'go la bi kā li dang /g.yon gral gyi 'go la kā li 'dug nas tshogs 'khor gyi bya ba byas/ de grol ba na thams cad langs pa'i skabs/ da mi ro rnams rang gnas su skyel dgos zer tsa na/ kā li'i 'gral gyi rnams la/ khong rang gis se gol gtogs pas thams cad langs nas gar byed cing dur khrod du song / sngar gyi shul du 'gyel lo/ /bi kā li'i gral gyi/ rnams khong rang gi dmigs pa brtad cing rnam 'gyur byas pas/ thog mar phyed tsam langs te slar 'gyel/ bar du mgo bteg tsam bteg tsam byung / mthar 'gul ba tsam yang ma byung ste/ der rnal 'byor pa kā lin re/nus pa cung zad tsam la nga rgyal byar mi rung / da dung bsgom dgos zer/ mi ro de rnams la kā lis rdog pa re bsnun pas thams cad langs te snga ma bzhin du song ngo / /phyis rnal 'byor pa kā lis dngos grub chen po brnyes/ bi kā lis kyang slar rang gnas su log ste bsgoms/ dus gzhan cig na mig sman gyi dngos grub thob bo/ /yang rgyal po de ba bā li'i yig mkhan pra ṇa pa zhes bya ba zhigayig mkhan bor te chos bslabs pas paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas par song / de nas tsar+ya pa'i rnal 'byor pa cig gi drung du phyin nas gdams ngag zhus nas bsgoms/ting nge 'dzin bzang po skyes/ lus kyang shin tu yang ba thob ste ngal dub med par gyur cing / chu'i steng du 'chag par nus/ nang gi rtsa thig mthong pa'i nus pas/—72—

bstan bcos dang yi ge'i rigs sngar ma shes pa thams cad kyang shes/ dud 'gro dang mi ma yin gyi skad go bar byung / nga/ ni nus pa thob pas spyod pa bya'am snyam ste lan cig ljongs rgyu zhing song ngo /der yul kā ma dra'i grong khyer cig gi 'dabs na/ lha khang phyed tsam zhig pa cig 'dug/de na gsung rab klog pa'i sgra thos so/ /sgo phye nas nang du phyin pas/ rnal 'byor pa kun spangs kyi cha byad rgan po cig res 'ga' ni po ti klogares 'ga' ni gnyid yur zhing 'dug go /de dang gtam cung zad byas nas/ pra ṇa pas klog mkhan de la/ khyed paṇ+ḍi ta lags sam rnal 'byore pa lags byas pas/ de na re/ rnal 'byor pa yin zer/ rnal 'byor pa rgan po zhig klog 'don byed dam byas pas/ 'di klog pa shin tu dka' bas dka' thub tu 'gyur sdig pa 'khyang snyam klog pa yin zer/ de tsam klog pa la dka' ba ci yod byas pas/ de na re/ 'o na khyed rang 'di klog nga sgom pa la 'gro zer/ po ti de gto nas de song ngo / /pra ṇa pas der po ti bltas pas yi ge'i 'go gzhug tsam yang ngo ma shes/ rnal 'byor pa de yang gar song cha med do/ /der spyod pa bya ba'i dus la ma sleb/ da dung sgoms shig ces pa'i sgra nam mkha' nas sgrags pas/ yang de nags tshal dben pa zhig tu song nas bsgoms so/ /klog mkhan gyi tshul 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor pa de ni/ grub thob dharma pa yin par grags/ rnal 'byor pa pra ṇa pas phyis spros bcas kyi spyod pa ni ma byas/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i tshig gi bdag po'i dngos grub 'grub ste smon lam gang btab pa 'grub bo/ /yang tsar+ya pa'i rnal 'byor pa cig mtsho zhig gi 'gram na sgom zhing —73—

yod do/ /yul ni u ḍi bi sha yin/ der lan cig tho rangs kha sgra dang 'od chen po dang bcas te/ bud med nag mo cig gam du byung ngo / /de bkres so/ /skoms so/ /ngal lo zer ba la/ rnal 'byor pa de la ri khrod pa 'gas byin pa'i ma he'i gzug gcig dang / myong gha ṭa gang yod pa dang stabs 'grig nas/ de la byin pas/ de khams gcig la zos/ shub gcig la btungs/ de dga' ba'i tshul gyis sngags cig bslabs/ 'dis lta stangs bcu 'grub par 'gyur zer/ bud med de na re/ nged phra men ma'i lugs kyis sngags gzhan la sbyin nas lus 'dor dgos zer/ mtsho de'i dbus su nub song skad/ rnal 'byor pa des rtsa shing la nyams sad byas pas/ lta stangs grub par mngon te/ da ni yul rgyu zhing spyod pa bya snyam/ de nas cung zad cig yul gzhan du song ba na/ blon po'i bu mo zhig blon po gzhan cig la bag mar 'gro ba la/ rgyang ring po nas dbang gi lta stangs byas pas/ de dpon g.yog thams cad tshur 'ongs rnal 'byor pa la phyag btsal/ gser gyi phye mas gtor/ yo byad rnam pa du ma bzhug nas song ngo / /de nas rnal 'byor pa de don thams cad 'grub snyam dga' ches te/ rig pa yer yer por byas nas rgyu zhing song ngo / /de nas dus gzhan cig na/ thong mkhan zhig zhing rmo zhing 'dug /pha tshad na bza' btung sna tshogs pa ras kyis g.yogs te bzhag 'dug go /da lho'i dus la bab pas zas slong dgos snyam ste/ shis brjod byas pas/ thong mkhan de ni gtam gyi sne tsam yang mi len par ma thos pa bzhin du lan mi 'debs/ rgyab bstan cing 'gro'o/ /de nas yang nan gyis lto bslangs pas rnal 'byor pa'i gzugs bzung nas ltogs ngab che ba 'di 'dra —74—

zhes kha zer bas/ des kyang rmos glang gnyis la lta stangs byas pas/ glang gnyis de ma thag shi'o/ /der thong mkhan na re/ 'o na khyod sangs rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor par 'dug pa/ sangs rgyas pa snying rje can bya ba yin/ da glang 'di gnyis gso bar zhu zer/ der rnal 'byor pas sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin byas kyang / g.yo ba tsam yang ma byung ngo / /der thong mkhan nyid kyis lcag rgyab pas glang gnyis 'phrab cing langs/ zhing chen po de yang skad cig nyid la rmos grub ste/ thag je ring rje ring la mig mthong tsam nas/ de na re/ sems can la phan btags pas dngos grub thob pa yin gyi/ ngan pa'i spyod pas ga la yin/ da dung sgoms shig zer nas mi snang bar song ngo / /de nas 'jig rten pa'i mkha' 'gro mas mchog sbyin pa de ni yang dag pa'i dngos grub kyi bar chad du shes nas lhag pa'i lha la nan tan du bshags pa byas nas bsgoms pas/ nam zhig na bcom ldan 'das ma 'dab chags kyi gzugs kyi rnam pas byon nas/ lung bstan zhing byin gyis brlabs/ shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i blo gros can du gyur/ phra mo'i las rnams ni grub lus ni gnas ma gyur ro/ /'dis dang po zhig rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi dga' ston dang tshogs kyi skabs/ gral 'chos mkhan yun ring rab byas pas/ pang ka ti pa ste gral bcos pa zhes ming la grags so/ /thong mkhan du snang ba de yang grub thob me dhi na pa yin par grags kyi/ dpal he ru ka'i gsal kha med do/ /yang slob dpon shrī ma nu ni/yul ma rur 'khrungs/ rigs tshong pa/ gnas de nyid du rab tu byung nas mi ring bar kha che'i yul du song / der rin sbas pa'i gtsug lag khang du sde snod gsum —75—

la sbyangs shing mkhas par byas pa zhig /slob dpon spyod pa pa'i dngos slob rnal 'byor pa na rnyi pa zhes bya ba sa 'og gi 'jig rten du 'gro nus pa cig dang mjal/dbang bskur zhing gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa thob/ dpal o rgyan gyi gnas su brag phug gcig tu gnas bcas te bsgom zhing bzhugs/ dpyid kyi thig le la gsal snang thob pas/ mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul shugs la byung ste/ri'i khong seng dang sa 'og la ci bder spyod nus/ de nas nus pa cung zad thob pa'i rnal 'byor pho 'ga' zhig dang lhan cig tu rig brtul gyi spyod pas yul rgyu zhing song ba na/ grong khyer cig gi 'dabs na thags mkhan rgad po gcig 'dug go /de na re khyod rnams rnal 'byor par rlom pa zhig 'dug na/ dur khrod du tshogs 'khor la mi 'gro'am zer/ 'gro'o byas nas lhan cig tu song / mi gzhon nu tsho bcud dang ldan pa'i ro zhig blangs te tshogs rdzas la bzhag pa na/ shrī ma nu 'khor bcas kyis mtshon gyis gcod par brtsams pa la/ thags mkhan de na re/ khyed rnams dngos grub kyi rdzas la sdig pa gsog gam zhes gad mo byed do/ /'o na ji ltar bza' byas pas/ thags mkhan de stag chen po'i gzugs su byas nas/ khams cig la zos nas slar mir song ngo / /de na re/ deng 'dir rdzas kyi dngos grub la/ khyod rnams g.yel bar gyur gyi/ da ni dngos grub phra mo don du mi gnyer bar/ lhan cig skyes pa'i don sgoms shig zer ro/ /de nas shrī ma nus kyang spros pa spangs te lo bcu gnyis bsgoms/ der dngos grub chen po nyams 'og tu chud nas slob ma 'ga' la chos bstan/ yul la hor du grong khyer gyi lam 'gegs pa'i brag de'u cig chu klung nī la'i 'gram du bskyal bas/ sdig —76—

spyod kla klo'i rgyal po zhig kyang dad pa thob ste zhabs la gshugs/ 'di mthar sku lus mi snang bar gyur ro/ /de ltar bzhi po de rnams la tsa shun a bhi ma n+ya sā dha ka ste/ mngon pa'i nga rgyal can gyi sgrub pa po bzhi zer ro/ /bod rnying rnams kyang /gtam rgyud de dag gi dum bu 'dra/ slob dpon ka sna pa chen po la sbyor ba 'di ni/de bzhi kar tsar+ya pa'i rnal 'byor pa yin pas/ tsar+ya pa zer tsa na slob dpon ka sna pa yin te 'ong snyam pa cig gis/ bal po'i sngags pa 'ga' zhig dang / bod rnying pa rnams la 'khrul gzhi bskyed pas byung 'dra'o/ /bshad ma thag pa'i thags mkhan rgan po de ni/ grub thob ta ni pa yin te de yang / yul mā la bar thags mkhan zhig thags 'thags pa'i las la mkhas shing rtsol ba che ba cig yod do/ /de la bu yang bcu tsam byung zhing / phyis de dag chen por gyur nas re re zhing khyim phug bag ma blangs/ so so la yang bu tsha mang du btsas thags mkhan gyi rigs rgyud shin tu mang bar gyur to/ /de nas de shin tu rgas par gyur te/ bu rnams kyi khyim du re mos kyis gso ba las/ de rgas pas sbyor ba mi bzo zhing / spyod pa mi mdzes par mthong nas/ bu rnams na re/pha la 'o mi brgyal ba'i zhabs tog ni nged rnams kyis byed/ khyim du re mos 'byon pa khyed rang 'o brgyal/ mi rnams kyis kyang 'phya ba las mi 'dug pas/'dir bzhugs shig zer bu rgan shos kyi khyim dang nye ba'i skyed mos tshal cig du bzhag 'tsho ba re mos kyis skyel lo/ /lan cig grub thob dza lan+ta ri pa de thags mkhan de'i bu cig gi khyim du byon pa/ nam sros pa na skyed mos tshal der gnas g.yar ba'i tshul gyis bskyal lo/ /der sgron me dang bcas te mi zhig sleb —77—

song ba ni shes/ su yin ma shes pa la/ tho rangs kyi dus tsa na thags mkhan rgan pos de na yod pa de su yin zhes dris pas/ dngos phyogs nas 'ongs pa'i rnal 'byor pa cig lags/ nyid rang su yin gsung / bdag thags mkhan 'di kun gyi pha lags te/ gzhan la ston ma nyan par 'dir sbas pa yin pas/ rang gis rang la yi chad pas yid mi bde bar mchis zer/ 'o na sdug bsngal de sel ba'i thabs cig mi 'tshal lam gsungs pas/ cis kyang 'tshal gyi rjes su gzung bar zhu zer/ de la slob dpon dza lan+ta ri pas rgan po de la ye shes 'pho bar mdzad de rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa stsal lo/ /de yang sems kyi sdug bsngal sangs/ nom pa chen po rnyed pa bzhin du spro ba bskyed de bsgoms pas/ le gnyis sam gsum tsam lon pa'i skabs shig na/phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub nyams 'og tu chud de/ 'on kyang re zhig g.yin la ma bstan par sbas te 'dug go /lan cig bu che shos de'i zas skyel ba'i res cig la/ nyin par mgron po byung ba sogs bya bas g.yengs nas/ zan skyel ba brjed/ nam phyed na dran te g.yog po zhig zas skyel du btang bas/ skyed mos tshal ni 'od kyis khyab/ rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs 'dug ste/ sgo gseng nas bltas nga/sa rgan po de ni lus la 'od 'phro zhing / gzugs dang cha byad sna tshogs pa'i mi ma yin gzi brjid dang ldan pas mchod pa byed par mthong ngo / /de nas grub pa thob pa'i grags pa byung bas yul der ma bzhugs/ yul gzhan sna tshogs par thags mkhan gyi spyod par brdzus te/ lo mang du 'gro ba'i don mdzad nas mthar 'khor mang po dang bcas te mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /—78—
