grub thob tan+ti pa 'di ni ba dri/ ḍom+bi sogs dang 'dra ba'i grub thob ches che ba zhig yin par 'dug 'dis gsungs pa'i do ha sum brgya pa bya ba rgyas pa cig yod/ gzhan yang man ngag thor bu mang du mdzad yod par 'dug na'ang /gtam rgyud de tsam kho na ma gtogs/ 'gro don mdzad tshul gyi lo rgyus rgyas pa ni bdag gis ma rnyed do/ /gzhan yang 'di ltar go bar bya ste/ sngon theg pa chen po'i gsung rab 'jig rten du thog mar byon pa'i skabs/ bya spyod rnal 'byor gyi rgyud phal cher byon par snang zhing / 'dus pa la sogs pa rnal 'byor bla med kyang mang du byung ba'i sdebs la/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa 'di yang byon pa yin no/ /sngar bod gzhan rnams 'khor lo sdom pa rtsa rgyud 'di sus spyan drangs pa'i gsal kha mi smra la/ mar do ni nga ṭi dang lhan cig slob dpon spyod pa pas spyan drangs par bzhed mod/ snga ma/ nyid don la gnas so/ /de ltar rgyud 'di byon pa nas ring zhig gi bar du gsang sngags 'dzin pa rnams kyis bsgoms shing bshad nas dngos grub thob pa mtha' yas pa byung mod kyang / gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa ring du dar ba med la/dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos brtsams pa yang cher med/ de'i phyir de dag gi gtam rgyud kyang nub pa kho na'o/ /des na rdo rje 'dzin pa/ sa ra ha pa klu sgrub ces sogs brgyud pa 'dod pa yang rnam grangs tsam yin gyi/ gcig tu nges bzung can yang med do/ /de nas phyi zhig na grub thob shā ba ri pas/ sdom pa'i rgyud kyi don thugs su chud nas dpal pū yi pa la thog mar gdams pa yin mod/ phyis ni slob dpon lha yi pa de nyid sdom pa'i rgyud kyi bdag por gyur cing / dpal he —79—

ru ka dang rdo rje phag mo nyid kyis rtag tu mngon sum du 'doms pa yin pas/ lha yi pa'i gong du gzhan la brgyud pa 'ded mi dgos so/ /slob dpon 'dis dpal rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi rgyud spyan drangs par grags/ de'i rjes su slob dpon rdo rje dril bu bas kyang / dpal mngon spyod bla ma'i rgyud spyan drangs par 'chad pa'ang yod/ gang ltar na yang slob dpon 'di gnyis kyis bshad rgyud de dag dang bstun nas/ rtsa rgyud kyi sgrub thabs sogs bstan bcos mdzad do/ /slob dpon ྅ dril nag gsum po 'khor lo sdom pa'i srol 'byed nyi zla lta bur grags pa yin la/ gzhan yang dā ri ka pa dang / ning gi pa dang / in+d+ra dh+wa ti chung ba rnams kyis lam srol re phye zhing / slob dpon kong ka na pa'am/ lang ka rgyal bzang dang / mi thub zla ba dang / bha ba bha dra rnams kyis kyang lugs srol mi 'dra ba re mdzad 'dug bram ze rin chen rdo rjes kyang de dag dang mi 'dra ba'i lugs srol gsar ba mdzad 'dug pa/ in+d+ra dh+wa ti chung ba'i rjes 'brang yi na nam khong rang nyid kyis srol gsar du phye ba yin ga brtag par bya mod lugs srol ngo mtshar che zhing byin rlabs dang ldan pa cig ni yin par snang ngo / /rin chen rdo rjes bde mchog gi sgrub thabs 'di kha che'i yul du brtsams nas/ yul dbus su dpal nā ro pa la skyes su stsal bas/ nā ro pas gzigs te ngo mtshar che bar dgongs nas/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor btags nas/ phyag mchod rgya cher mdzad pas/ snyan grags rgyas te ji zhig ltar la kha che dang nyi 'og tu/ dpal ྅ yi pa'i lugs las kyang 'di sgom pa mang ba'i dus cig byung skad/ bod du yang lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos rtsal 'don du bsgyur zhing / sngon dus cung zad dar bas sa —80—

bcad mchan bu yig sna sogs yod do/ /lang ka rgyal bzang gi lugs ni 'ga' zhig ྅ yi pa'i nang sel yin zer ro/ /'on kyang bskyed rim lha yi pa dang mthun rung du yod kyang / rdzogs rim sogs sgo gzhan nas ches mi 'dra bas lugs srol logs pa nyid yin no/ /de dag ni bod du 'gyur ba'i dbang du byasaso/ /gzhan yang grub thob glu dbyangs mkhan dang / nag po rdo rje dang / ka la hang sa ku mā ra dang / dharma pa dang / ku sku ṭi pa dang / gyus ri pa dang / tsa ṭi ya pa dang / nā ḍi pa dang / dhin+ta ra pa dang / bī na pa dang / ṭa rnyen pa dang / tā ḍa ka ba dang / kaX ka la pa dang / dza ya na ni pa dang / bha de pa ste grub pa'i slob dpon bcu bzhi po de dag kyang 'khor lo sdom pa'i lam las grub pa brnyes shing / de dag gi srol gtod pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gzhung sogs lugs srol mi 'dra ba re re byung bar grags/ so so'i dus der lugs de dang de bsgoms pas grub pa thob pa yang mang du byung bar 'dug /de dag gis mdzad pa'i gzhung lugs bod du 'gyur ba mang po mi snang yang / 'phags pa'i yul du sngon dus mang du byung zhing /phyis kyang ci rigs pa yod par snang ngo / /rtsa rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor la lha tshogs thams cad sku mdog nag por 'dod pa yod ces bshad pa ni/ slob dpon dharma pa'i lugs yin par snang la/ zhabs g.yon brkyang du mdzad pa yod par bshad pa ni nag po rdo rje'i sgrub thabs so/ /gar stabs su byed pa ni grub thob sa 'dzin zhabs te gan+dhar pa'i lugs so/ /grub thob kuṇ+ḍa ri pa'i slob ma dpal o rgyan par grags pa chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi sgrub thabs ni/ sku mdog ma nges par 'dod cing / yab yum kha dog rnam pa kun tu mtshungs par smra'o/ /bī na pas —81—

mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs na/ lha tshogs thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis par yod pas/ de'i lugs la rtsa rgyud kyi lha tshogs phyag gnyis pa kho nar bzhed ces grags kyang / sgom bde ba'i dgos pa dang mtshon byed tsam yin gyi/ phyag mangs mi bzhed pa ma yin no/ /rnal 'byor rdzogs 'phreng du bsdus pa'i/ he ru ka ser po'i dkyil 'khor ni/ slob dpon dza ya nan ti pa'i lugs yin zer ba tsam snang / slob dpon bha de pa dang / bha da li ka dang / bha dra pa dang / brnye pa rnams mtshan 'dra mtshungs la/ yi ge nor ba dang / don nor ba dang / gcig tu 'khrul ba mang po byung yang ngo bo so so yin zhing / bstan bcos kyang so sor yod do/ /slob dpon ku sku ṭi pa'i lugs kyi rtsa rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad gdong brnyan can du bzhed ces grags so/ /de la grub thob glu dbyangs mkhan ni/ glu gar mkhan gyi rigs rang gi las la brtson pa/ tshig mang po gsar du sbyor nus pa zhig yod pa las/ lan cig dus ston zhig la mi che ba lnga brgya tsam 'dus/ de re re la bstod pa gsar pa'i glu dbyangs kyis bstod dgos byung bas/ ji zhig nas tshig gsar pa sbyor ba'i blo gros gshugs te/tshig spyor snga ma rnams nyid/ slar bskyar te 'don pa spos nas glu blangs so/ /der tshig gsar pas bstod pa rnams kyis rngan pa che bar byin/ bskyar mas bstod pa rnams kyis zas nyung zad re tsam ma gtogs ma byin pas dus ston grol nas des bsams pa/ tshig gsar pa sbyor ba la thogs pa med pa'i thabs cig dgos pa 'dug snyam/ shing drung zhag tu ma no bsam gtong kyin yod tsa na/ rgyud yongs su grol ba'i rnal 'byor pa zhig der byon nas khyod 'di ltar —82—

sem mam gsungs pas/ de mchog tu dad pa skyes nas de ltar lags kyi rjes su bzung bar zhu zhes zhabs la gshugs/ gsol ba btab pas rnal ga tsho' byadzo ra pa des/ bde mchog he ru ka'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa nyung ngu zhig byin no/ /de nas des kyang mtshan thog thag tu gnyid spangs te rtag tu sgom par byed cing / nyin par yang res 'ga' ni/ ngam grog dag tu yib kyin bsgom/ re/sa 'ga' ni rang gi las kyi mtha' byed do/ /de nas lo mang dag song ba'i skang/sa zhig na/ lung stongs kyi lam 'ga' zhig na khyi mo zhig na nas 'chi la khad 'dug go /der spyang ki zhig 'ongs nas khyi de za la khad khad 'dug pa la/ thabs sna tshogs kyis bsrungs kyang mi thub pa ltar byung / khyi mo de'i srog srung ba'i phyir rang gi phyag g.yon pa bcad de spyang ki la byin pas de zos te spyang ki song ngo / /de nas yangs thabs cig la khyi mo med par rdo rje phag mor song nas/phyag spyi bor bzhag cing bka'i gnang ba stsal ba tsam gyis grub pa thob/ de nas nags dang grong khyer kun tu glu kho na len cing skye bo mang po smin grol la bkod/grub thob gā ya pa ste glu dbyangs mkhan du grags so/ /slob dpon nag po rdo rje ni yul ka liñja ra te/ ka ling ka pa yin/ so ma pu rir slob gnyer byas te/ mkhas par song ba'i skabs shig grong khyer na byis pa mang po tshogs te/ gcig gis sgom byed pa ltar byed/ gzhan rnams kyis de la lkog gyur dris shing / des kyang de rnams la mngon shes lung ston gyi zlad mo byed kyin 'dug pa mthong nas/ des rkyen byas te slob dpon gyis kyang / tshong khang na tshong pa rnams kyi sgrom dang rkyal pa rnams kyi nang na ci zhig yod ces blos —83—

brtags kyang ma shes nas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la sbyangs kyang phra mo 'di tsam yang mi shes pa snyam/ mkhas pa'i bya ba la thugs mug ste mtshan mo gsangs nas bros so/ /de nas kha sar pa ṇi la gsol ba 'debs kyin zla ba drug bzhugs/rmi lam du/ 'di nas shar phyogs su phyin pa hi tsi li zhes pa'i grong khyer yod/de'i nya pa'i grong na rdo rje phag mo bzhugs te/ der zhag bdun du gsol ba btab na zhal ston gsung / de bzhin du byas pas zhag bdun song ba'i tho rangs cig /nya ba'i bud med rgan mo nya brgya phrag pa la bkal nas hral hral 'gro ba cig 'dug /de bcom ldan 'das mar shes nas zhabs la phyag byas te gsol ba btab pas/ bud med lang tsho ma cig tu gyur to/ /yang gsol ba btab pas sku dngos su gyur te me lce drag tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs nas/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs shing gdams pas ting nge 'dzin dang mngon shes skyes so/ /der sa dong byas nya ros mtha' bskor te/ rgyud sbyangs shing bsgoms pas dus gzhan zhig na grub pa brnyes so/ /slob dpon 'dis nya pa'i grong gi mgron khang cig tu bzhugs tsa na/ rnal 'byor pa'i gtso bo gsum 'khor rnal 'byor pa stong tsam dang bcas nas 'ong zhing 'dug /de rnams la 'dir byon tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzod byas pas/ slob dpon gsum po des slob dpon 'di bzhugs pa'i sgo nas ltas pas sha dum cig dang / nya dum cig dang myong bum chung cig las mi 'dug cing / gnas de yang dog por shes nas khyed kyis de rnams tshims par yang mi nus/ gnas 'dir yang mi shong ngo zer/ slob dpon na re/ ji tsam shong blta'o byas nas/ rnal 'byor pa stong phrag gcig nang der zhugs pas/ khyim gyi —84—

gra cig kyang ma khengs so/ /yo byad de rnams gtad nas khyed rnams kyis 'di longs spyod nus par gyis shig gsungs/ rnal 'byor pa de rnams kyis rdzas nge/ las zhag bdun gyi bar du ji tsam zos shing 'thungs kyang ma zad do/ /de rnams kyis slob dpon nag po rdo rje'i zhabs la phyag byas/ bzod pa gsol te/ lhag ma za ma nus par bor te song ngo / /ka la haX sa ku mā ra ni grong khyer pa ṭa li pu trar 'khrungs/ chung ja'i dus su zhing gi rka yur kho na 'tsho bar byed/ lus kha dog dkar ba zhig yo da pas/ ka la ni zhing gi yur ba pa/ hang sa ni ngang pa ste dkar po/ ku mā ra gzhon nu ste de ltar grags/ de nas gtsug lag khang gcig tu rab tu byung zhing chos bslabs pas mkhas pa'i gral du chud tsam byung / da ni gzhan snying po med snyam ste/ bla ma cig la 'khor lo sdom pa zhus nas bsgoms pas/ nam zhig na nus pa khyad par can brnyes so/ /yul bhang ga la'i grong khyer cig na/ rgyal po cig gis sbyin bdag byas te/ bram ze lnga brgya tsam yod pa la re res thab gsum gsum byas te sbyin sreg mchod sbyin re re byed/ dkyil 'khor dang mchod pa'i yo byad dpag tu med pa yod pa la/ slob dpon 'dis dmigs pa brtad pas skad cig nyid la rlung dmar mi bzad pa langs nas/ mchod skong thams cad chag yo byad thams cad khyer ro/ /de ltar lan bdun brtsams pa las thams cad rlud gis khyer ba'i tha mal bram ze rnams dang / rgyal po rang yang rlung gis khyer zhing gos dang bral bar 'dug go /de nas rgyal po dang bram ze rnams slob dpon gyi mthu bstan par shes nas gus pas btud de/ bka' gnang zhus/ phyin chad srog —85—

bcad pa'i mchod spyin mi byed cing / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dad par gyur to/ /slob dpon sto pa ni yul lho phyogs dang nye ba'i grong khyer swā li pu drar 'khrungs/ yul der rab tu byung zhing / rig pa'i gnas rnams la mkhas par byas/ nyan bshad kyis dus 'das pa'i ngang la bgres shing spyan yang long ci byar yang med pa'i skabs su yang dag pa'i lam dngos su ston nus pa'i bla ma zhig dang mjal na ci ma rung snyam zhing rtag tu dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pas/ mnal lam du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma byon/ ngas byin gyis brlabs kyi gsung / de nas yang yang gsol ba btab pas dngos su byon nas byin gyis brlabs shing gdams pa gnang ngo / /de nas bsgoms pas lo lnga lon pa na/phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub nyams 'og tu chud/ klog mkhan gyi tshul bzung nas sems can gyi don mdzad do/ /mahā mā ya'i gzhung slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa zhig bdag gis kyang thos so/ /ku klu ṭi pa ni rig ma khyim bya'i gzugs su bsgyur ba cig yin/ guṇ+ḍi ri pa ni lhun ri pa zhes sngar bod na grags pa de yin par mngon/ bye'u nyuṇ+ḍi ri ( 〈dzaX〉 rtse dwags ) mang po bsad nas sha gsol/ yang gsos te zhal nas sbur ba'i cho 'phrul bstan to/ /tsā ṭi la pa ni mtshan tsam ma gtogs lo rgyus cha ma 'tshal/ nā ḍi pa yang na ri pa gcig gam mi gcig brtag go /slob dpon gan+dha ra pa ste slob dpon sa 'dzin pa ni/rigs rje rigs/ yul gan+dha ra ste sa 'dzin du 'khrungs/ mtshan dngos ni/ bidz+nyā naX ku ri zer/ dge bsnyen byas nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs par bslabs/—86—

gsang sngags pa'i sde cig la zhugs/ de na sa 'jin nas yongs pa'i mi g.yin med pas/ gan+dha ra pa zhes bla dwags su thogs/ slob dpon sgrub pa po purba gup+ta zhes pa/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor cig la 'khor lo sdom pa zhus nas bsgoms pas/nam zhig na phra rags thams cad la gsal snang thob bo/ /des gser mgar gyi grong bya ba shar phyogs kyi grong khyer cig dang nye ba'i nags su bsgoms pas/ 'bar snang gsal ba cig la dngos su me byung nas/ nags kyi rtswa dang shing thams cad mes tshig go /de nas mi ring bar char dbab po snyam/ ting nge 'dzin kho nas char phab ste sngar tshig pa rnams yud tsam gyis gsos so/ /der nus pa thob pas rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad cing yul sna tshogs su bzhud/ gling gaX ga sa ga ra nas/ grong khyer pra ya ga'i bar du/ chu bo gaṅgā la lpags gdan bting ste/ 'khor dang bcas pa yar 'byon mar 'byon mang po mdzad/ chu klung ro haX ta'am tshangs pa'i bu shin tu rgyas pa la'ang de bzhin du mdzad/ de nas lan cig gling dha na lhar bzhud par bzhed nas/'khor dang bcas pa rgya mtsho'i steng nas mi bying bar bzhud pa na me tog gi char dang / sgra dang 'od dang dri bzang gis khyab pa dag byung ngo / /der slob dpon gan dha ra pas bsams pa/ da ni bdag bla ma dang nus pa mnyam mo bsams pa ni/de ma thag chur bying ngo / /yang dad pa skyed pas sngar bzhin du gyur te gling dha na shir bzhud do/ /der yang sngags kyis 'gro ba'i don mang du mdzad/ nyi ma gcig la mchod rten brgya dang brgyad la rdo'i gdugs bkal lo/ /de nas slar yang ma ga dha dang nye ba/ dbang pos phug gi gnas su bzhugs/ dang po bla ma dang yon —87—

tan mnyam mo bsam pa 'i nga rgya' byung ba'i rgyus/ sku lus ni gnas ma gyur/nus pa khyad par can brnyes pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing / phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub la nye bar phyogs pa'o/ /bī na pa ni gzhan du bris zin/ ta rje pa ni/ tan+ti pa dang gcig gam snyam/tā ḍa ka pa ni/ chom po gcig phyis grub pa thob par grags/ grub thob kang kā la pa ni/ yul shar phyogs go ra pa/ khyim bdag nor dang ldan pa cig 'dod yon la rtse zhing dga' bas gnas pa las/ glo bur du chung ma shi bar gyur te/ phung po dur khrod du bskyal ba'i tsa na mya ngan byed cing 'dug go /der legs par rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa cig byon nas/ khyod ci byed gsung / des lo rgyus zugad sdug gtam byas pas/ 'di bas khyod nyid kyang 'chi na gsung / 'o na de las thar ba cig zhu byas pas des dbang bskur zhing gdams pa gnang de nas khyim bdag de dur khrod der 'dug nas/ sems kyi dri ma spyong ba'i don du keng rus kyis mtha' bskor te bsgoms pas lo drug na dngos grub thob/ 'gro don yang rgya cher mdzad do/ /slob dpon dza ya nan di pa ni/ bram ze mkhas pa tshangs par spyod pa zhigasangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs nas dge bsnyen byas so/ /gsang sngags kyi slob dpon cig la gdams pa nod nas bsgoms/ yul ba ga la'i rgyal po'i mchod gnas byed cing yod pa la/ des gtor ma'i bya ba yo byad dpag tu med pa dang bcas te/ nyin re bzhin gtor ma btang bas blon po 'ga' zhig gis rgyal po la/ 'dis rgyal po'i longs spyod la 'phangs med byas zer zhing phra ma bcug pas/ rgyal pos slob dpon btson du bcug go /der bya rigs mi gcig —88—

pa thams cad 'dus/ 'dab chags 'bum phrag mang po pho brang der 'ongs nas/sgra sna dzogs 'byin/ lus rnam 'gyur sna tshogs byed/ mi rnams kyi mgo la 'tshog par byed do/ /der bya skad shes pa zhig gis brtags pas/ nged rnams kyi pha ma btso ni du bzung ba yin/ khyed rnams zhug bdun nas rlag par byed do zer skad/ de rgyal po la zlos pas/ rgyal pos kyang btson khang gi khar 'ongs nas/ slob dpon la gtam dris pas/ slob dpon na re/ ngas rgyal po'i yo byad nas rang 'tshams kyis blangs nas btang ba med gsung / 'o na de tsam gang las rnyed byas pas phyag nam mkha' la g.yabs pa tsam gyis 'bru dang zan dang dar ras sogs dpag tu med pa mdun du phung phung byung / de nas slob dpon de grub pa thob par shes nas/ rgyal pos zhabs la gtugs/ pho brang du spyan drangs te/mchod do/ /de gong yon to sbas pa'i rnal 'byor du mdzad/ de nas brtsams te grub thob tu grags so/ /chos 'khor bi kra ma shi la'i ba ling ā tsar+ya te gtor ma'i slob dpon thog ma rang mtshan klu sgrub snying por grags pa gtor ma'i cho ga kun las btus pa mdzad pa po de yang / grub thob dza ya nan di pa 'di'i slob ma yin no/ /slob dpon bha de pa ni/ ma ga dha'i phyogs gcig gnas chung gcig gi gnyer byed pa'i gnas brtan yin/ chos kyang ci ris shes pa gcig yin pa la/lan cig dge slong dur khrod pa zhig la brda gtong ba'i phyir dur khrod du phyin/der mang ngo'i bcu bzhi yin pas/ grong khyer nas 'ongs pa'i mchod pa byed mkhan mang du 'dug gzhan rnams mchod pa zin nas sngon la log /bud med —89—

dar yol cig mchod pa'i bya ba la thogs nas rjes la lus/ de ni sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo lan gsum zer nas/ rkang pa khru gang tsam sa la ma reg par yer kyis song tsa na/ gzhan rnams las chod chad kyi song bar grong khyer du sleb song ba mthong / da dus rjes ma zin yang slar de btsal bas rnyed/ sprul pa'i skur shes nas zhabs la gshugs shing gsol ba btang pas/ des ye shes 'pho ba'i dbang bskur zhing gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa stsal/ bha de bas gnas brtan gyi bya ba bor nas/ res 'ga' ni dur khrod du bsgom/ res 'ga' ni gtsug lag khang du bsgom/ de ltar lo bcu gnyis tsam song ba na/ lan cig dur khrod du mi mang pos song ba na/ keng rus chos gos gon pa zhig tu mi rnams kyis mthong skad/ gtsug lag khang du'ang de ltar mthong ba lan mang du byung /nang du dngos grub khyad par can brnyes/ phyi rol tu keng rus dang / mi thod bya ril gyi cho 'phrul mang du bstan/ phyis 'ja' lus su gshegs/ 'dis kyang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim dang dbang chog gi gzhung la sogs pa mdzad do/ /gzhan yang grub thob bi dhi badz+ra zhes bya ba 'khor rnal 'byor pho mo lnga brgya tsam dang bcas te rtag tu tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor la spyod pa zhig byung / 'khor lnga brgya po re res kyang thun mong gi dngos grub 'grub/ gzhan yang slob tshogs mang / 'dis 'gro lding du byon te/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs dang / bsdus pa'i don dang / rnam par bshad pa la sogs pa mdzad/gnas der 'ja' lus su gshegs par grags/ 'di'i srol ka rgya gar du ring du ma dar/ 'gro lding na da lta'i bar du yang yod par 'dug 'di dang bram ze ye —90—

shes rdo rje ste ye shes zhabs su grags pa gnyis car dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud phyi ma nas lung bstan to/ /yang rnal 'byor pa ma tri dad ta zhes bya ba/ rigs ni bram ze/ rten ni dge bsnyen/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la rnam 'byor du byed pa cig lan cig lung bstan byung ste dur khrod du bzhud/ rang gi blo sbyang ba'i don du/ mi ro la la gdan du bting / la la sngas su btsug /la la phyogs phyogs su ka ba'i tshul du btsugs/ la las steng nas thog phub pa'i tshul byas te bzhugs/de ltar mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom ste/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub nyams 'og tu chud do/ khren tu spros med kyi spyod pa mdzad pa cig yin/ dus de tsam na o ḍi bi sha'i yul gyi phyogs cig tu/ mtsho gsar pa brdol/ klu gdug pa can gsar du skyes pa zhig byung ste/ des grong pa'i khye'u dang bu mo gtsang ma dag rkus te rang gnas su 'byer ro/ /lan cig rgyal po bī ra pā la zhes bya ba'i bu gcig kyang klus khyer te stor bas/ rgyal pos slob dpon de la gsol ba btabs/ slob dpon gyis mtsho'i nang du song / klu'i gnas su byon te rgyal po'i bu blangs te slar rgyal po nyid la gtad do/ /der thams cad kyi grub pa thob par shes nas/ klu de 'dul bar zhus/ slob dpon gyis thugs brtad pas mtsho de khol/ sngar khye'u bu mo rkus pa thams cad kyang ma shi ba nyid du thon nas/ rang rang gi pha ma sogs la gtad pas dga' ba skyes/ 'di la grub thob ma swā na pa zer/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel pa ste phyag rdor stod 'grel lugs kyi sdom pa'i sgrub thabs dang / sbyor drug bsgoms pas grub pa thob pa yin/ 'dis sems 'grel gyi kha skong yang mdzad/ chos rgyun yang ci rigs par byung ngo / /dā —91 —

ri ka pa nas de'i bar gyi slob dpon de rnams kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i gtam shin tu mang ba zhig yod 'dug na'ang / bdag gis mthong thos su gyur pa ni/ gzhan du bris pa dang / 'dir ni bris pa de tsam mo /de bzhin du tsar+ya pa'i sde rigs su chad pa la/ grub thob hi ra rtso pa dang /man+da ra pa dang / ti la ka pa dang / su dar sha pa dang / tsi t+yā tsa pa dang / karka ra pa dang / dza du kaṇi dang / dha na mi tra dang / slob dpon dzi mu ta pa dang / dharma shrī dang / a dzi ta badz+ra dang / kriṣ+ṭha ga yi pa dang / li la badz+ra dang / sa ri ta pa la sogs pa bstan bcos kyang ci rigs pa mdzad cing / nus pa thob pa'i grags chen mang du byung la/ phyis rang yang na go pa dang / sa dh+wa ri pa sogs nus mthu chen po thob pa dag byung ngo / /tsar+ya pa rnams phal cher 'khor lo sdom pa la zhugs pa mang / dgyes rdor dang / gshin rje gshed dang / gzhan sgrub thabs phra mo la brten nas/ nag po chen po dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rigs grub pa yang mang du byung / thams cad kyang dpyid kyi thig le dang / rlung gi rnal 'byor la gtso bor byed pa sha stag go /slob dpon an tar pa yan chad du/ spyod pa pa'i slob rgyud mang pos sa steng khyab kyang / tsar+ya pa'i sde rigs su chad pa med/ slob dpon spyod chung ba'i dus su spyod pa par grags pa'i sde byung / de nas bhu ba ri pa dang / bhu ba blo ldan gyi dus la'ang cung zad 'phel/ de rjes slob dpon ku sa la pas gzhan gyi 'dres dang bsre bslad spangs/ gzhud man ngag rnams la dag ster dang / sgrub —92—

yin no/ /zhes pa 'di yang slob dpon spyod pa pa'i lo rgyus kha skong dang 'khor lo sdom pa'i srol 'byed gyi byung tshul rtogs pa'i phyir du/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bar skabs su brjod pa'o/ /zhus dag /maṅga laX// //

zhal lung las gzhan du rang stog gi dre mas ma sbags pa'i yi ge yang dag pa'o/ /na mo badz+ra dha rā ya/ dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo rdo rje 'chang / /rig kun bdag po dpal ldan bla ma la/ /snying nas gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs rje chen po'i byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'dir bdag cag gi bla ma dam pa rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyis mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub brnyes pa/ rje btsun bud+dhā gup+ta nā tha'i zhabs kyi rnam par thar ba cung zad cig brjod na/'phags yul lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram ra smi shwa ra zhes bya ba dang nye ba in+d+ra ling ga zhes bya ba'i grong khyer chen por yab ni tshong dpon chen po longs spyod bsam gyis mi khyab pas mngon par mtho ba kriṣ+ṭha zhes bya ba la/ yul tha dad na bu brgyad yod pa las/ rje 'di ni chung stag yin te/ chung dza'i dus nas slob dpon ti rmi nā tha zhes bya ba 'khor rnal 'byor pa mang po dang bcas pa phyogs der pheb pas rnal shel 'byar pa byed pa la mos par gyur/ yab la zhus pas kyang gnang nas rnal 'byor pa mdzad/ mtshan ni brnya nā tha zhes bya bar btags/ bla ma de yang lo 'ga' rer/ yul ka tsa li dang / gong ku na dang / tu lu rā ti la sogs par/gtso bor dben pa bsten cing bzhugs/ rje 'dis ni bla ma'i rim gro ba mdzad cing / yi ge la sogs pa rig gnas phra mo la bslabs/ bram ze'i rnal 'byor pa —94—

dī pa nā tha zhes bya ba la sgra mdo tsan+d+ra pa yan lag dang bcas pa thams cad dang /sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos dmar ser snyan dngags a laṅka ra/ a ma ra ko ṣa nas ci rigs pa dang bcas pa gsan/ bla ma ti ni nā tha de/ bcud len gyi rdzas gsol zhing bzhugs pas/ rdzas kyi nus pas ral pa ni khru nyi shu tsam/ sku'i sma ra yang khru bdun tsam skyes te/ skye bo rnams ya mtshan du gyur pa la/ rgyal po rā ma rā dza the tshom skyes/ legs par brtags pa'i yid ches te/ nyag ma re re bzhin du mchog tu gyur pa'i mu tig re res brgyan no/ /slob dpon gyis mu tig thams cad phyogs gcig tu sbungs pas phung po chen por gyur te/ su 'dod pa khyer zhes de nyid du ci dgar bor nas/ 'khor bcas yul dbus su phebs/ bla ma de bha ṇa ra shi te/ bā rā ṇa sir thog gcig bzhugs/ ḍi li'i grong khyer dang nye ba/ bi kra ma longs spyod kyi nags su gtso bor bzhugs/ bcud len kla pa sgrub par mdzad pas/ legs par 'grub ste sngar gyi ral ba sogs lhung / dgung lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can du gyur/ dam pa 'dis kyang bla ma de la gi rgyu na ta pa ra ma zhes bya ba'i go rak+ta'i lugs kyi dbang bskur gsan nas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha'i sgrub thabs kyang mang du gsan/ ḍi li dang / ṭi la dang / gor ṣa ṭa ri dang / ha ri dwa ra zhes bya ba/ 'phrog byed sgo yang zer ba ste byang phyogs kyi ri dang nye ba de rnams su yang thog re bzhugs shing / de ltar lo dgu tsam zhig skabs su rlud gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang / yang dag 'jog spel gyin mdzad/ phal cher slob dpon prad+ma nā tha zhes bya ba rig sngags kyi nus pas klu'i yul du byon par grags pa zhig dang / kriṣ+ṭha nā tha zhes bya ba dug sbrul —95—

gyis mid kyang gnod pa ma byung bar phyir thon pa'i rnal 'byor pa chen po de gnyis la yang gdams pa mang du gsan/ go rak+ta'i gsung / mahā ba da dang / su saX ba da zhes bya ba rig byed chen po dang / rang gi rig pa zhes bya ba nges don ston pa gnyis/ bhā ṇa hri kha la ste/ srog lu khur rgyad ces bya ba/ lus dang 'jig rten gyi rnam gzhag ston pa/ shā ṇa tan+t+ra te srog gi rgyud ces bya ba rnal 'byor gyi lam gtso bor ston pa zhig ste/ gzhung lugs de rnams 'dzin par myo4dzad cing /de dag gi bshad pa dang / nyams len gyi man ngag thor bu lnga bcu lhag tsam las tshogs mang po dang bcas pa la/ mkhas par sbyangs/ mtho dman bde sdug gi nyams kyi se/gas sel bogs 'don ji rnyed pa zhig zhus/ phan gnod kyi sngagasadang las tshogs/ gzhan yang mang du mkhyen cing grub par mdzad/ de nas sku yang dar la bab pa'i skabs yin pa'i/ da ni sgrub pa rtse gcig pa zhig bya dgos shing / sgro 'dogs thams cad bla ma bzhugs dus ma bcad na mi yongs dgongs te/ gan+ta mṛ ga'i mchod pa ste/ ngo bo ni tshogs kyi 'khor lo yin la/ dbang dang ga dmasang ga zab pa re la mchod pa de 'dra re/ gzhan yang rnyed bkur dang / ji rnyed pa'i yon rnams 'bul ba dang / ci gsung sgrub pa'i spyod lam gyis mnyes par mdzad de/ yang dang yang du dri lan gyi rnam par gtan la phab ste/ bla ma gsum po de'i gdam ngag gi sgro 'dogs chod par byung ngo / /go rak+ta'i rjes 'brang du grags pa dzo gi zhes zer ba la sde tshan bcu gnyis yod/ nā tha dzo/ pa wo dzo/ pak+ṣa sna/ go pā la sna/ pa ga la ze/ ā yi na/ tso li zi/ ho du sna/ dh+wa dza ra/ bhe ra gi pa/ mang ga la nā tha re/ bta nā tha sna/ zhes pa —96—

rnams so/ /snga ma'i nang sel/ nā ḍi shwa ri dzo ki zer ba'i sde gcig yod/ da lta yang nang pa zang ma yin/ bla ma ti zhi nā tha/ prad+ma nā tha/ spos nā tha gsum ka nā ṭi shwa ri'i sde yin no/ /de nas rje 'dis lo gcig ma la wa'i yul du ni sba'i bcud len zla ba drug kla pa zla ba drug bsten/ phyis sing ga li'i gling dang / dzha mi gi ri dang / dza ga grwa thar yang kla pa kyi sbyor ba zla ba bzhi re mdzad pas/ da lta dgung lo smin yang / lo sum cu tsam gyi na tshod du bzhugs pa 'di yin/ de skabs kyang / ma rus yul du ra 'o ra ste rgyal po'i mi gcig gis yon sbyar te/ spyil bu chung ngu zhig mdzad nas rtse gcig tu bsgoms/ mnal lam du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i rnam pa yang yang byung / res 'ga' mngon shes skye ba snyam byed pa dang / mi dang mi ma yin ci rigs pa'i lkog gyur gyi spyod pa mkhyen pa dang / de sogs yon to gyi sna mang du byung zhing / res 'ga' sku la zug zer sna tshogs ldang ba dang /thugs kyang mi bde zhing mtho dman du 'gyur ba sogs/ nyams mtho dman sna tshogs pa byung zhing / de thams cad kyang bla ma'i gdams ngag gis lam du btang / res 'ga' mnal lam du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rngang 'tshong ma zhig gi gzugs su 'ong nas/ gegs sel mdzad pa yang yang byung / de nas lo bzhi lnga tsam zhag re mal re mdzad cing rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas/ sgoms kyang mtho dman che bar byung zhing / lan cig nub phyogs sin skyi'i yul gyi grong khyer na ga ra ṭha ṭha zhes bya bar cung zad cig bzhugs pa'i skabs/ bsnyung ba drag pos drag tu bsnyung ste/ de yang je drag la 'chi ltas rnams kyang tshang bar byung bas/ 'chi —97—

ba'i gdams ngag bsgom dgos dgongs/ rtse gcig tu rlung bkag cing bsgom par mdzad pa na/ lan cig nyin zhag sbrel ma tsam thugs dran med du song zhing /zhal dbugs kyi 'gyu ba'ang chad/ de kha'i ngang nas thugs gsal rig bde nyams dang bcas pa rnyed cing / de ka yang yun ring rab bar du ma sad/ de nas sad tsam na bsnyung ba kun drag de nas bzung nas/ gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin phal cher rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / tshul mi bying ba sogs thun mong gi yon tan ci rigs pa shar pa 'di byung gsung / de rjes sin dha'i gnas chen mjal bar bzhed de phebs pa/ na ga ra ṭha ṭha nas gnas chen gyi bar du nyin lam dgu la yul stong pa 'ba' zhig yin cing / gcan gzan dang chom po sogs 'jigs pa che/ khyad par zas g.yos su byas pa ci rigs pa khur yang nyes pa med/ rdzas g.yin khab dang skud pa re yod na'ang / chom po rnams kyis nges par 'phrog cing / brdung ba dang gsod pa'i bar du byed pa zhig yod/ der phebs dus nags tshal zhig tu/ stag gcig drung du rgyugs byung ba/ de gzigs pa la brten nas rmi lam lta bur bden med du myom song bas stag kyang log /yang lam zhig tu nags kyi khyi zhig gis rmugs pas sku la rma byung zhing / nyin gcig zug zer che bar yod pa lam du khyer zhing bsgoms pas/ nam phyed tsam na zug zer zhi zhing rma yang shul med du song / gnas chen nyid du phebs nas/ de na lha mo hing ga lwa rti zhes bya ba/ lha mo u ma'i rten rang byung zhig yod pa/ de'i drung du zhag 'ga' bzhugs pas/ nub snga ma cho 'phrul cher byung zhing / gnyis pa la tho rangs kyi dus tsam na/ rdo sku nyid bud med rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i rnam par song / phyag byed —98—

pa ni med/ yo byad mang po 'bul ba ltar byung / de na re/ rnal 'byor pa nga rgyal cher mi rung / grub pa ma yin pa la nga phyag mi 'tshal/ ting nge 'dzin cung zad tsam 'dug yo byad ni spyin gyi zer/ de skabs nga sangs rgyas pa'i rnal 'byor pa nus pa thob pa yin pas/ mu stegs pa'i lha chen pos kyang phyag 'tshal lam dgongs pa thugs la yod pas/ de shes par 'dug /lar de dus rgyud sde mang po ma thos pas/ yon tan chung ngu la nga rgyal chen po yod gsungs/ tshur lam/ lam du chom rkun mang pos sku la dbyug pa brdeg pa sogs byung bas/ de rnams lus sbyong bzhin du song nas rtsa mdud grol/ sku lus ches yang bar gyur nas zhag dgu'i lam nyi ma lnga la chod nas/ slar na ga ra ṭha ṭha ra phebs/ de nas byang phyogs la byon te/ grong khyer mo la tā na dang / ka bhe la dang / kho rā swā na dang /ba dza swā na dang / go ṣa la sogs par thog re thog re bzhugs shing / yul de dag gi mi phal cher mong gol te/ stod hor kla klo stag gzig gi rigs yin pas/ thog mar phebs tsa na co 'dri ba dang / gnod pa re byed pa byung / drag sngags kyi mthur mngon pa'am/ rdzas sngags kyi mig 'phrul cung zad re bstan tsa na/ mgu bar 'dug gsung / de rnams kla klo sdig spyod kyi yul yin yang / nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul dang 'brel bas/ zhing gi rnal 'byor ma shin tu mang bar 'dug gsung / de nas nub phyogs o rgyan du phebs/ sang sla ta'i skad du au ḍi ya ṇa/ rang bzhin skad du o rgyan zer/ ḍa dang ra 'don tshul 'dra min yod pas/au ra ya ṇa zer ba 'dra cig yod/ de la bod yig 'khrul gzhi rgya 'byams nas/u rgyan du song gda' na bod skad rang la grags pa'i tshad mar bya dgos dgag —99—

tu med/ da lta de phyogs rang na kla kle'i skad du grags pa kun gyis go ba la/yul ga dza ni zer ro/ grub chen lwa ba'i na bza' can gyi phug pa dang / rgyal po in+d+ra bhā ta'i pho brang gi shul dang / i lo bar pa ta zhes bya ba'i gnas chen rnams snyi phebs/ o rgyan gyi gnas mthil dhu ma sbyir ste/ du ba'i gnas zhes bya ba'i grong khyer zhig tu zla gcig tsam bzhugs/ spyir o rgyan gyi gnas mthil de ri rong dang nags 'thug pos mtha' bskor pa'i dbus na thang khor tsam pa shar nub tu nyin lam gnyis tsam/ lho byang du bzhi tsam/ grong khyer ni dhu ma sbyir gcig pur 'dug de yang rgya gar gyi grong khyer chung la gtogs pa tsam yin/ gzhan ghā ma ghā ma 'dra 'dug gsungs/ gnas mthil de ma gtogs pa'i sgo bzhi sogs o rgyan gyi phyi'i yul ni shin tu ltos che bar 'dug kla kle'i yul yin rung gnas mthil na yang da lta dge 'dun gyi sde ni med/ gzhi sdod rnal 'byor pa'i sde dang /dge bsnyen dang / mu stegs dang / kla klo sogs kyang mi 'dug bud med phal cher ni mkha' 'gro ma'i rigs can du yod par snang ste/ phan gnod kyi sngags kyi nus mthu chen po grub pa dang / gzugs sna tshogs su bsgyur ba dang / lta stangs kyi nus pa yod pa dang / cho 'phrul ston nus pa'i rigs can shin tu mang ba gzigs 'dug cing / sngon chad stod hor dang / a ka pa ra pā tsas sogs kyi lung mi 'gro ba yang / sngags kyis bsrungs pa'i nus mthu 'ba' zhig yin gsungs/ gnas 'di shar dang lho dang nub rnams mtsho gsum gyis bskor/shar gyi dang lho'i rgya mtsho'i lag brgal nas 'ongs na hor kla klo bha lag kha'i yul du sleb 'ong / de'i sa phyogs gcig na slob dpon rta mchog gi sprul pa ma —100—

bsdus par grags pa'i nam mkha' thag ring po na rta'i gzugs brnyan zhig dang /lwa ba pas mkha' 'gro ma'i rdo char bzlog ste nam mkha' la chags par mdzad pa'i pha bong zhig brag gi ngos zhig dang nye ba'i gnas la rten med du gnas pa dang / gzhan pha bong che chung mang po brag la cung zad 'byar pa'i tshul gyis ram me gnas pa dang / pad+ma badz+ra kyi thugs dam he ru ka'i lha khang sogs ngo mtshar can gyi gnas thams cad mjal/ sngon grub chen grags che ba phal cher gyi gnas re yod gsung / lan gcig lam du 'gro ba'i bu mo gcig /chu ha cang che ba ma yin pa zhig gi 'gram du/ bye ma la sngags bzlas nas chu la gtor song bas/ chu'i rgyun chad de/ de'i bar la song / slar yang chu sngar bzhin 'bab pa dang / yang bud med zhig bya ma bya'i gzugs su bsgyur nas/ nam mkha' la 'phur te thag ring po'i shing zhig la babs song / de sogs 'jigs shing ngo mtshar ba mang po 'dug gsung / 'on kyang zhing gi rnal 'byor ma'i cho 'phrul de dag ni rje nyid kyi gzigs pa yin gyi skye bo phal bas mthong pa'i spyod yul min nam snyam mo/ /dhu mnyi rar bzhugs pa'i skabs smig sgyu la sogs pa'i rtags lnga rgyud nas gsungs pa bzhin du/ shin tu gsal zhing brtan par byung / rang dang snang ba thams cad rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor du rang shar la snang ba zhag gsum tsam nyin mtshan 'bral med du byung mod/ phyis yang yal song gsung / de nas rim gyis/ stod hor gyi yul mang po brgyud nas kha cher phebs sa ra dā dang na ra dā sogs mu stegs kyi gnas rnams su byon/ shin tu 'tshub cing thugs dam yang gong 'phel du byung / dha ra ta bho ṭa ste nang khom du grags pa dang / kas —101—

kā ra zhes grags pa bod la rgyug pa'i stod hor gyi yul rnams su byon/ bod dang li yul gyis so mtshams dang / par sig gi bar mtshams dang / kha che dang mong gol gyi yul 'di kun la kho rang yul skad du chag so zer ro/ /slar yang bla ma tirbi nā tha mjal du phebs/ lo rgyus zhus pas shin tu dges par byung / yang ḍi li nas lto la phebs te/ bhi me shwa ra zhes bya ba/ dbang phyug gi lha khang stong pa zhig tu bzhugs pas/ srod kyi thun la ro langs mang po lag tu dbyug pa thogs te/ gnod pa skyel du byung ba la/ thugs g.yo ba med pa dang / rlud bkag ste bzhugs pas/ de rnams dras dum du sil gyis zhig /de ma thag tu 'brug sgra tsam gyi sgra zhig grags pa dang mnyam du bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin la song ste/ nyi ma shar ba'i bar ma sad/ de nas kyang zhag mang po'i bar du sku lus bde ba chen pos gang / de yan chad du lo bcu drug tsam gtso bor bsgom bzlas dang / rlung dang sems gnas kyang ma chag par mdzad/ 'di nas rlud ci rigs par las su rung bar byung bas 'di phyin rdzogs rim gtso bor mdzad gsung / de nas lho phyogs dang nye ba u shir zhes bya ba/ yul chung ngu zhig na/ rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyi lha khang mar me mdzad bzang pos rab gnas mdzad pa/ da lta lung stong na yod cing / grong khyer ba'i mi rnams kyi rkyen sel du lo re bzhin mchod pa chen po yod pa/ yul chos dang bstun pa'i grong khyer ba rnams kyis ni/ khrag mchod byed pa zhig yod pa der yun ring po bzhugs/ lan gcig bde nyams gcig gis rkyen byas te/ nyin zhag drug tsam ting nge 'dzin thun gcig la song zhing / phyi'i snang ba thams cad 'gags/ nang bde stong gi nyams khyad par can la rtse gcig —102—

tu gnas par 'dug gsung / 'di phyin dwangs ma rags pa brtan cing dbang thob pa byung / de nas ma rur phebs pad+ma badz+ra gyis bzhengs pa'i kyai rdo rje'i lha khang /dam tshig nyams pas zhal ras mthong na khrag skyug par grags pa de mjal/ de nas ā bha 'a mu stegs kyi gnas dang / yul so pa ni na ma si ta ste kla kle'i lha khang zhig tu smo brdzus mdzad cing thog rer bzhugs/ yul kad tsa ru bla ma to | nā tha phebs pa gsan te mjal du byon/ zhag gsum tsam bzhugs/ bla ma de lho phyogs su phebs song / yul so ra nir so ba nā tha ste dbang phyug gi liṅga dang / bi rū pa'i rdo sku rang byung yang mjal bar mdzad/ lho phyogs sa he ra bhi thang zhes pa'i grong khyer/ lam srang rang la yang nyin lam gsum bzhi tsam 'gro dgos pa zhig yod pa der/ dbyar zhig bzhugs pas thugs dam shin tu 'phel zhing rgyu 'gru/la zhig la phebs pa la/ smad 'tshong ma zhig gis khrus byas pa'i khrus khu khang steng nas pho ba dbu la phog pas/ de/ dang mnyam du/ bidz+nyā na dz+nyā na/ a brdzi ta bi brdzi snya zhes rnam shes dang ye shes spang bya dang spong byed med ces pa'i sgra grags pa yang gsan pas/ de nyid du lta ba la nges shes chen po brnyes/ de ni ye shes kyi rnal 'byor ma zhig yin pa 'dug gsung / lho phyogs mthil gyi phyi nang gi gnas phal cher du phebs shing / snga phyir bgyis na lto phyogs kyi yul gru thams cad du ma byon pa tsam med/ de yang mar ha ṭa dang / ji na de sa dang / taX ba la dang / bi rtswa na ga ra dang / kaṇi ṭa ka dang / tri liṅga dang / tri mal dang / tsarnyi dang /ma phywa ra dang / tsā ri tra dang / ma rba ra dang / ko du na dang / tsi ba la dang / ni tsā mas dang / ni dra ha ra dang / tsan+d+ra du ra dang / pañca bha tā ra dang / tsa ra maṇ+ḍal —103—

dang / mo ra maṇ+ḍal dang / dza la maṇ+ḍal dang / ta la maṇ+ḍal dang / tuṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍa 'a/ dang / bho ga ma skyo ra dang / ka liṅka dang / g.yin yang yul phran sna tshogs pa de dag ni/ lho phyogs mthil yin no/ /de nas koṅka na nas/ rgya mtsho la nub phyogs su gru btang nas byon pas/ 'gro lding gi gling ste/ rgya skad du/ ḍa mi sko di pa zhes par phebs/ 'di la kla klo dang yul mtha'i mi dang / gling phran pa rnams kyi skad du/ sam lo ra na so zer gyin gda'/ gling de na gsang sngags kyi bstan pa tshes dar ba yod/ mngon shes dang ldan pa'i slob dpon su ma ti zhes bya ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta gcig la/ bde mchog dang / dgyes rdor gyi dbang gsan nas/ dgyes rdor gyi rgyud la bshad pa'ang zhib rgyas su gsan/ dgyes rdor 'di slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi lugs yin cing / spyir gling de na rgyud sde bzhi ka'i bka' ma chad pa dang / khyad par bla med ches dar dus 'khor ma gtogs rgya gar na yod pa phal cher de na yod/ phur bu dang khro bo bcu'i rgyud dang / he ru ka'i rgyud mang po dang / phyag na rdo rje dang mkha' lding dang / ma mo dang nag po chen po sogs dang / rta mgrin bla med kyi rigs rgya gar na med pa mang po yang de na yod pa dang / slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas nas brgyud pa'i chos kyang mang bar yod 'dug dge 'dun mang po yod kyang 'dul ba'i lag len dag po med de/dge slong rnams gos nag gyon pa phal cher chang 'thung ba sogs yod par 'dug go /gling der lo gcig tsam nas bla ma de sku 'das pas/ rgyud kyi 'phros yang bag tsam ma rdzogs shing / man ngag kyang gsan ma thub pas/ slob dpon de'i sras mo rnal 'byor ma nus pa thob pa/ ma ti swa sī zhes bya ba zhig la chos kyi 'phro —104—

rnams gsan/ de nas slar tsho lnga pa dang lhan cig grur zhugs nas shang kha dī pa ste/ dung gi gling du phebs/ de na bde 'byung gi gnas zhes bya ba/ ri bo sman sna tshogs skye ba zhig 'dug /der thog gcig bzhugs/ gling de na/ ga dza nā sa zhes bya ba'i gling nas 'ongs pa'i mi gdong mi la/ sna glang po che lta bur yod pa mang po gzigs/ de nas lhor byon pa la/ pā la ta zhes bya ba'i gling du phebs/ de nas shar phyogs su gru btang bas/ sing ga li'i gling du phebs te der lo lnga tsam bzhugs/ gling de ni/ dge 'dun gyi sde mang zhing / chos kyang dar la/ shin tu 'byor pa che zhing / skyid pa yin te/ dza lī musti ta lī ma ṇi ka ra ne ba ne kuñja ra gha ri gha re pad+ma nī nā ri/ bha lwa de sha siṅga la zhes pa ste/ chu rnams mu tig dwangs gzhi nor bus gang ba/ nags rnams glang po ches gang ba/ khyim thams cad bud med pad+ma can gyis gang ba zer te/ don la'ang phyogs 'dra 'dug gling de rgya khyon yang shin tu che bar 'dug ste/ thams cad zhabs kyis bcags gsungs/ shrī bā du ka zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs rjes bzhugs pa la/ theg bdun tsam gsol ba 'debs par mdzad pas/ zhabs rjes nas 'od zer mang po 'phros nas sku lus la thim pa'i snang ba byung / kan ḍa la zhes bya ba'i yul zhig gi phu/ nags 'thugs po zhig gi dbus na brag phug 'dug /de na sngon slob dpon chen po shan+ti pas siṅga li'i gling du phebs pa'i dus kyi dngos slob/ ma shā ka ra shan+ti bod skad du grags pa'i 'byung gnas zhi ba zhes bya ba/ dgung lo bdun brgya yang lhag lon pa zhig bzhugs pa/ slob ma gcig ma gtogs pa phal cher la mi mjal na'ang / rje 'dis phug pa'i sgo drung du bzhugs pas nang —105—

du byon gsung mjal bas shin tu dges shing / chos 'brel zhig kyang gsan/ de yang grub pa yin gyi phal pa chos mthong ba rang cig min par sems/ rgyal po rā he shing kha bhan ṭa ri la/ chos kyi gleng ba gsungs pas/ mchog tu mgu ba thob par byung / gling de nas gru btang nas u liṅga zhes bya ba'i gling phran zhig tu cung zad bzhugs/ de nas yang yul de'i snang ba 'ga' zhig dang lhan cig tu/ a mu ka zhes bya ba'i gling phran zhig tu phebs/ 'di phan chad du ni rje nyid rang ma gtogs 'dzam bu gling gi mi 'gro ba med pa lta bu yin gsung zhing / sing ga la'i gling nas da bar zhag sum cu lhag tsam re rgya mtsho la gzings gtong dgos gnyis dang / gling gnyis po de la'ang zla lam tsam re yod gsungs/ de nas gling de dag gi mi dang lhan cig gru bo che bzo khyad chos phun sum tshogs pa zhig tu/mi stong phrag lnga tsam dang lhan cig lho phyogs la gru bskyod de byon pas/ zla ba bzhi tsam na/ dzha mi gi ri zhes bya ba'i gling ches bzang ba/ zhing la sogs pa med cing / 'bras 'bru re btab pa la sdong po mi 'grang lnga tsam yod pa/ khyim re'i 'tsho ba thams cad 'byung ba tsam yod pa/ grong khyer chen po lho byang gnyis snang zhing / de gnyis re re'i srang bar la nyi ma bdun bdun tsam re 'gro dgos pa'i lam yod pa/ grong khyer gnyis kyi bar na ri lho byang du gsum tsam zhig 'dug pa'i gcig gi rtse mo na mtshan mo 'od 'phro ba'i gser gyi brag chung ngu zhig kyang snang gsung / der lo gcig lhag tsam bzhugs shing / gling de na sngon slob dpon klu sgrub phebs pa'i bzhugs khri dang / bcom ldan 'das kyi rdo sku chen po mang po dang / lha khang yang mang du yod cing / de rnams la mchod pa dang / dus —106—

ston yang che bar yod/ klu sgrub kyis bzhengs pa'i lha khang zhig tu rtse gcig tu thugs dam mdzad pas/ bde ba can nas slob dpon klu sgrub 'khor mang po dang bcas nas byon pa gzigs shing / de yang sku'i rnam pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag sor re la'ang dpag tshad tsam yod pa blta ba'i mi ngom pa zhig gzigs shing / dag snang gi chos kyang 'ga' re gsan no/ /de la ye shes kyi sku gzigs pa 'di ni gsang 'dus las/ tshangs pa drag po la sogs lhas/ /nam yang mthong bar mi nus so/ /zhes lha mthu che rnams kyis kyang mthong bar dka' ba yin pas/ mngon par rtogs pa ci tsam yin rgyud sde mkhyen pa rnams kyis gsungs shig de nas shar phyogs kyi gling phran 'gar 'gro ba'i tshong ba rnams dang lhan cig gru shar drang thad du btang ste zla gcig tsam phebs pa na/ ri'i rgyal po po ṭa la ka yod pa'i gling du phebs/ kha cig 'di po ṭa la chung ba yin zer ba'ang yod/ gang na'ang mi'i 'gro ba'i spyod yul gyi po ṭa la ste 'di kho nar mngon no/ /nor bzang gzhon nu'i gnas shel gyi phug pa dang / khro gnyer can ma'i gnas dang / lha ma yin gyi sgo gser gyi phug pa dang / sgrol ma'i gnas seng ldeng gi nags dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po'i gnas ri bo rang byung gi lha khang dang bcas pa re re/ gzhan yang mjal du btub pa'i gnas phal cher mjal/ ri bo po ṭa la nyid la'ang bskor ba zhig mdzad/'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi gnas su grags pa/ nam mkha'i ngos la nags tshal dang / de nas 'bab pa'i chu dngos su 'bab pa yod de/ de la khrus kyang —107—

mdzad gsungs/ po ṭa la'i ri chen po'i mgul thugs par nags sna tshogs 'dug pa bskor bar phebs/ rtse mo shel ma rdo'i brag ri rgya dpangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa la da lta 'gro sa ni mi 'dug gsung/ gling der phyin pa'i sdig pa dag pa 'dra/ de phyin chad tha mal gyi mnal gtan med pa dang / mi ma yin phal mo che zhig gi spyod pa mngon sum du gzigs pa dang / de dag gi longs spyod la dngos su longs spyod byar gyur pa 'di byung gsung / gling de'i mi kun la da lta phyi nang kla klo sogs grub mtha' gang yang med/ mi grong yang than thun ma gtogs mi 'dug po ṭa la ka la gsol ba 'debs pa la shin tu brtson par 'dug sngon dus bzhengs pa'i sangs rgyas pa'i lha khang yod/ 'dzam bu gling na med pa la/ las las grub pa'i 'khrul 'khor mang pos khyim gyi mtha' bsrung ba 'ba' zhig 'dug gling 'dir gling g.yin nas 'ongs pa'i mi rna bas lus thams cad g.yog thub pa mang po gzigs/ gling de nas gru btang ste thag ring po byang phyogs su byon pas/ dza ba dī pa zhes bya ba/ nas gling du phebs/ gling de na nyan thos sen+ta pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde mang du yod cing / de rnams su ma bzhugs/ de na mtsho chung zhig gi dkyil na gling chung zhig yod de/ de'i ming ni/ ba na dī pa ste/nags gling zhes bya ba yin/ de na slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rjes byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ phyi brag ri nang lha khang gru bzhir yod pa/ dbus na kyai rdo rje phyag gnyis pa'i rdo sku rang byung bzhugs shing / phug pa gcig na gsang sngags kyi glegs bam mang du yod/ rgyud 'bum phrag lnga pa yang bzhugs zer te/ shin tu 'tshub par grags pas lta nus pa ni mi 'dug gsung / de nas slar yang byang —108—

la phebs te/ siṅga lar phebs/ de dus sangs rgyas kyi zhabs rjes la gsol ba 'debs shing bzhugs/ der rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor gtso bor mdzad pas/tha mal gyi rnam rtog phal cher 'gags/ bde bas nyin mtshan ngo mi mkhyen pa 'dra ba'ang byung / de phyin zhu bde 'gyur med bstan pas bde stong rgyun mi 'chad pa byung la/ lan gcig mnal lam na/ rang nyid rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku shin tu che bar gyur pa la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas yin snyams pa sangs rgyas mang po byon te/ khyod ni 'chi ba med pa'i sku'o zhes bstod pa'i snang ba byung / de nas koṅka na'i gling du phebs te/ dz+nyā na kā ya zhes bya ba/ mtsho'i nang na 'jam dpal gyi sku rang byung / sku tshad ri chung tsam yod pa nyal stabs su gnas pa dang / bi spa kā ya zhes bya ba/ nam mkha' la 'ja' tsho ni shar ba lta bu/ mchod rten gyi gzugs brnyan shin tu che zhing gsal ba dpal du ba 'khrigs pa reg pa med pa'i mchod rten du grags pa de yin te/ de gnyis la nyin mtshan dus drug tu rol mo dang / dri bza' dang / me tog gi char 'bab pa la sogs pa mi ma yin gyi mchod pa rtag tu 'ong / cho 'phrul rgyun mi 'chad pa zhig yod pa de dag tu phyag mchod dang smon lam mdzad/ slar gru btang nas lho phyogs ma phywa rar phebs/'di dang nye ba'i yul phran shaX bhu dat+ta zhes bya ba na/ rdo rje thegs pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa/ thun mong gi grub pa'i rtags ci rigs pa dang ldan pa'i rgyal po 'phrog byed 'od ces bya ba la/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud dang / sdom pa rnam par brtson pa dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i de nyid dang / ha ri dā ri'i glu dbyangs la sogs pa chos mang du gsan/ bla ma 'di ni rnal 'byor ma dī na ka 109—

ri'i zhung po yin no/ /der grub chen zhi ba sbas pa'i snyan pa gsan te/ dza gad nā thar thog mar mjal bar phebs zla ba gsum tsam bla ma'i rim gro bgyid cing bzhugs/ sngar gyi bla ma gzhan rnams la gdams ngag zhus shing bsgoms pa bas/ grub chen 'di'i zhal ras mthong ba tsam yang bogs che bar byung zhing / yo byad thams cad yon dang / tshogs kyi 'khor lor byas te/ gdams ngag gnang dgos par zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas dbang bskur dgos pas da rung yo byad tshol gsungs/ de nas tri liṅka phyogs su zla ba gsum tsam sdom bu byed cing byon pas/ ru pya ste/ dngul to la sum cu tsam dang / gzhan yang yo byad mang du byung /tri mal zhes bya ba tsan+dan dmar po'i nags kyis khyab pa'i yul zhig tu'ang byon/der yang yo byad mang po 'byor/ bla ma yang kaṇ+ḍa ṭa kar phebs 'dug pas/ drung du phebs/ dbang gi yo byad thams cad legs par bshams/ dmigs pa'i sgo nas dbang bskur zhig mdzad/ gdams pa ci rig pa gnang / de skabs dbang bskur tha dad mang po ni/ slob dpon gaX bhi rā ma ti la zhus/ de nas shar phyogs kyi gling phran rnams gzigs par bzhed nas/ dzā ri khaṇ+ḍa dang / dza ga da nā tha rgyud nas bha ṅga lar phebs/ yul puṇ+ḍa bha rta ru kha sa chu ṇi mjal/ zhag nyi shu tsam gsol ba 'debs kyin bzhugs/ mnal lam du byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshan ma yang yang byung / de nas ti pu rar phebs/ ti pu ra'i yul gyi phu/ ka sa raX ga'am/ de wi go ṭa'i gnas yod pa mjal par mdzad cing / grub chen nag po spyod pas bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang du zhag shas bzhugs/ yul 'di yang o rgyan bzhin du/ gzugs sna tshogs su bsgyur ba'i mkha' 'gro ma gdug tshub —110—

che ba mang po yod cing / stag rdzus dang / sna tshogs pa'i rdzas dang sngags kyi ngan thabs byed pa shin tu mang / de nas ra khang gi yul gyi nang tshan/ ha ri bhañja dang /pu khang dang / bal gu rnams su phebs/ yul 'di rnams na dge slong gi dge 'dun ches mang zhing / bstan pa lhag par dar bar yod pas/ yun ring rab re bzhugs shing / ha ri bha nye'i gtsug lag khang mchod rten chen po zhes bya ba zhig na/ dharmā k+ṣa sto ṣa zhes bya ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po zhig dang / de bzhin du bal gu'i yul du bzhus pa'i bar he tan sde sgo ṣa zhes bya ba/ dge bsnyen paṇ+ḍi ta chen po zhig la gsang sngags kyi chos kyang ci rigs pa gsan/ mdo lugs kyi gzhung mang po zhor nyan du mdzad/ bla ma 'di kun yang grub chen zhi ba'i zhabs kyis slob ma 'ba' zhig yin gsung / de nas gru btang ste/ dha na shrī gling du phebs/gling 'di nang dge 'dun shin tu mang zhing / dpal ldan 'bras sbung ngam/ mchod rten dpal yon can zhes kyang bya/ a stu ka kā ya zhes bya ba mchod rten chen po ngo bo shin tu rgya khyon che ba'i brag ri mchod rten gyi dbyibs can/ phyi la rdo'i lcags ri brag ri 'dra ba nyis rim gyis bskor ba/ nyi ma gcig la skor ba thebs tsam/shar du grong khyer shin tu che ba/ rgya nag dang / phreng gi dang / rgya gar la sogs pa'i yul tha dad pa'i tshong ba shin tu mang pa'i tshong 'dus chen po 'dug gsung /dang po reg pa med pa gzugs brnyan gyi mchod rten mjal bar mdzad dus/rnam snang gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor dang / dz+nyā na kā ya ni/ 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor dang / shrī dha rgyu ka ṭa ka ni mi bskyod pa gtso bor byas pa'i rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor du gzigs/—111—

gzhan yang tshong pa rnams dang lhan cig tu byon pas/ po ṭa la zer ba'i rgya mtsho'i do ri ga po gcig dang / pi gu'i gling dang / dza ti dang li shi sogs mang po skye ba/phreng gis 'dzin pa'i gling zhig dang / swadha dhī pa dang / gser gling chen po dang /gser gling gi ming can chung ba gnyis/ su rdza dhī pa/ tsan+d+ra dhī pa/ sarba dhī pa ste/gling chung chung de rnams su yang zhabs kyis bcags/ de nas gaX ga sa ga ra zhes bya ba'i gling chung zhig tu nag po spyod chung dang / bhu ba ri pa dang / bhu ba blo ldan rnams rim par byon sa'i dgon pa zhig na slob dpon nag po spyod pa pa'i rgyan drug mkha' 'gro mas byin gyis brlabs pa de mtshan mo me 'bar ba sogs cho 'phrul dang 'tshub shin tu che ba cig 'dug pa de yang mjal/ der dbyar zhig zla ba gsum gtum mo dang / phyag rgya chen po rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas/ gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro ma'i rigs su gtogs pa mang po dang / khyad par mi ma yin gyis mkha' 'gro ma mang po dngos su 'du ba byung / de dag gi rkyen gyis ye shes gong nas gong du 'phel zhing / rtog pa khyad par du gyur/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po zhi ba sbas pa la/ de rnams kyis rtogs pa 'bul bar bzhed nas/gzengs la bskyod de/ dzam bu gling du phebs par bzhed pa'i lam gling phran chung ngu zhig na/ sngon 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug seṅge sgras thugs bskyed pa'i gnas su grags pa/ gling stong pa zhig na nor bu dmar po 'dra ba'i rdo'i phug pa dang / tsan+dan gyi nags tshal yang yod pa/ shin tu gnyan pas 'dab ma re yang gcod mi nus pa zhig yod pa de mjal du phebs/ de na grub chen zhi ba'i zhabs kyi gdams pa'i mnga' bdag rnal 'byor ma chen mo dī na ka rā/—112—

'khor rnal 'byor pho mo bzhi bcu tsam dang bcas pa bzhugs 'dug pa la/gdams ngag gnang bar zhus pas/ mang du gnang zhing / de nas rnal 'byor ma chen mo de nyid kyi zhabs pad bsten bzhin du/ tri liṅga dang / bi du na ga ra dang /kaṇi ṭa ka rnams brgyud nas/ bhaX dwa gyi yul du phebs/ dzam bu gling ba thams cad kyi skyabs gnas gcig pu grub chen zhi ba sbas pa dang mjal/ zla ba bcu gsum tsam drung du bzhugs/ gdams pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan/ mtshan ni brnya gubha gyis gsung bas de phyin brnya gup+ta nā tha zer/ dbang bskur dang bshad pa phal che ba ni rnal 'byor ma chen mo dī na kā ra dang / slob dpon gam bhi ra ya ti chen po gnyis la zhus shing / phyag len dang dogs dpyod ci rigs pa zhu bar mdzad pa'i bla ma ni/ gzhan yang mang du yod pa/ su dhī gar+bha zhes bya ba dang / kan+ta pa zhes bya ba dang / be ta tik+ṣa ṇa dang / bī ra ban+ta dang / gha gha pa ste/de rnams kyang grub chen zhi ba sbas pa'i zhabs 'bring bsten pas/ rdo rje'i thegs pa la ches mkhas shing / khyad par nus pa brnyes pa sha stag yin te/ spyir grub chen 'di'i drung du/ yul dang rigs la sogs pa skye bo gzhan gyis bshad rgyu med pa'i rnal 'byor ba rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa ngo mtshar can ston pa mang du 'ong zhing / yang gar song cha med par song ba/ de lta bu yang yang yod pa zhig 'dug gsungs/ lan cig kha ge rgyu'i ri sul zhig na rnal 'byor ba zhig mar me sbar te 'dug drung du byon pa'i de'i snang bar yal shul na mi thod skam po gsum 'dug gsung / de ni mig sman grub pa'o/ /de nas grub chen zhi ba sbas pa'i gsung gis/ yul dbus kyi phyogs su sgom du songs zhig thugs dam gyi bogs che —113—

bar 'ong zhes gsungs pa zhig byung bas/ dbus kyi phyogs su phebs/ mahā bho dhi mjal bar mdzad/ rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs rgyang tsam gcig tu sgom khang zhig mdzad/ zla ba gcig tsam bzhugs shing / nyin mo ting nge 'dzin kho na dang /mtshan mo phyag dang skor ba 'ba' zhig mdzad/ thugs kyi snang ba la/ rang nyid mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas pa yin snyam pa dang / sku lus rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam pa shin tu sku tshad che ba/ sgra dang 'od du ma dang bcas par gyur/ byang chub chen po bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa dngos kyi rnam par gyur te/ khyod ni ta thā ga ta rat+na spa ra pra dī pa zhes bya ba yin no/ /zhes lung ston pa dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas mang po byon te/ rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod sprul pa ste sprul pa lta bus sems can gyi don mdzod cig /ces gsung ba'i snang ba byung / de nyid du bde stong gi ye shes 'od gsal mu mtha' med pa la yun ring du gnas pa byung zhing /de nas rim gyis gnas chen po brgyad po rnams bskor ba la yang phebs/thams cad du thugs dam gyi bogs shin tu che ba byung / bya rgod phung po'i ri dang /ri bya rkang yang mjal/ slar yang rtogs pa 'bul ba la/ grub chen zhi ba'i zhabs kyi drung du phebs/ 'di skabs/ bhaX dwa gyi rgyal po gzhon nu ba la bha dra 'dis/ grub thob chen po 'khor bcas la tshogs kyi 'khor lo mdzad pa'i gsol ba gdab pa'i don du ston mo zhig mdzad pa dang 'dzom/ sngar gyi rtogs pa rnams phul zhing / sangs rgyas dngos su gzigs pa'i mos gus spros pa'i rnam pa thams cad dang bral ba thugs pa 'khrungs te/ sngon med pa'i mos gus kyi nus mthu 'dis/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin spros pa thams dang bral ba/—114—

gcig min du ma ma yin pa brjod bral nam mkha' lta bu mngon du gyur/ phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa tshad du phyin/ nang kun dha dbu ma'i nang 'khor lo rnams su brtan pa thob pas rtsa mdud grol ba'i rtags thob/ rnal 'byor ba'i grar su chud pa 'di de nas byung ba yin gsung / bla ma tirbi nā tha dang lan rting ma mjal ba'i dus de nas/ de bar du lo bzhi bcu zhe drug song gsung / lar kho bo sgom yu na shin tu ring yang / gnas skor yang g.yeng ba'i rgyur song ba 'dra/ khyad par grub chen zhi ba sbas pa 'di dang ma mjal bar du bla ma gzhan rnams dang cung zad las 'phro chung ba yin na/ thun mong gi yon tan 'ga' las gnas lugs kyi don la 'gyur ba med pa'i gdeng ma thob/ spyir yang ḍa mi tor dgyes pa'i rdo rje ma gsan bar du sangs rgyas pa'i man ngag rgyud dang 'brel ba'i khung ma rang tsho ma lon pas kyang yin pa 'dra'o gsung / o rgyan nas phyir byon dus/ da nga rnal 'byor pa chen po yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal chen po byung / gzhan khyad du gsod pa'i sems skyes pas kyang / de nas lo bcu gnyis tsam du sgom la skyed chen po ma byung zhes dang / lan cig dzha mi gi ri'i gling du dad par bya dgos pa'i yul 'ga' zhig la smad pas kyang / dngos grub rang du 'gyang bar 'dug gsung / de dag kyang bdag cag la sogs pa gya gyur spyod pa rnams/ lam la 'bad par gdams pa'i dgongs pa can yin gyi/ gzhan du na/ dam pa 'di nyid grub pa'i dbang phyug lwa ba'i na bza' can dang gnyis su med par 'khums so/ /de skabs zla ba gsum tsam du slob dpon mchog la gdams pa'i 'phro mang du gsan/ de mtshams nas/ kha gen+t+ra'i ri bor tshogs kyi khang pa rgya chen po zhig —115—

bzhengs/ rim pas slob dpon zhi ba'i zhabs kyi slob ma/ gsang sngags spyod pa thams cad 'dus te/ slar yang zla ba gsum tsam na/ rnal 'byor pho mo stong phrag lnga tsam byung ste/ rgyal pos kyang nyin re bzhin du dngul to la stong phrag drug drug gi rin thang gi tshogs kyi yo byad dang / gzhan yang nyer mkhe'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa 'bul zhing / dpon slob rnams kyi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor rgya chen po mdzad de/ nyin mo'i cha la phal cher gdams ngag 'bogs pa dang / so sor mnyam par bzhag pas gnas pa dang / rgyud sde zab mo dang sngags kyi gzhung mtha' yas pa rnams 'chad pa'ang shin tu mang la/mtshan mo'i cha la 'khor lo'i mchod pas dus 'da' bar mdzad/ zla ba re re bzhin rgyal po nyid kyang 'ongs te/ der 'dus thams cad la gos mchog phrugs re dang / dngul srang bzhi bzhi'i yon phul zhing / zla ba drug song ba'i rjes su/rnal 'byor pa re re la yang gser mo har bcu phrag re sogs yon gyi rnam pa ni mtha' yas pa zhig gis mchod par byas te/ phyi rabs lo lnga brgya tshun chad la 'phags pa'i yul du rdo rje theg pa'i chos 'khor 'di bas che ba ma byung / grub thob zhi ba'i zhabs kyi gdams pa la brten nas/ mkhas pa rnams kyis rgyud sde 'chad pa dang / nus pa cung zad rnyed pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams las tshogs dang dngos grub sgrub pa mang po byung ste/ dam pa 'dis gzigs pa la yang dngu8 chu grub pa bcu gnyis tsam dang / mi snang bar gyur pa yang drug tsam dang / dngos grub phra mo dang / las tshogs grub pa ni dpag tu med pa 'dug gsung / de nas tshogs pa shas che ba ni so sor gyes shing / rnal 'byor pho mo sum brgya tsam zhig —116—

slar yang zla ba bzhi tsam der bzhugs te/ de kun gyi 'tsho ba yang rgyal po'i phul/de bar du dam pa 'dis kyang bzhugs shing / dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston gyis thugs mgu ba bla na med pa thob/ mchog brnyes zhi ba'i zhal snga nas dam pa 'di la/ khyod byang phyogs dang shar phyogs kyi yul rnams su song / skal ba dang ldan par shes na gzhan la chos kyang ci rigs par shod/ ces stsal pa ltar bla ma'i zhabs la phyag mdzad de/ phyir phebs pa na paṇ+ḍi ta'i rnam pa gcig gis/ mgron khang g.yos khang yod pa zhig tu khrid/ g.yos khang gi nang du mi mang po yod pa ltar snang ba zhig las/ dam pa 'di dang gzhan yang rnal 'byor pa mang po la/bza' btung gya nom pa'i rnyed bkur byas/ de nyid phyir song ba'i shul na/g.yos khang gi nang na su yang med de/ me bus pa'i shul yang mi snang gsung /yang rnal 'byor pa gzhan zhig /me bas shig ces brjod pas me rang 'bar 'byung zhing / 'bras tshos shig ces brjod pas snod du 'bras chan 'byung ba sogs cho 'phrul de lta bus mgron byed pa zhig kyang yod gsungs/ de nas pra ya kar phebs pas/ zhi ba'i zhabs kyi slob ma/ shubha rak+ṣi ta zhes bya ba rnal 'byor rnga/ shin tu ma spros pa 'chol ba ltar ston pa zhig dang mjal/ khong rnal 'byor chen por grags pa'i phyag mdzad cing / dka' ba mang po byas/ rtse gcig tu bsgoms pas/ thun mong gi rtags 'di tsam thob gsung ste/ rlung cung zad 'dzin kyin 'dug pas/ sku lus shin tu chung bar gyur nas ku phor chung chung zhig gi nang du zhugs/ yang rlung sbyor zhig mdzad kyin 'dug pas sku lus mi 'dra ba brgyad byung / mchog gi yon tan ni chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du mthong ba tsam yod —117—

gsung / gdams pa gnang bar zhus kyang ma gnang / de nas dza gad nā thar phebs/ de rjes cig ti bu ra dang nye ba bhi me shwa ra'i yul na phyi brag phug la/nang dgyes rdor drag po gdan can gyi lha khang ka ya sba bgres pos bzhengs pa zhig yod par bzhugs dus/ mtshan mo cig der dur khrod nas ro langs nyi shu tsam yongs nas gar byed cing 'dug mchod gtor dngos su blangs song gsung /de skabs tsar+ya pa'i rnal 'byor pa 'ga' la dbang dang man ngag 'dra mdzad/ bhaX ga la dang / ti pu ra dang / ra khang gi rnams su slar yang phebs/ kā ma rur lo gcig tsam bzhugs/ slob ma brgyad tsam phyag phyir yod pa/ yang dag pa'i don la rtogs pa bzang rab yod pa rnams rje btsun zhi ba'i zhabs mjal bar song /gzhan 'ga' zhig yod pa/ rje nyid kyi mched grogs zhig la gtad de/ rang nyid shing gi ri brgyud nas phebs pas mon pa'i jag pa tshan gcig byung ba/ rang dkyil 'khor du bsgoms pas kho ba tsho mig yengs pa 'dra ba la cang ma byas par tshur thon/ bod kyi phyogs su ched brtad lha sa mjal bar phebs/ lam du bsam yas mjal bar phebs pas/ gnas bdag mi dkar po'i rnam par dngos su byung / phyag 'bul zhing chos 'brel zhus te/ de nas lha sar phebs dus jo bo shākya mu ne de thub pa'i dbang po chags bral la shes rab dang bcas pa go bzlog gi lhar zhal gzigs/ bcu gcig zhal la gsol ba 'debs par mdzad pas/kha sa rla ṇi'i sku zhig thugs ka nas chad nas/ nyid kyi thugs kar thim pa'i mod la/ rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dngos yin snyam pa zhag mang po byung gsungs/ nub gcig dngos su bud med shin tu mdzes ma gzi brdzid che ba mang —118—

po/ re re la 'khor brgya stong du mar bcas pa mjal bar byung / glu dang mchod pa mang po byas/ bod du sleb pa la gzhi len gyi tshul du 'dug bod kyi gnas bdag mkha' 'gro ma chen mor 'dug gsung ste/ bstan ma bcu gnyis yin par mngon des zhag mang po mi zas gsol ma dgos/ de nas rim gyis gtsang phyogs su phebs/ bod kyi sde dpon gyi sar cher ma phebs/ de skabs bdag dben gnas byang chub chen por yod pa dang dus mtshungs/ bdag gi bsod nams kyi dpal du phebs/ sang phebs rgyu'i do nub rmi ltas kyang bzang ba rang zhig rmis/ bdag gis 'phral skad thams cad byang bar shes shing / legs sbyar yang thor bu shes pas/ chos dang gang zag gi dri ba 'ga' re zhus pa rnams/lan dpyis phyin par bka' stsal/ spro ba bskyed de rgyud ci tsam mkhyen zhus pas/ /kyai rdo rje/ sa sbu ṭa/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ mahā mā ya/ mtshan brjod/dbang mdor bstan/ sgrol ma'i rgyud rnams zhib mor thos/ bde mchog 'khor lo dang / gsang ba 'dus pa dang / mi g.yo ba dang / rdo rje gdan bzhi dang /ral gcig ma dang / ku ru kul+le la sogs pa'i rgyud phan 'ga' re dang / nag po chen po'i rgyud rnams yaX me ba re nyan gsungs/ man ngag gi gzhung ni mtha' yas pa zhig thugs la mnga' ste/ gsang 'dus/ bde mchog gshen rje gshed dang /mahā mā ya/ kyai rdo rje sogs gyi rdzogs rim gyi gzhung mang po dang / g.yin yang gsang ba grub pa dang / do ha mjodi dang / phyag rgya bzhi pa dang / bsam mi khyab la sogs pa gzhung mang po dang / phreng ba skor gsum sogs slob dpon gyi las rim gyi gzhung chen bod du sngar 'gyur ba'i tshad ldan rtsa ba'i gzhung rnams phal che —119—

ba la'ang mkhyen pa shin tu rgyas/par snang yang de dus nged kyis cher ma zhus/ snga phyir gser zho nyi shu lhag tsam dang / dngul ṭaX kha brgyad tsam/ gzhan ci rigs pa dang / dbang re la gos dar yug re tsam dang / ther ma re tsam dang / byin brlabs dang man ngag re la tshogs 'khor re dang kha bzang ba re tsam re chos thun thams cad la chos phyag bzang ba re ma chag par phul te/ sngon chad kha ba can gyi phyogs su ma byung ba zhus pa la/ sgrol ma rnal 'byor ma'i dbang bskur ba/de'i bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim gyi man ngag byin brlabs dang bcas pa/rgyud kyi bshad pa/ gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs/ mi bskyon pa lha bcu dgu/ sems kyi phyag rgya'i dbang / dpyid thig gi byin rlabs/ bka' babs drug ldan gyi khrid chen mo/ dza lan dha ra'i do ha dang man ngag sems kyi phyag rgyas man ngag gzhung bshad/ yi ge bzhi pa'i man ngag rang byin gyis rlabs pa'i byin rlabs rnams dang gzhung gi bshad pa/ phyag rgya bzhi'i snying po/ kyai rdo rje'i rdzogs rim ku sa la'i man ngag dang / yan lag drug pa/ ye shes 'char ba/ sgron me gcig pa/ dran pa gcig pa/ mahā mā ya'i man ngag phag mo keng dras la zhugs pa dza lan dha ri'i lugs/ phag mo rngon pa'i gdams ngag phag mo sna tshogs mdog rnam 'byor ma dkar dmar sngo gsum/ ngang ba'i rdo rje bdag med ma/ rdo rje phag mo ca co sgrog ma/ mi g.yo ba'i rdzogs rim a ti shas mdzad pa/ dpal mchog shom bi pa'i de nyid bzhi pa/ nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs gnyis dang bcas pa rnams legs par thob/ nyin mtshan med 'bad stsol byas te/ dbang dang byin brlabs dang / khrid rnams la dogs dpyod zin bris nan chags su —120—

byas shing / gzhung mang po phyag dpe dang / zhal las yi ger bris te tho re long nge ba bsgyu ra zhing / gsung 'phros ci byung byung zin bris su byas/ chos zab mo gcig la rnam rtog cung zad gcig byung ba'i rkyen gyis zla ba gsum du nye ba na/ cis kyang myur du 'byon pa'i zhal ta gnang ba la/ lo gsum cis kyang bzhugs dgos pa dang / min na'ang lo gcig cis kyang bzhugs dgos pa'i nan zhus phul/ de ltar ma gnang na chos kyang 'phro lus 'gro bar 'dug bka' drin dran pa'i yon ni 'di tsam zhig ma mtha' 'bul zhes zhus kyang / myur du rgya gar du 'gro ba don che/ rnyed pa dang nor gyi dgos pa med/ bshad pa dang gdams ngag gi 'phro rnams nga'i chos kyi sbun rnams kyis 'chad par 'gyur/ rnam rtog shas che bar 'dug pas/ gdams ngag la la bshad kyang mi btub pa 'dug gsung zhing bzhugs su ma gnang / rje 'di nyid rgya gar ba'i lugs la ltos pa'i dbang dang gdams ngag gnang ba la bka' yangs par 'dug cing / 'on kyang bla med kyi dbang dang gdams ngag 'di kur/ ni/ slob ma bzhir longs pa la phyogs gcig tu 'chad pa cher med gsungs/ dam pa 'di gong du bshad pa ltar/ mkhas pa'i yon tan yang bsam gyis mi khyab cing / rnal 'byor pa'i rtags mtshan kho bo cag gi tha mal ba'i mig gi mthong ba yang / nyi ma phyed tsam du rlung gi rgyu ba bkag nas bzhugs pa dang / shin tu grang ba'i tshe yang sku lus gcer bur bzhugs pa la nyams nga ba med par ma zad/ nye 'khor 'dom gang tsam tshun chad/tsha tshub tshub pa/ g.yin grang ba las skyob nus shing / rlud rnams zhal dang shangs kyi rgyu ba bkag nas/ spyan dang snyan nas ci bder 'byung 'jug nus pa dang /—121—

zhabs chu la mi bying ba dang / phyag sor gnyis sa la btsugs te sku'i brdzid thams cad bor yang yun ring du theg pa dang / gzhan gyi sems mkhyen pa sogs lkog gyur gzigs pa mnga' 'o/ /sku lus yang bas thog so gnyis gsum sku lhung du bcug kyang lpags pa bskyur ba 'dra ba zem zem 'bab pa dang / ri gzar po la yang thang bzhin gshegs pa dang / dug dang dngul chu la sogs pas sku la gnod pa med pa dang /thugs byams pa'i ngang tshul gyis khyi dang gcan gzan ma rungs pa rnams kyang sku la ldag pa sogs yid chags par byed la/ bya rog dang byi'u la sogs pa rnams sku pang dang phyag rtser 'ong zhing / phyag gis byugs kyang mi 'bros par dga' bzhin pas gnas pa dang / dbang bskur ba'i tshe ye shes dngos su 'beb par nus pa dang / dkyil 'khor las 'od 'phro ba sogs cho 'phrul ci rigs pa skal ldan rnams kyi ngor ston par mdzad pa dang / mi'i kha zas gsol ba med kyang /mi ma yin gyis phul ba'i zhal zas kyis 'tsho ba dang / lha'i rnal 'byor la thugs rtse gcig tu bzhag pa'i tshe da lta'i snang ba 'di dngos su 'gag cing / dus rtag tu phyi nang thams cad gzhi med rang grol du gzigs pa'i ye shes mnga' ste/bdag cag nyi tshe ba rnams kyi spyod yul yang de 'dra na/ sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan gyi pha mtha' ni su zhig gis bgrang bar spyod/ yi dam gyi lha ji ltar gzigs tshul zhus pas/ dngos su ni ma mthong / rmi lam gyi mtshan ma brtan po la/ rdo rje phag mo dang / sgrol ma'i rnam pa yang yang 'ong / dpal he ru ka dang / bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'ang lan 'ga' re mthong gsung / de yang zhal gzigs —122—

dngos kyi dbang du byas shing / bdag cag blo chung rnams kyi don gsungs kyi/nyams kyi snang ba la gzigs pa ni ci rigs pa gong du brjod pa ltar yang yin la/ gzhan yang rtag tu rgyun mi chad par gzigs kyin yod par snang ngo / kho bo yang sku drung na yod pa la/ lan gcig nam mkha' la gzigs shing sku nyams dang gsung nyams mang po zhig mdzad kyin 'dug pa la/ ji ltar yin nan gyis zhus shing gsol ba btab pas/ ྅ yi pa dang / pad+ma 'byung gnas 'khor mang po dang bcas te nam mkha' la gshegs par 'dug gsung / rgyu hing ga lnga ci'i gnas su byon pa man chad/ sngon gyi grub thob mang po dang yang nas yang du mjal/ yang bka' las kho bos sngags bzlas/ rlud bsgoms/ chu dang g.yang sa dang chom po dang / lto gos kyi 'jigs pa med pas nga ni gnas skor byed pa blo bde zhing skyid po yod kyang gsung ngo / /de ltar na bdag gis dam pa 'di la gzhung dang man ngag ci rig par thob mod kyi/ de tsa na 'byor pa yang chung / rnam rtog kyang rgod pas/ rdzogs rim gyi man ngag gi gnad zab mo ci rigs pa thob kyang / mang po zhig ma thob cing / bla ma nyid kyis bka' stsal ltar/ gzhung gi bshad pa rnams ni dam pa 'di nyid kyi mched grogs/ slob dpon ni rwa ṇa shrī'i zhabs dang / pu rna badz+ra gyi zhabs las mtha' chod par nod mod kyi/ sngar ma thob pa'i man ngag rnams zhus dus/ phal cher mi bzhugs gsung nas mi gnang ngo / /dam pa 'di/ de nas bod kyi yul khams gzhan ci rigs pa rnams su phebs nas/ skyid grong phyogs su zla ba gsum tsam bzhugs gnang zer/ 'gyang tsam bzhugs bden yin/ yang skabs de nyid du ka snar thang ba'i tshong pa 'bras 123—

dol khar phyin pa dang yang mjal nges yin zer/ sku lus kyi bkod pa gnyis par sem/ de nas bal yul mthil du phebs/ 'ju 'ju 'ga' zhig gis zhabs rtog dang 'bul ba cher byas pa/ de nyid du 'phongs pa thams cad la stsal/ bal po'i gnas thams cad mjal bar mdzad/ zla ba gnyis gsum tsam bzhugs/de nas yul bhang ju yang zer/ tsaspra ra ṇa ra phebs/ sngar gyi slob ma rnams dang mjal te/ dpon slob lhan cig tu pra ya ga sogs kyi lam rgyud nas/ grub chen zhi ba sbas pa'i drung du phebs te/ rdo rje slob dpon gtso bor bzhugs/ kha gen+t+ra'i ri la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo rnams la/ 'khor lo'i mchod pa rgya chen po mdzad/ 'di skabs ni slob dpon chen po zhi ba'i zhabs kyang / slob ma rnying pa mchog rnams ma gtogs phal cher dang mi mjal bar lo gcig gnyis 'gro tshod yin par 'dug bzhugs sa yang phug pa zab mo mi bzad pa cig yod par 'dug rje 'dis zla gcig tsam kha ge rgyu'i gnas der bzhugs te/ nyin re bzhin grub chen zhi ba'i zhabs kyi sku drung du phebs gyin 'dug zer/ de nas yang yul dbus kyi lam rgyud nas bha ṅga lar lo gcig tsam bzhugs/ spyod pa pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo nyi shu tsam zhabs 'bring du byung la/ slar ti phu ra'i yul du phebs/lo mang rab bzhugs/ de nas da lta de wi ko ṭa dang nye ba zhig na bzhugs zhes thos so/ /'di dag gi skabs kyi yul so so'i ngo mtshar ba'i gto mang po yod mod kyi/ 'dir rnam thar dkyus go ba'i gegs su 'gyur bar snang bas ma bris so/ /༈ yang smras pa/ rje btsun mchog 'di'i bka' drin gyis/ /bdag kyang —124—

skal ba bzang por gyur/ /'gro la rtag tu phan dgongs pa/ /brtse ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod sngon ma dra'i dus yul phyogs su/ nga tsor gyur te 'dab chags kyi/ /'gro ba mang la chos ston pa/ /de tshe gtso bor gyur la 'dud/ /ri bo po ṭa la yi ngogs/ /dge bsnyen rigs sngags 'dzin gyur nas/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang slob dpon du/ /bsten mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gzhan zhig na o rgyan du/ /lwa ba'i zhabs kyis rjes bzung nas/ /bla mar gus pa'i tshad du bzhag /gtso 'khor gnyis med gyur la 'dud/ /sa 'og spyod pa'i mi ma yin/ /rigs 'dzin mthu stobs cher gyur nas/ /klu dang lha min dbang po sogs/ /'gro ba'i don chen mdzad la 'dud/ /deng 'dir grub pa thams cad kyi/ /zhal lung dngos su gsol mdzad nas/ /skal ldan mang po'i don mdzad pa'i/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal/ /'di 'og lcang lo can du ni/ /badz+ra shu kla zhes bya ba/ /gsang ba'i bdag po'i pho nyar 'gyur/ /rigs sngags bdag po de la 'dud/ /de 'og in+d+ra nī la'i 'od/ /ces bya sangs rgyas zhing mchog tu/ /rdo rje sde zhes bya ba yi/ /'khor lo'i bsgyur rgyal de la 'dud/ /slar yang zhing der dga' ldan gnas/ /mdzes byed gser gyi dbang po zhes/ /skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i tshul/ /sems dpa' che la spyi bo'i 'dud/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ /rin chen rab 'phro snang ba zhes/ /theg chen dam chos seng ge'i sgra/ /sgrog mdzad rgyal ba khyod la 'dud/khyod sngon shākya thub pa'i drung / /zhing par gyur te dad pa bskyed/ /de nas brtsams te dus rtag tu/ /mchod 'os gyur pa khyod la bstod/ /de dag ni rdo rje —125—

gdan gyi byang chub chen po dang / dpal he ru kas lung bstan pa dang / sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i tshul shin tu gsang ba chen pos bka' stsal pa'i skyes rabs rnams so/ /zhes pa 'di ni bla ma dam pa lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po'i rnam par thar pa ste/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon chen po de nyid kyi zhabs kyi pad+mo la nye bar reg pas rdo rje theg pa la blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas pa'i bka' drin thob pa rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang gzhan la phan pa'i phyir sgro skur spangs te dngos gnas lhug par brjod pa'o/ /thog ma'i dus kyi brjed byang las gsal bar phye ba 'di ni rang lo nyer bdun pa la'o/ /'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstanaX pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ //zhus dag/maṅgal// //—126—

oX swā sti/ dge legs dpyid kyi dga' ston rnam 'phrul ba/ /gang 'dir yid byung g.yul las rnam rgyal te/ /dpal ldan phyogs kyi dga' ma'i skyed tshul du/ /mchog tu grol ba'i dga' ston sbyin 'di mtshar/ /snyan pa'i dri bsrung g.yo ldan pa/ /phyogs kun ya mtshan ri mo yi/ /rab tu rgod pa lhur len pa/ /'phrog byed kyi ni zhal bzang bzhin/ /ngo mtshar gtam gyi sbyor ba ni/ /gang 'dir dri za'i bu mo yi/ /rgyud mangs kyi ni rjes 'gro ba/ /yid can rna ba'i bdud rtsi nyid/ /gang yang yang dag pa'i lam la shin tu goms shing smon lam gyis dbang du gyur pa rnams ni/ gzhan gyis ma bskul bar yang dge ba la 'jug pa lta ci smos/ de bas na dge ba la yongs su goms par bya'o/ /de yang 'di skad ces bya ste/ nam zhig sngon gyi legs byas kyi/ /bdud rtsis 'tsho byed mkhar nyal bu/ /bde sogs bdag bzhin mchod sbyin brgyas/ /mngon par bsgrubs pa'i mi bdag ni/ /mu kun da yi lha zhes pa/ /chu gter bzhi yi ske rags can/ /'byung po 'dzin byed nor 'dzin ma/ /gang gi 'jug byed na yang spyod/ /blo ldan sa 'dzin de yi bka'/ /phyogs kun mi bdag mgo bo la/ /snang byed cod pan rab 'char ba/ /nyi gzhon shar gyi ri la bzhin/ /de yang shar phyogs ti pū ri'i rgyud du/ zla ba'i rigs kyi rgyal rigs zhig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs —127—

dbang phyug zla ba drug tu bsgrubs pas/ rmi lam du 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug bram ze'i gzugs kyis byon te/ khyod ci 'dod gsung ba la/ 'phags pa/bdag dang bdag gi rigs thams cad/ rgyal srid thob par 'gyur ba de lta bu 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsol bas/ 'phags pa'i gsung gis/ 'jig rten na bsod nams dang ldan pa nyung mod kyi/ 'on kyang brgyud pa bco lnga'i bar du de ltar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas nang par 'phags pa la mchod pa'i don du/ kha sa rga khrir chas pa las mthar gyis phyin te/ de nyid du mchod cing ཿga go /de'i tshe shar rdzo yul au ḍi sha'i rigs kyi gtso bo rnams kyis bdag cag rnams sngon rgyal po yod pa'i dus su ni bde la/ da ltar ni 'thab rtsod kyis mi bde bas/ 'o skol rnams kyis rgyal po zhig btsal lo zhes phyogs mang por song ba las/ mthar gyis kha sa r+sā ṇi mchod par byed pa'i rgyal rigs kyi bu de khyer nas seng ge'i khri la bzhag cing dbang bskur bas/ ming yang ā ga ma rā dza zhes grags so/ /de nyid kyi bu brgyud brgyad par gyur pa/rgyal po mu kun da de ba zhes bya ba byung ste/ yul au ḍi sha gha hu ra/ bā ga la/ bo ḍa/ dzā ri khaX ḍa/ ka liñja ra rnams snga nas kyang mnga' ris su yod pa las/dpung gi stobs kyis tri li ga zhes bya ba'i rgyal khams dang / yul dbus phal cher yang mnga' 'bangs su chud cing rgyal po glang po'i bdag po zhes grags so/ /rgyal po de'i sras ba ra pa rā ma brta ri zhes bya ba/ ma ga da dang / bcom brlag dang / pra ya ga rnams kyi bdag po'i sa la gnas pa zhig gi sras su grub chen ka t+na pa'i rnam 'phrul du mi 'jigs pa'i bden pas zhal gyis mches pa bla —128—

ma dam pa kun dga' grol mchog de nyid yang srid len pa'i tshul mdzad ces grags te/ grong khyer gā yar bltams pa'i nyin/ pho brang gi yang thog tu rnal 'byore pa gcer bu thal bas lus la byugs pa zhig lam gang nas 'ongs cha med par byung ste/ de na mchod pa'i las la brtson pa'i bram ze rnams kyis mi gtsang ngo snyam nas/ sde tshan bcu gnyis kyi rnal 'byor pa rnams ni 'chol ba'i spyod pa can te kho bo cag gtsang ma'i las la mngon par dga' ba rnams la tshul 'di 'os pa ma yin pas rnal 'byor pa 'dir ma 'dug cig brjod pas/ rnal 'byor pa dang mchod rdzas gnyis ka de nyid du mi snang bar gyur nas de rnams phan tshun du mi dang mi ma yin pa su zhig ces smra ba la yang rnal 'byor pa gzhan zhig de nyid du byung nas/ dam pa gu ru na mā ste na mo zhes smras nas de yang mi snang bar gyur to/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na btsas ston rgya chen po byed pa'i tshe/ yab rgyal po nyid snga nas mu stegs spyod pa pa kho na la dad pa'i dbang gis dpag tshad brgyad 'khor yug tu phyi nang gi rab tu byung pa gzhan bsrung zhing nyin rer rta ba dang rnga mo la gnas pa dag gis sa'i cha rnams rtog par byed do/ /de ltar nyin zhag dgu'i bar du sngar gnas pa rnams bskrad cing / glo bur ba yongs su mi ster ba las/ nyi ma bcu pa'i snga dro mchod sbyin gyi khang par rgyal po nyid kyang bzhugs shing / bram ze rnams kyis mchod pa byed par brtsams pa na/ sred med kyi bu'i sku la mchod yon 'bul ba'i tshe/ glo bur du go dha ri gyon pa'i rnal 'byor pa thod pa can zhig gis mchod spyin gyi chu snod du khrus byas pas/ bram ze stag dbyug thogs pa rnams kyis brdeg par brtsams pa na/ phaṭa ye zhes zer bas —129—

mchod sbyin gyi khang pa zhig pas de thams cad dngangs pa na/ rnal 'byor pa de'i zhal nas rgyal po la khyod kyi bu ni skye ba gzhan du sangs rgyas pa'i rigs yin pas 'di'i btsas ston la bram ze'i lugs kyi mchod sbyin bya bar mi 'os nges par rnal 'byor pa rnams la mchod sbyin pa rgya chen po gyis gsung / 'di su zhig yin zhus pas/ me gha nā tha zhes gsungs nas de nyid du sa la thim mam zer/der yang rnal 'byor pa'i bka' bzhin byas/ ming rā ma go bā lar btags/ de nas phyis sras kyis gtam smra zhing shes pa'i dus na/ sangs rgyas dang slob dpon go rak+ṣa kho na'i bsngags pa brjod pa zhig byung ste/ yum rgyal rigs kyi bu mo lasdi ni thog ma nas kyang sangs rgyas la dad pas/ nub phyogs so ra spyi'i paṇ+ḍi ta gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa bsod snyoms pa zhig sbyan drangs nas/ des kyang slob dpon ma khol gyis mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstod pa mang po 'dzin du bcugalhag pa'i lha mang po'i dbang bskur ba dang / rigs sngags sbyin pas sngon gyi skye ba mang po dran cing / khyad par yang srid snga ma gangs ri'i khrod du chos kyi sgron me sbar ba'i tshig don dang yi ge dang skad rnams thams cad yongs su dran cing gzhan rnams la'ang mang du bstan pas bram ze dang mu stegs can kun kyang ngo mtshar du byed cing / yang bsod snyoms pa kusta mi tra las byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i sdom pa nod cing zab mo'i chos kyang mang du nod nas bzlas pa dang rnal 'byor sogs kyang ci rigs par byed cing / rgyal po'i sras su song bas/dngul to la mang pos me tog sogs rtsed mo'i yo byad sna tshogs pa nyos te rtsed mor spyod pa na yang sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs dang mchod rten rnams kho na la —130—

mchod pa'i tshul du mdzad do/ /yang skabs shig na/ rā dza kṛ ha dang / gur pa par pa ta dang nye ba'i nags tshal rnams su 'khor nyung shas dang bcas de rgyu ba na/ shing drung zhig na rnal 'byor pa zhig bcud len sgrub pa'i g.yog thams cad smre'u gsum dang / dom zhig gis byed pa/ skabs 'gar mnyam par bzhag pa na rlung gi rgyu ba 'gag pa zhig mthong ba tsam gyis lhag par mos pas phyag 'tshal zhing de nyid du 'dug nas/ grong khyer du mi 'gro'o/ /rnal 'byor pa de ni grub thob chen po o ko ra nā tha'i dngos kyi slob ma me gha nā tha'am dz+wa la nā tha zhes bya ba yin no/ /'dir bla ma de gnyis kyi lo rgyus cung zad bsnyad na/ dang po ni yul dbus na rgyal rigs kyi bu zhig chung ngu nas pha 'das shing / phu bo'i khyim du gso ba las/ bī rū pak+ṣi'i slob brgyud dzo gi zhig gis rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs zhig byin no/ /de tsam ma gtogs lo bco brgyad lon gyi bar du rig pa gcig kyang ma bslabs pas/ yid mi dga' nas phu bo dang / khyim bdag mos blun po khyod kyis ci rung zhes spyos nas phyir phyung bas yid 'byung nas/ gzhan gyi yul du slong mos 'tsho zhing rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sgrub par byed cing mthar gyis lo bcu drug song ba na/ ting nge 'dzin bzang po yang skyes nas nub phyogs hi ga la tsi lha mo u ma'i gnas su song nas lha mo'i rdo sku'i steng du zla ba drug gnyid kyi 'od gsal thun gcig bsgoms pas lha mo bskrag nas/ rnal 'byor pa red dhi de hi ki ni dhi de zhes zer ba na rnal 'byor pas rdzu 'phrul dang gter gyis ci byed/ ye shes kyi dngos grub sbyin na blang mod/ lha mos bdag la grub thob spyin du med/go rak+ṣa las long zer bas na des go rak+ṣa 'tshol du song ba na/ sin dha'i yul na —131—
