rnal 'byor pa grangs med pa 'dug pa'i gral gyi tha ma zhig na/ bzhin shin tu mi sdug pa/ yan lag las rnag khrag lhung ba zhig 'dug pas de yin par shes nas phyag btsal zhing gsol ba btab pas/ des byin gyis rlabs pa'i tshod ma phul gang stsal ba 'thungs pas de nyid du shes bya'i yul kun la mnga' brnyes/ chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i grub thob chen por gyur nas/ chos bshad pas 'di'i slob rgyud shin tu mang ngo / /'di'i gsung 'ga' zhig mu stegs kyi gzhung lugs dang bsres nas spyod pa'i mu stegs pa'i rnal 'byor pa'ang o ko ra ra zhes pa mang du byung ngo / /phyi ma ni dus ma yin par char 'bebs pa dang / lus la me 'bar ba'i cho 'phrul bstan pas/ sprin gyi mgon po dang 'bar ba'i mgon po zhes grags so/ /de nas rgyal bu rā ma go pā las slob dpon de la bsnyen bkur mang du mdzad pa na/ slob dpon des kyang lhag pa'i lhas byin gyis brlabs pa dang /gdams ngag kyang 'doms par mdzad cing / bu khyim du ma 'gro bar de nyid du 'dug shig ces gsung nas 'dug pa na/ yab kyis slob dpon la nga'i bu 'di nyid du rdzongs shig ces brjod pas/ slob dpon gyis kyang 'di ni nga'i chos kyi bu yin pas nga dbang ba yin no zhes slar gsungs pa na/ rgyal bu ra ma bha ra ta ri khros nas/ zho shas 'tsho ba dag cig 'phrog tu btang pas 'phrog par ma nus shing / slar rta ba stong phrag gcig la rnal 'byor pa ngan pa de choms shig ces smras te btang pa de rnams slob dpon gyi drung du nye bar sleb pa na/ slob dpon gyis sngags kyi sbyor ba cung zad cig gis de thams cad kyi phyin pa rengs te g.yo —132—

'gul ma nus pa na thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur te/ e ma mthu dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa 'di la bdag cag mos par bya'o/ /zhes phan tshun gcig gis gcig la 'doms shing dad pa bskyed pas rengs pa rnams grol zhing / slar rgyal po la sbran pas/ rgyal po yang ngo mtshar skyes nas/ slob dpon gyi drung du song ste phyag 'tshal zhing / dngul ta ra snyim pa mang po gtor te bzod par gsol bas slob dpon gyis kyang bi bhū ti'i thig le yang stsal to/ /de nas dus gzhan zhig na gong ma rgyal po mu kun da dang ( 〈ju〉 de ba/) ḍi laX pā tsa ba stag gzig gi rgyal po rtsod par gyur te/ ma ga dha nas zla phyed tsam nub tu 'ongs pa/ yul ma thu ra sa ka ri zhes pa'i grong khyer srang ga la yang nyi ma gnyis kyi lam yod pa zhig tu rgyal po rā ma bha ra ta ri dmag dpung sum 'bum tsam dang lhan cig gnas pa na/ slob dpon chen po me gha nā tha yang de nyid du byon te phan tshun gyi dmag dpon gnyis kar las bsod snyoms gsol te bden pa'i tshig gi stobs kyis 'khrug pa'ang rang zhi la/ khyad par ḍi li'i g.yul ngor spyod pa'i glang po che drug stong tsam gyi gtso bo gsum dang / rgyal po glang po'i bdag po'i g.yul du spyod pa'i glang po che kun gyi mchog go pā la hasti zhes bya ba/lus kyi dpang la khru sum cu rtsa brgyad yod pa glang chen phal pa nyis brgya'i bya ba byed par grags pa'i glang chen mchog de rnams kyang phyag re res gnon pa'i cho 'phrul ston cing / dam pa 'dis kyang sngags dang mnyam gzhag cung zad re mdzad pa na/ rgyal po gnyis ka'i rta'i tshogs rnams res bskul yang mi 'gro/res bzung bar yang mi nus pa mthong nas/ skye bo thams cad ches ngo mtshar bar —133—

gyur to/ /yang skabs zhig yab rgyal po de nyid ku be ra dang zhi ba la mchod pa nam byed res kyi/ slob dpon me gha nā tha rdzu 'phru‘sda gyis mngon du byon nas/khyod kyi rigs kyang sangs rgyas kho na mchod na/ 'di mi 'os zhes zlog par mdzad do/ /lan cig rtsed mo'i zhor la lam gyi gzhi mdo'i lding ga zhig la byi tse snyim pa gang gtor ba na'ang mig 'phrul bzhin du slob dpon dpon slob gnyis der byon nas sngar bzhin bzlog pas/ de phyin chad yab rgyal po'ang sangs rgyas pa rnams rdzu 'phrul che zhes gtso bor mchod do/ /de ltar dam pa 'dis ni skabs 'gar slob dpon rnam gsum so so'i drung dang / skabs 'gar pho brang du bzhugs shing / yab dang lhan cig yul puṇ+ḍa brta na dang / kha sa ṅgā ṇa dang / ra ra rnams brgyud nas u ḍi sha dza gad nā tha/ kaṭa ka bha na ra si/ u shi ra na li ta ghā hū ra bho ḍa rnams su'ang byon/ slob dpon chen po ā nan+da bha dra'i dpon po ā nan+da pra skro ti dang yang mjal/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i bzlas lung mnos pas rjes su bzung ba'i rtags 'phral du byung bar grags 〈'di rgyal po grag shos yin/〉shing / rā dza kṛ 〈rgyal po'i khab 〉ha/ ga ya shir+ṣa gu rla ri bya rkang / kṛ dha 〈bya rgod phung po 〉ku ṭa sogs rgyal po'i gnas chen kun dang / nags dang grong khyer kun tu bskor zhing ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i rol rtsed can zhig go /de ltar skyes bu mchog gi lo brgya'i bya ba zhig lo brgyad du nye ba la rdzogs par mdzad par grags/ de las skye ba 'phos pa ni da lta'i 'di'o/ /de ltar na sngon goms pa rnams ni dge ba la ngang gis 'jug pa yin no zhes dge ba la goms pa'i yon tan bsngags pa la sbyar bar bya'o/ /bla ma dam pa tshul bzhin bsten pa rnams ni 'phags pa —134—

rnams rtag tu rjes su 'brang ba'i phyir/ bla ma bsten pa'i yon tan bsngags pa la'ang sbyar bar bya'o/ /smon lam gyis legs par bsgrub pa rnams ni nges par legs pa kho nar 'gyur ro zhes smon lam gyi stobs la'ang sbyar bar bya'o// //'dir smras pa/ tshogs gnyis rin chen yid kyi shing rta dang / /yang dag smon lam rta bdun rab sbyar bas/ /don gnyis rab rgyas snang byed bdag po ni/ /sa gsum mkha' la thogs pa med par spyod/ /chu yi gter las thigs tshul du/ /dam pa'i rnam thar brjod pa las/ /bsod nams gang zhig thob gyur pa/ /ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la bsngo/ /zhes pa'ang mkhyen yangs mi'i dbang po'i bkas bskul nas/ tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gsum pa la 'gur mo'i pho brang du sbyar ba'o/ /gcig zhus dag //maṅga laX/ bha wan tu// // —135—

oX swā sti/ rdo rje 'chang dbang dpal ldan dus 'khor dang / /zla bzang 'jam dpal grags pa pad dkar sogs/ /chos rgyal rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku rnams dang / /dus 'khor zhabs dang zla ba mgon po dang / /rigs ldan rnam 'phrul chos rje yab sras sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la gus pas 'dud/ /bdag cag 'dir tshogs skal ldan gdul bya la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal tu gsol/ /'dir zhing khams mchog tu gyur pa mi ma rjed 'jig rten gyi khams/ gling khyad par can bdun pa las kyi sa/ dum bu bla na med pa 'dzam gling lho'i phyogs/ rgyal khams ngo mtshar can pu rgyal bod kyi yul/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi zhing khams khung ba/ rgyal sras byang sems kun gyi mdzad pa'i spyod yul/ gsang sngags 'dzin pa kun gyi gnas mchog dam pa/ gangs can ljongs 'di'i lte ba sa'i thig le/ ri bo stong phrag du ma'i dbus na mngon par 'phags pa/ sa 'dzin dbang po nags rgyal dpal gyi ri/ ru lag g.yas dra'i so mtshams/ phyi ltar na sangs rgyas kun kyi zab mo'i chos sgra sgrog pa'i gnas bya rgod phung po'i ri/ nang ltar na 'phags pa sbyan ras gzigs kyi pho brang dam pa ri bo po ṭa la/ gsang ba ltar na rdo rje theg pa'i nges gsang 'byung zhing dar ba'i gnas byang phyogs sham bha la/ de kho na nyid ltar na dpal ldan 'bras sbungs chos kyi dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug gi dkyil 'khor/ don dam —136—

ye shes sangs rgyas seng ge'i khrir bzhugs e waX zung 'jug gi ngo bo/ sgrub gnas bye ba phrag brgya'i dbus na/ lhun po ltar mngon par mtho zhing / grags pa nyi zla ltar gsal ba/ ri khrod chen po jo nang zhes yongs su grags pa 'di'i gnas kyi che ba'i dbang du byas na/ sa gzhi la rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i yon tan dang / skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i che ba dang / sgru ba brgyud chu bo'i gzhung ltar rgyun ma chad cing dar ba'i gzi brdzid dpal dang ldan pa'o/ /dang po sa la rang bzhin gyi sa grub pa'i yon tan ni/ gangs can man+ta ra dang lhun po sogs/ /lha dang drang srong rig 'dzin bgrang yas kyis/ /nye bar bstan pa'i ri'i rgyal po rnams/ /phyogs 'dir gcig tu 'dus pa lta bur yod/ /phyogs bzhi'i ri rnams rtse mo shin tu mtho/ /rtsa ba brtan cing dbyibs legs lhun stug chags/ /ngos rnams sman ljongs nyams dga' yangs pa dang / /zla ba chu shel in+t+ra nī la sogs/ /nor bu'i phung po brtsegs 'dra'i brag ri mdzes/ /ri bo'i sul rnams nags tshal sna tshogs dang / /ljon shing du mas rnam par brgyan pa yod/ /zla ba drug tu me tog sna tshogs bkra/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kun sel byed pa/ /sman mchog rnam pa sna tshogs du ma yi/ /dri zhim ngad kyis phyogs kun khyab pa dang / /rnam pa sna tshogs 'bras bu chags pa ni/ /'chi med dbang po mchod sbyin brgya pa'am/ /mi 'am ci yi rgyal po ljon pa ni/ /'khor bcas rol zhing rtsa ba'i skyed tshal 'dra/ /ri bo'i mgul nas char sprin gsar pa 'khrigs/ /bdud rtsi'i char zim rgyun mi 'chad par 'bab/ /—137—

mthong bas yid 'phrog thos na nyams dga' zhing / /bsdad pa tsam gyis ting 'dzin ngang gis skye/ /klu yi rgyal po rgya mtsho'i rtse sa 'dra/ /'bab chu sna tshogs lhung lhung sgra 'byin cing / /ri dwags du ma bag phab bde bar rgyu/ /'dab chags sna tshogs snyan pa'i ca co sgrog /rta bdun rgyal po lho yi khyim gnas pa'i/ /zla ba drug tu ri dang ri bo'i sul/ /ri drung ri yi shod kyi ngogs rnams su/ /rmad byung ya mtshan kha dog sna tshogs 'char/ /ston ni gser dang byi rle'i 'phreng ba spel/dgun dus ri dbang rgyas pa'i rtse mo rnams/ /bco lnga'i zla ba nya rgyas lta bur 'gyur/ /yan lag brgyad ldan 'bab chu du ma can/ /ri mtho sa gtsang rig pa shin du dwangs/ /lu hi ta zhes chu klung tshangs pa'i bu/ /'bab chu'i rgyal po byang gi phyogs su rgyu/ /rgyal ba'i zhal mthong grub pa'i dam la gnas/ /'dren pa'i bstan pa gces par skyong ba yi/ /lha mo mthu ldan nags sman rgyal mo ni/ /lha sman 'bum gyi tshogs dang lhan cig tu/ /dga' bas rol zhing lha srin sde brgyad la/ /dbang bsgyur rdzu 'phrul chen pos skyong ba'i gnas/ /ri rgyal 'di yi ri 'dabs khor yug na/ /grub pa'i gnas dang lha khang gtsug lag khang / /chos grwa brgya phrag du mas bskor te gnas/ /de las khyad par gnas mchog dam pa 'di/sa gzhi e yig chos kyi 'byung gnas 'dra/ /mkha' la rang byung 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dbyibs/ /ri rnams pad+ma 'dab ma rgyas pa 'dra/ /nub byang dpal gyi ri bo sngo 'bor skyong / /mtho zhing brjid chags ri rgyud du mas bskor/ /phyi rol rgyal khams gzhan nas bltas pa'i tshe/ /sa las rdo rje rtse lnga lta bur 'phags/ /gnas 'di'i nang gi gang nas bltas gyur kyang / /'khor los bsgyur rgyal —138—

gdan la bzhugs pa 'dra/ /byang shar phyogs na rta mchog rin chen zung / /de'i drung na dmag dpon rin po che/ /dpa' bo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba 'dra ba yod/ /byang gi phyogs na nye bar brten pa ni/ /brag ri'i 'phreng ba 'khor lo rin chen 'dra/ /de 'og seng rdzong zhes grags brag ri ni/ /blon po rin chen gtso la gus pas 'dud/ /nor bu rin chen 'dra ba'i brag ri ni/ /nub byang phyogs gnas ri de'i ngos la ni/ /'dab chags dbang po du ma dga' ba'i rol/ /grub pa'i gnas mchog du mas brgyan pa yod/ /lho yi phyogs na yid 'ong ri yi dbyibs/ /btsun mo rin chen mngon du phyogs pa 'dra/ /nub phyogs ri ni glang chen nyal ba bzhin/ /mdun ri lhun chags sman ljongs rgyas pa ni/ /'khru yi phung po lta bur dbyibs legs shing / /gnod sgyin dbang po gter gyi bdag po'i gtso/ /'phags pa dzam bha la yi dbyibs su yod/ /phu ni gzengs mtho lcags ri lta bus bskor/ /mda' ni ma shor phyag rgya lta bur bsnol/ thur ri'i ngos la bkra shis dpal be dang / /gnas lugs mtsho ni pa a yig gsal bar dod/ /g.yon phyogs dngul gyi phye mas g.yogs 'dra ba'i/ /ri bo dar yol lta bus mdzes par byas/ /don dam e la waX yig bzhugs pa ltar/ /gnas kyi lte bar mthong grol chen mo ni/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa' kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /mthong thos dran reg 'brel tshad don ldan ni/ /rmang ni sa gzhi lta bu rgyu che zhing / /rtse mo skye med gnas la reg pa snyam/ /bkod legs rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang 'dra/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad bzhugs pa'i gnas/ /gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan —139—

pa/ /rab 'byams rgya mtsho zhes bya'i zhing khams dang / /'od dpag med kyi gnas mchog bde ba can/ /mi 'khrugs zhing khams mngon dga' la sogs dang / /'dod pa'i khams kyi mchog rab dga' ldan dang / /gzugs khams rtse mo dbang phyug chen po'i zhing / /mkha' khyab 'og min stug po bkod pa sogs/kun 'dus bdag nyid mchod rten dpal yon can/ /sku gzugs gzhal du med pas gang ba bzhugs/ /mtha' skor kho ra khor yug phyogs kun tu/ /gtsug lag khang dang sgrub gnas bgrang yas yod/ /dbus ni he ru ka dpal dus 'khor sogs/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug rnams kyi dkyil 'khor dang / /phyi rol phyogs mtshams dur khrod chen po brgyad/ /rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor zab mo dang / /rgya che'i dkyil 'khor ngo mtshar rmad du byung / /gnas mchog dam pa 'dir ni su bsdad kyang / /chags sdang la sogs nyon mongs ngang gis sangs / /dge ba'i chos rnams gong nas gong du 'phel/ /gnyid rmugs sel zhing rigs pa dwangs pa'i gnas/ /zhen chags sel zhing nges 'byung 'phel ba'i gnas/ /gnod sems 'bri zhing snying rje rgyas pa'i gnas/ /rnam g.yengs spangs shing zhi gnas brtan pa'i gnas/ /log rtog mi 'byung lhag mthong ngang gis skye/ /gnas mchog 'di dang mtshungs pa gzhan yod min/ /phyogs 'dzin can gyis bsngags pa brjod pa dang / /the rang 'gong pos grags pa bsgrags pa dang / /dbang sdud nor sgrub la sogs rten 'brel kyis/ /'du 'tshogs can dang grags pa che ba 'gar/ /rmongs pa'i 'gro rnams chu ltar rgyug pa la/ zhing mchog dam par 'khrul dang 'di mi mtshungs/ /gzhan du lo dang zla bar bsgoms pa bas/ /gnas —140—

mchog 'dir ni zhag dang za ma tsam/ /bsgoms pa'i phan yon lhag par che ba yin/ /gzhan du dge sbyor 'bad de bsgoms pa bas/ /sdig pa'i las spangs chos dang bla ma la/ /mos gus byas nas gnas 'dir nyal ba yang / /bla med byang chub mchog la nye ba yin/ /nya pa gdol pa ri dwags rngon pa dang / /mtshams med byed pa la sogs sdig can yang / /gnas 'di bskor zhing sgrub chu 'thung pa dang / khrus byas phyag dang skor ba mchod pa phul/ /de yis sdig pa dag nas lha yul skye/ /skye bo gzhan dag smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ /gnas mchog 'di ni mthong ba don ldan yin/ /de ltar na mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i gnas mchog 'di ni/ rgyal ba shākya seng ge la sogs pa sngar byon pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi bzhugs gnas su rgyu nya pa ba lags/gnyis pa skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i che ba ni/gnas 'di dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs shing /sgos su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing mchog tu gdod nas grub pa yin pa las/ bstan pa 'di la mi'i skye ba nye bar gzung ba'i tshul bstan pa'i dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs tshul ni/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes bya ba sprul pa'i sku de nyid kyis/ brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi gnas rnams su byon zhing / khyad par nags rgyal gyi ri la lan mang du phebs pa dang / yang dgos gnas 'dir zhag bdun bzhugs par grags shing / phug chen gong ma dang phug pa gong 'og rnams su chags phab/ de rjes su rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la bzhugs —141—

pa/ snubs chen nam mkha'i snying po dang / ngam 'bre klu'i rgyal mtshan dang / sna mnam pa tshul khrims 'byung gnas la sogs pas kyang sgrub gnas su mdzad cing / bod dbus gtsang gi phyogs 'dir gsang sngags brgyud kyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad pa la thog mar bka' drin che ba sgra sgyur gyi rgyal po 'brog mi lo tsā pa'i slob ma/ mo grub pa thob pa bzhi'i gtso mo/ bzang sgom dkon mchog zhes bya bas/ thog mar nags rgyal gyi shar mgul du cung zad bzhugs/ de nas gnas 'dir byon te yun ring du bzhugs shing / mthar 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes pa yin/ bzhugs gnas da lta yang yod pa 'di lags/ de rjes su lo brgyad cu skor song ba na/ ma cig sangs rgyas ri mas gnas 'dir chags phab/yun ring du bzhugs shing bka' gdams dang rdzogs chen gyi sgrub grwa bskyangs par gda'/ bzhugs gnas dang chos grwa da lta yang yod pa 'di lags/ de nyid kyi sgrub grwa ma stongs pa'i rgyun la/ mi ring bar dpal ldan grub thob 'dar phyar rin chen bzang po phebs te/ thog mar tshogs pa ma bskyangs/ sgrub pa kho na mdzad cing bzhugs/ phug chen 'og mar bdag med lha mo bco lnga dang 'khor lo bde mchog sogs zhal gzigs/ phug chen gong mar slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dngos su zhal mjal te/ pad+ma dbang chen gyi chos skor mtha' yas pa'i bang/ga por bskos/ nus mthu thogs pa med cing byin rlabs dang ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i grub thob rtsod med du gyur pa yin par gda'/ de skabs gsang 'dus rim lnga gtso bor gyur pa'i gsang rnying gnyis 'dus kyi sgrub grwa mdzad/ grub thob nyid kyis mi'i bla ma gzhan la ma gsan yang / sems 'grel —142—

skor gsum la gzigs kyin don thugs nyams su bzhes pas/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i nyams rtogs mthar phyin pa mnga' bar 'dug de rjes mi ring bar sngar gyi sgrub grwa'i rgyun ma stongs pa la/ rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku mkhas btsun bzang po'i mthar thug /rtags mngon gyur gyi grub thob chen po zhang kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus/ mtshan gyi khyad par gzhan kun spangs chen po kun tu bzang po zhes bya bas phebs pa yin te/ de yang chos rjes kun spangs chen po de nyid/ se mkhar chung na bzhugs pa'i dus/ grub thob se ston kun rig gi sku'i skye ba yin pa yang thugs kyis dran/ gzhi bdag rnying pa rnams kyis kyang ngo shes/ rgyud kyi snying po mdzad pa'i thog mar dge ba'i gzugs ltas kyang byung /brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi gtso mo/ nags sman rgyal mos jo nang du spyan 'dren pa'i zhu ba yang yang phul/ de la da lta dus la cung zad ma bab pas da res mi 'tshal/lo gsum nas 'ong zhes zhal gyis bzhes/ de bar du lha sa yer ba sogs dbus phyogs su 'gro don cher mdzad/ sngar gyi phyi nang gi rten 'brel 'dzom pa las/lo gsum gyi mtshams de nas spyi brag nags gsum gyi mkhan slob dge 'dun thams cad mgrin gcig pas nan tan du gsol ba btab pa la brten nas/gnas mchog dam par 'dir chags phab/ de tsa na gnas 'di'i rgyun bzhugs sgrub pa po sum cu tsam yod par grags/ thog ma lo gcig seng rdzong du bzhugs/de nas 'byogs po'i btsan gyis gdan drangs/ 'byog por gzims khang mkha' spyod bde ldan du/ thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba'i mtshan ma brnyes nas rgyud kyi snying po rtsa 'grel tshang bar mdzad/ rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa'i snyan rgyud —143—

yi ger bkod pa'i thog ma 'brid yig chen po yang mdzad/ de rjes sku tshe'i smad la sgrub gnas skyid phug bde ldan du gdan phab par gda'/ de skabs phyogs bcu nas 'dus pa'i chos mdzad sgrub pa pho mo tshogs pa nyung dus kyang drug brgya re rtag tu 'dus shing / de nas brtsams te da lta'i bar du rgyud thams cad kyi nges gsang zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa gtso bor gyur pa'i sgrub grwa rgyun ma chad cing / dar zhing rgyas par gyur pa lags te/ chos rje kun spangs chen pos gnas 'dir lo nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bzhugs/ de nas byang sems rgyal ba ye shes kyis lo brgyad/ mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtshos lo bdun rnams gdan sa mdzad pa rnams la'ang sgrub brgyud je 'phel du gyur/ de rjes rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku chen po/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo/ mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i glegs bam gcig gyur/ ngur smrig 'dzin pa kun gyi khyu mchog rgya chen byang chub sems kyi mnga' bdag mtha' bral nges don bstan pa'i bdag po/ rtags dang yon to mtha' dag ma sbas mngon du gyur pa'i/grub thob kyi 'khor los bsgyur pa chen po/ chos rje kun mkhyen dol po pa mtshan brjod par dka' ba shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid kyis/ lo bco lnga'am bcu gsum gyi bar du gdan sar bzhugs dus/ skabs de nyid dang / ma 'ongs pa'i sems can mthong thos dran reg thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sa bon gdab pa'i phyir du/ mthong grol gyi sku 'bul chen mo bzhengs/ bshad sgrub mtha' dag gi sgo nas mdo rgyud kyi bstan pa sgo thams cad nas rgyas par mdzad/ de rjes thugs sras dam pa sgra sgyur lo tsā ba chen po blo gros dpal bzang —144—

po rgyal tshab du mnga' gsol nas lo ngo bco lnga gdan sar bzhugs pa dang / de rjes mkhan chen phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis lo drug gdan sa mdzad/ de rjes lo gsum tsam nas mkhas grub dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gdan sar mnga' gsol mdzad de/ de rnams kyi ring la yang kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po nyid gnas mchog dam pa 'di nyid du bshad sgrub kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa dang / phyogs bzhi'i ri khrod sna tshogs su sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa spel ba dang / chos sde dang grwa sa tha dad pa rnams su chos kyi 'khor lo mtha' yas pa bskor bar mdzad/ de ltar kun mkhyen chen po 'di'i sku thog la tshogs pa nyung dus su yang stong phrag gnyis re 'tshogs/ mang ba la tshod bzung du med/ nam zhag rgyun du mdag sbyar mtshams bcad pa rang yang stong phrag re mi 'chad pa 'byung / gnas 'dir 'tshogs phyin dge sbyor gyi sne mi zin pa ye mi yong / sems 'brel skor gsum dang / byams chos sde lnga dang / bslab bsdus spyod 'jug sogs gzhung lugs kyi 'chad nyan dang / dbang sgrub mchod lag len man ngag sgo thams cad nas spel bas/ bshad nyan gyi zur chos pa yang lnga bcu tsam re rtag tu bzhugs/ mdor na nges don gyi bstan pa nam langs pa dang nyi ma shar ba bzhin du gyur pas/ sngon chos rje kun spangs chen pos gnas 'dir pha las bu lhag bu las tsha lhagatsha las yang tsha lhag pa 'byung zhes dang / da lta bzang ldan bar mar chos 'chad/ma 'ongs pa na mchod rten bzhengs zhes lung bstan pa thog tu bab pa der gda'/de nas slar yang mkhan chen phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis lo bco lnga'i bar gdan sa mdzad pa dang / de rjes rim can du kun mkhyen byang chub seng ge mkhas —145—

mchog nya dbon chen po kun dga' dpal/ mkhan chen rgyal ba jo bzang / rgyal sras chos dpal mgon po/ 'dren mchog shes rab bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po/ mkhas btsun chos dpal bzang po 'jims chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ 'jims chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rgyal ba nam mkha' chos skyong ste/ de yan chad mdo sngags mtha' dag dpal jo nang pa kho na'i bka' srol 'dres med kho na yin zhing / gdan rabs de thams cad rigs ldan gyi sprul pa'i sku yin par grags so/ /de rjes kyang gdan rabs su byon pa thams cad mkhas btsun bzang po sha stag byon pa lags te/ 'dren mchog nam mkha'i mtshan can gyi rjes su/ byang sems dpal ldan rin chen/ mtshungs med chos skyong rgyal mtshan/ sgo rum kun dga' legs pa/ bstan 'dzin nam mkha' bzang po/ mkhas pa rin chen bkra shis/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchogabastan 'dzin kun dga' dpal bzang rnams byon/ de rjes da lta'i bla ma dam pa'o/ gzhan yang gnas 'dir ri khrod so so'i sgrub gnas skyong ba'i sgrub pa mo dang sgrub chen grub brnyes mang po dang / zur chos kyi slob dpon dang / rdor 'dzin mdzad pa sogs mkhas grub du ma zhig byon pa lags na'ang / mtha' yas par brjod kyi ga la lang / skabs 'di dag tu spro na/ chos rje yab sras la sogs pa bla ma rnams kyi che brjod/ rnam thar rgyas bsdus rnams nas ci rigs par blangs la 'tsham par bshad do/ /gsum pa/ sgrub brgyud chu bo'i gzhung ltar rgyun ma chad cing dar ba'i gzi brjid dpal dang ldan pa'i yon to ni/ kha ba can 'di na sngon sgrub gnas —146—

bsam gyi mi khyab pa byon zhing/ da ltar yang sgrub grwa mang du yod mod kyi/ sgrub grwa 'di dang por tshugs pa dang dus mnyam pa'i sgrub grwa bshad grwa rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ 'di dag las ches 'phyi ba dus phyis btab pa rnams kyang / 'ga' zhig ni rtsa ba nas stongs/ 'ga' zhig ni grong yul dang ser khyim du song / kha cig sngon gyi shul du da lta sgrub grwa yod pa'ang 'dug mod kyi/ bar skabs/ su stongs pa'i shul la gsar 'debs byas pa dang / kha cig ser khyim gyi sa nas gtsang ma'i grwa gsar du phye ba dang / bar skabs su ser khyim du song ba rnams phud nas/ de'i shul du grwa tshang ngam sgrub grwa gsar 'dzugs byas pa kho na yin gyi/lo sum brgya bzhi brgya tsam du gang stongs dang ser khyim la sogs pas bar ma chod par/ bla brgyud chos brgyud gcig cing / nyams len gyi rgyun gcig pa'i sgrub brgyud bar ma chad par dar ba ni/ bod gangs ri'i khrod na sgrub gnas dam pa 'di kho na las gzhan med/ gnas 'dir ni ma cig ri ma nas gzung ste/ deng sang gi bar du sgrub grwa rgyun ma chad pa'i dbang du byas nas/ lo lnga brgya tsam song zhing / chos rje kun spangs chen po phebs pa nas chos brgyud gcig cing / nyams len gyi rgyun gcig pa'i sgrub brgyud 'di kho na la'ang / da lta yan chad du lo bzhi brgya lhag tsam song ngo / /de ltar na gnas gcig tu tshugs pa'i sgrub brgyud la dpal jo mo nang dang / gnas gcig tu tshugs pa'i bshad grwa la gsang ne'u thog bstan pa'i rgyun gang stongs med par gnas yun ring ba yin ces/ shes ldan blo gzu bor gnas pa rnams la grags shing phyogs gcig nas don la'ang gnas pa yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang dpal ldan gsang phu na/ phyis byung lo nyis brgya tshun —147—

la/ sa dge so so'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa ma gtogs/ rngog lo yab sras dang /phya tshang la sogs pa gsang phu ba rang lugs kyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa med la/gnas mchog 'dir ni lta grub nyams len gyi rgyun gcig kho nas byin rlabs kyi rgyun la bsre bslad med pa dang / gzhan yang tshig bshad tsam gyi rgyun ma yin par sgrub pa nyams len snying por byed pa'i srol ka rgyun ma chad cing / dus kyi tha ma 'di lta bur yang lag len du thebs ba'i gra yin pas na/ cig shos las kyang ches khyad par du 'phags shing / ches ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba yin no/ /sgrub gnas kyi rgyal po dpal ldan jo mo nang 'dir mthong grol chen mo gnas kyi lte bar byas pa'i mtha' skor gyi sgrub gnas byin rlabs can rnams cung zad smos na/rgyab ri'i g.yon phyogs nyi bstan 'di la/ chos rje yab sras bzhis bzhugs shing rdo rje phag mo'i gnas skyid phug bde ldan 'od gsal brag de'i g.yas phyogs na rin po che shes rab 'bum pa dang / mkhas mchog nya dbon chen po kun dga' dpal dang / rgyas sras dngul chu chos rdzong ba'i thugs sras rgya ma pa yon tan 'od sogs skyes bu dam pa du mas bzhugs pa'i gnas shug pa gnam 'phyang bde chen brag de'i stod na mkhas grub o rgyan pa dkon mchog grags pa'i bzhugs gnas sgrub khang 'di lags/ sbud bkra dbu rgyan pa las cung zad bgres pa gcig yin/ o rgyan du lo lnga bzhugs/ grub rtags mngon rgyur ba mnga'/ chos rje kun spangs chen po'i mched grogs gong ma lags par gda'/skyid phug gi g.yon phyogs kyi brag na/ ma cig ri ma'i chos grwa dang bzhugs gnas/ de'i g.yon phyogs su phug pa chen po gong 'og gnyis yod pa'i/ gong ma —148—

ni slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi bzhugs gnas dngos de yin par grags shing / phyis grub thob 'dar phyar rin chen bzang pos yun ring du bzhugs/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang mngon sum du mjal/ rta mgrin yang gsang gi chos skor mtha' dag gi bka' babs brnyes sa der gda'/ phug pa 'og ma 'dir grub thob 'dar phyar nyid kyis bdag med lha mo bco lnga dang /'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes sogs kyi zhal gzigs sa der gda'/ phug pa 'di gnyis kar du grub thob des yun ring du bzhugs pas/ deng sang 'dar phyar phug pa gong 'og tu grags/ skyid phug gi 'og na mkhas btsun yon tan brgya mtsho dang / kun mkhyed chos kyi rgyal po gnyis car gyi slob ma dge slong bkra shis bzang po zhes bya ba/ mngon shes thogs med du mnga' ba/ sku gshegs dus byang chub kyi sems spyi bor 'khyil bas dbu gtsug tu gtsug tor gyi rnam pa shin tu rgyas te rmog gi khyon tsam byung ba/ de lta bu'i bzhugs gnas phug pa dang / de'i 'og phyogs na kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po nyid 'dzin pa'i nyams rtogs mthar phyin pa'i tshul bstan sa rdo rje gdan zhes bya ba'i phug pa dang / pad+ma gdan zhes bya ba'i phug pa gnyis yod/ de'i 'og g.yon ngos brag pad+ma kha 'bus lta bu'i rtse la/ chos rje kun spangs chen po dang / byang sems ༷ chen ngo/sa kyang ( 〈dzaX〉 rin po che ) cung zad bzhugs shing / mkhas btsun yon tan rgya mtshos yun ring bzhugs pa'i gzims khang bde ba can zhes bya ba 'dir/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos kyang yun ring du bzhugs/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang / khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin dregs pa'i —149—

tshogs kyis bskor ba zhal gzigs/ bde ba can gyi smon lam mdzad pas nub bde ba can gyi zhing khams kyi bkod pa dngos su gzigs shing / mthong grol gyi sku 'bum chen mo la lus kyi las dang / rgyu nor longs spyod kyi 'brel pa thogs tshad rang gi skal ba dang 'tsham par skye ba gcig nas brtsams te/ skye ba bdun tshul chad la zhing khams rnam dag bde ba can du skye la/ theg chen chos kyi dga' ston la spyod par 'gyur ba'i 'khrul med kyi ltas mngon sum du gzigs/ gnas kyi ming bde ba can mtshan don dang mthun pa lags/ de dag gi g.yon ngos phyogs blon po rin po che 'tshogs pa lta bu'i brag 'di la/ sgrub gnas dam pa gsang sngags 'jigs med seng ge rdzong zhes bya ba/ chos rje kun spangs kun tu bzang pos rnal 'byor yan lag drug pa dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor los bstan pa spel ba'i bar du dge ba'i rtags dang mtshan ma byung ba'i gnas de lags/de'i 'og tu rta ra gdong zhes grags pa 'di na/ sbud bkra o rgyan pa'i slob ma zla seng gis kyang cung zad bzhugs/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i slob ma/ grub chen rta ra ba zhes bya ba/ lce chung gi bdud rtsi kho nas tshim ste/ sku tshe smad lo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar du mi zas bza' btung gzhan rnams gsol mi dgos pa lta ci smos/mtha' na chu snyim pa gang tsam yang ma gsol ba/ gdan dang na bza' la sogs pa'i spros pa ye mi dgos pa des bzhugs shing / de'i stod brag ri ngos gzar po'i phug pa chung ngu phal gyis bgrod dka' ba 'dir/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po nyid kyi slob ma grub chen dbus pas bzhugs/ grub thob de yang zla ba phyed phyed tsam mi zas ye gsol mi dgos/ thugs nyams 'ur res kyi sku 'bum chen —150—

mo'i phyir ngos nas brgyud de rtse la thal byung du gshegs/ char khebs kyi ze pro la phyag ya re tsam zhabs ya re tsam bzhag pa'i ngang nas 'phags cing bskor ba lan mang du mdzad/ slar bum ldir chen mo'i steng du 'bebs kyi tshul du rdo rje'i skyil krung phab pas nyams sad 'gro ba zhig yin par 'dug rgyab ri'i g.yas kyi ngos la chos rje yab sras thams cad dang bla ma mkha' spyod pa la sogs pa mkhas grub dpag tu med pa'i bzhugs gnas/ mkha' spyod zung 'jug rdo rje'i rdzong zhes bya ba/ da lta 'khyog po'i brag ces zer ba yang dben gnas mchog ngo mtshar can 'di bzhugs/ 'dir chos rje kun mkhyen chen pos srog rtsol gyi nyams rtogs rgyud nas bshad pa bzhin mthar phyin pa'i tshul bstan/ de'i g.yon du brag phug pad+ma rā ga dang / g.yas su phag mo'i dur khrod do/ /gnas mchog dam pa 'dir lho nas shar gyi bar mdun gyi ri la/ phu na rdza bye 'ur grags pa 'di/ chos rje kun spangs chen po dang / byang sems chen po'i slob ma mo grub pa thob pa zhang btsun ma yon tan mtshos bzhugs shing / de ni 'dzin pa'i nyams rtogs mthar phyin/ rtsig pa la thogs med du gshegs/ ma zos bkres med zos kyang 'ju/ /thur sel mi 'dzag bde ba rgyas/ /zhes sogs kyi yon tan mngon gyur du mnga'/ phu shar nub kyi ri rtse la phar 'phur tshur 'phur mdzad par grags shing / las stod pa dbang rgyal gyis kyang bstod bskur cher mdzad pa de yin/ de rjes kun mkhyen chen pos kyang cung zad bzhugs shing /zhal slob sgrub pa mo ye shes rgyan zhes bya ba mngon shes rgya che la brtan pa mnga'/phyi nang bar gsum 'phral yun thams cad thogs med du mkhyen pa zhig dang /—151—

sgrub pa mo zhang btsun mchos mche nas bya ba/ bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems mnga' ba nus mthu chen pos/ dge slong bkra shis bzang po gshegs la khad kyi dus su/ nga'i che'i lhag ma lo bdun khyed la 'bul/ khyed kyi tshab tu nga 'gro gsung nas de ma thag snyung ba med par gshegs/ dge slong pa'ang de 'phral snyung ba gdangs/ lo bdun bzhugs te/ de lta bu'i grub brnyes ngo mtshan can de rnams kyis bzhugs pa'i gnas lags/ 'di'i g.yon na gzhong stod kyi dur khrod dang / shar ngos kyi lung pa na/ 'brog mi'i slob ma mo grub pa thob pa prad mo dkon ne'i sgrub gnas rnams bzhugs shing / gzhan yang phyis thebs pa la/kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i slob ma sgrub chen ma 'od gsa' skyid kyi sgrub gnas dang / sgrub chen ma dpal mo mtsho'i sgrub gnas/ deng sang rdza shar nub tu grags pa gnyis/ gzhan yang gling bzhir grags pa/ bde chen byang chub gling /'od zer gling / khra'u gling / bsam gto gling ste/ gling bzhi dang / dbu rtse gtsug lag khang lha khang du ma dang bcas bzhugs pa 'di lags/ de dag ni gnas spyi'i bshad pa mdo tsam lags te/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun gyi zhing khams 'dir/ /brtson 'grus ldan pas rtse gcig 'bad gyur na/ /ma dag rnam smin lus 'di gnas gyur nas/ /rdo rje'i sku mchog tshe 'di nyid la 'grub/ /brtson pa 'bring po'ang bar dor sangs rgya zhing / /brtson 'grus tha ma yis kyang lam sna zin/ /gnas mchog 'di dang cho se brgyud 'di nyid la/ /dam tshig ma nyams sdig chen ma bsags na/ /'bad rtsol med kyang snyoms las dbang gyur kyang / /gnas 'dir bsdad pa tsam gyis dge sbyor skye/ /sa bcu'i byang sems —152—

rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku/ /de dag rnams kyi byin rlabs ngang gis 'jug /dad pa chen pos phyag mchod skor ba dang / /gsol ba btab na yid ches 'phral 'phral 'byung / /lan gcig mjal ba'ang bar chad kun zhi zhing / /lan gsum bskor bas ngan 'gro'i skye sgo khegs/ /lan mang mjal na mtshams med byas pa yang / /rnam par dag nas bde chen gnas su 'gro/ /mthong thos dran reg thams cad don ldan pa'i/ /gnas mchog 'di dang mtshungs pa 'ga' yang med/ /zung 'jug ye shes chen po'i pho brang 'dir/ /dad pa bskyed cing 'brel ba 'jog pa rnams/ /tshe ring nad med bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ /rnam mkhyen go 'phang thob pa'i dge legs 'phel/ /〈zhes dge slong kun dga' snying pos bris/〉 bkra shis/ dge legs 'phel/sras bcas rgyal ba kun gyis byin brlabs pas/ /dngos grub thams cad 'bad med 'byung ba'i gnas/ /'dir ni mkha' mnyam sems can don phyir du/ /bdag kyang sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin par shog khu bhaX/—153—

nga khrind bzhu/gas/oṃ swā sti/ dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo dang / /rdo rje phag mo rnal 'byor ma/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug birlu pa/ /chos sku kun bzang gnyis pa ni/ /kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus sogs/ /chos rje yab sras rnam bzhi yi/ /zhabs kyi pad mo la btud de/ /'dir tshogs rnams la byin gyis rlobs/ sgrub gnas skyid phug bde ldan 'di'i che ba'i dbang du byas na/ shes rab e yig chos kyi 'byung gnas mchog /waX yig bde ba che dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /zung 'jug ye shes mtshon pa'i brda thabs can/ /gnas kyi bkod pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung / /lhun stug brag ri yangs shing mtho ba ni/ /rnam dag lta ba mtho zhing yangs pa mtshon/ /de la bya rgyal 'phur lding rol ba ni/ /nyams rtogs yon tan sna tshogs 'char ba'i rtags/ /rtsa ba me tog 'bras bu'i tshal gyis mdzes/ /rtags dang nyams myong phyogs med shar ba mtshon/ /ri dwags tshogs rnams dga' zhing rtse ba'i gnas/ /thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba skyong ba'i rtags/ /gsang ba nam mkha'i khams kyi phug pa ni/ /rdo rje phag mo'i gnas mchog pā ṭa na/ /rang byung mchod rten gnas dang mtshungs pa ste/ /dus dang dus la bdud rtsi'i dri bzang 'byung / /de yang gshin rje gshed dmar nag gi rgyud las gsungs pa/ tse t+ya pā ṭa na mchod rten gyi grong khyer zhes kyang bya/ dgyes rdor dang kha sbyor sogs las/—154—

tsā ri tra zhes bshad pa/ rgya gar lho phyogs na 'phrin las kyi rdo rje phag mo'i rang byung gi gnas myos byed bzang po'i dri rang byung du 'thul ba zhig yod pa yin la/de dang mtshungs par gnas mchog dam pa 'dir yang / rdo rje phag mos byin gyis brlabs pa'i rang byung gi gnas yin pa'i rtags su dus bzang ci rigs pa la nang mchod kyi dri bzang po rang byung du 'thul ba'i rnam pa da lta yang 'byung / de la gnas 'dir chos rje kun spangs chen pos/ sgrub gnas kyi dge mtshan du ma yod par gzigs te/ dbyar dgun bcu gsum tsam bzhugs/ de rjes yab sras gzhan gnyis kyis kyang thog re bzhugs shing / de nas kun spangs chos grags dpal bzang la sogs pa du mas rim can du bzhugs/ khyad par kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas kyis kyang lo gnyis bzhugs shing / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel yongs su rdzogs pa'i gzab bshad thog mar mdzad pa'i gnas yin la/ yang sngon chos rje kun spangs chen pos slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birlu pa dngos su zhal gzigs/ lam 'bras kyi 'khrugs sdeb pa dang / rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi khyi ka gyis shig par lung bstan pa yang brnyes/ lam 'bras kyi bstan bcos rnams kyang 'dir mdzad par gda' bas/ slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug birlu pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas chen yang yin no/ / zhus dag //dge legs 'phel// //—155—

oX swā sti/ rdo rje ༵chang dbang dpal ldan dus 'khor dang / /zhes pa nas/ri khrod chen po jo mo nang zhes yongs su grags pa 'di'i gnas kyi yang dben rgyal mtshan gyi tog lta bur gyur pa ni/ sgrub gnas mkha' spyod bde ldan zhes bya ba 'di yin la/ sa'i mthil chos 'byung gru gsum lta bu/ lung pa pad+ma 'dab brgyad kha phye ba 'dra ba/ gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi dbyibs can/ mdun ri 'bru'i phung po la rin po che'i 'phreng ba lan gsum du g.yogs pa 'dra ba/lho'i ri rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa las/ bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'babs pa lta bu/ lho nub kyi phyogs na rgyal ba thams cad skyed pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo'i sku'i rnam pa can gyi ri mthon po/ chu skyes kyi ze'u 'bru rgod pa'i dbus nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'bab pa/ de'i drung na dngos grub 'byung ba phag mo'i dur khrod dang bcas pa/ de dang nye ba'i g.yas kyi ri la dung dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa bkra shis kyi rtags brgyad tshang ba/ rgyab ri bdud rtsi can gyi shing gi nags tshal gyis khebs pa/ sku gsung thugs rnamapar dag pa'i ri bo rtse mo gsum pa rigs gsum mgon po'i tshul du bzhugs shing / g.yon gyi phyogs na brag rgyal po chen po sde bzhi chos nyan pa'i rnam pa can dang / mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brag phug pad+ma rā ga la sogs pa sgrub gnas dgomatshan can du ma'i dbus na/ brag ri rdo rje rtse lnga pa lta bu'i steng du/ rigs ldan —156—

sprul pa'i sku kun spangs kun tu bzang pos sgrub gnas chen po mdzad/ byangasems chen po dang mkhas btsun chen pos kyang rim can du bzhugs/ chos rje kun mkhyen chen pos kyang lo gnyis ngo gsum bzhugs/ sor sdud bas5btan srog rtsol gsum mthar phyin pa'i tshul ston sa yang 'di lags/ de rjes dam pa de nyid kyi thugs sras bla ma sangs rgyas bzang po zhes bya ba/ 'khrungs yul dbu ru stod pa yin/ dgon pa sprin chen du rab byung mdzad/ mkhas btsun yon to rgya mtsho'i yang zhabs la thug /chos rje kun mkhyen chen po'i drung du rnal 'byorayan lag drug pa'i 'khrid zhus nas/ gnas 'dir sgrub pa yun ring du mdzad pas bla ma mkha' spyod par grags/ srog rtsol gyi gegs byung ba yang kun mkhyen chen pos sel bar mdzad/ de nas mngon shes khyad par can 'khrungs temakha' spyod kyi mun khang du bzhugs bzhin pa nas/ dgon pa nags phug gogatsug lag khang gi gsung rab po ti thams cad chos 'don byed pa bzhin du klog thub pa dang / gzhan yang mngon shes thogs med mnga' ste/ 'on kyang yon tan thams cad sbas pa'i tshul du mdzad/ kun mkhyen chen po sku bzhugs pa'iring la 'dzin pa'i nyams rtogs mthar phyin phyis gzims khang du khong rang gcig pu bzhugs pa la/ phyi nas nyan dus rol mo'i sgra grag pa yang yang byung/nang gcig rol mo'i sgra shin tu yun ring ba zhig byung nas/ gzhan rnams kyis lta bar phyin pas/ na bza' shul har re lus 'dug ste/ gnas skabs de nyid du 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku brnyes pas/ sngar bla ma mkha' spyod pa zhes mtshan thogasapa yang don dang ldan par song ngo / /de ltar na skyes bu dam pa de mkha' spyod du —157—

gshegs pa'i gnas 'di yin cing / de rjes su skyes bu dam pa bsam gyisamikhyab pa khyon pa lags so/ /sgrub gnas las kyang sgrub gnas mchog gi phul/ /dben gnas las kyang yang dben 'byog po'i brag /ngo mtshar las kyangango mtshar rmad byung gnas/ /nyams dga' las kyang nyams dga'i ting 'dzin 'phel/ /lung pa'i mthil gyi ri dang sa gzhi dang / /chu rnams 'dus pa ye yigachos 'byung 'dra/ /bar gyi cha ni pad+ma rgyas pa bzhin/ /dri med nam mkha'i ngos ni 'khor lo 'dra/ /shar ri rin chen 'bras bu'i phung po dang / /lho yi ri ni rgyal ba tshe dpag med/ /nub dang bden bral rnal 'byor ma dpal dbyibs/ /byangagophyogs na mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i phug /rgyab ri rigs gsum mgon po lta bu la/ /g.yon nas rgyal chen bzhi yi chos nyan tshul/ /gnas kyi lteb rdo rje rtse lnga 'dra/ /brag ri rin chen rdul mang brtsegs pa'i steng / /bla ma'i gzhims khangamakha' spyod bde ldan zhes/ /grub rigs bye ba phrag brgyas brten pa yod/ rtswagasum rnam par dag pa mtshon byed du/ /bdud rtsi lta bu'i chu rgyun gsum yanga'abab/ /bsil dang dro dang bsil drod snyoms pa ste/ /nus pa'i khyad par rtsa —dang mtshungs pa yin/ /gnas mchog 'di ru phyag dang bskor ba dang / /byin rlabs sgrub chu 'thungs dang khrus byas pa/ /de dag thams cad bde 'gro bzangapor 'gro /lan gcig tsam gyis bar chad sel ba dang / /lan mang bskor bsasdig sgrib thams cad 'byang / /gnas mchog 'di yang rgyal ba'i sprul pa ste/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa e ma ho/ /gnas kyi srung ma gnod sgyin rdzu'aphrul can/ /che btsan dpa' bo brag rje zhes bya bar/ /ming 'dogs bsgyur—158—

nas bka' yi srung ma mdzad//she ༵ rnam daX rngi 'a po she//si pa ṣ+ka nas ༵ba la~X 'a pa//rda rja' rnal 'byar rtsa gcag yeXrda/ la//hūṃgatu gal dri kyi par 'phran las sgrub//kyai grub 'i yi za dang zag pa stu / rwa de na tu/mkhan/zhe/lte/na sprod pa dge ba'i//gnas 'a na tuganyan sa grags pa byung /chas/ bzhan spyad pa da ba 'a ngang tshul/can//bsta/da pa tsam gyis ting 'dzin ngang gis skye//cung zad goms na lhag par bogasaskye/bye nge ru mi dge 7 yi ri 9ri rbe/ rten 9 na rje sderdebad //phya zing gsang ba sa kha na nyad kya/she/'a 'a mtshan rtan 'asa'i 'dus pa yan//bla ma muX༈ maXḍi 'gra' byan rla~Xs kyas//༵brosa'adaX rda/zhugs dang da 'a bska~Xb sags//rnam dag gzi ge delaḍi 'a 'a pa rnams//sdod skyad phun gi rten sangs she pa ji'i she/ dadzhain phya' she lte she rimang/'a rtan spyod she ltar 'as pa sbyar bshad da//'khyag pa khrad kya gnas brdo/da dge'//zhus dag///

nga5nad bzhugs/oX swā sti/ 'dir dus gsum du byon pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi zhing khams kyi mchog 'og min stug po bkod pa dang gnyis su ma mchis pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'phags tshogs rgya mtsho 'du ba'i gnas chen 'dzam gling bye ba phrag brgya'i chos gzhi mtha' dag gi gtsug gi nor bu/ ting 'dzin 'bum phrag brgya'i 'byung gnas/ legs bshad bye ba sgrog pa'i skyed tshal/'gro kun thar par bgrod pa'i them skas/ srid zhi'i phan bde kun gyi rtsa ba/mchog dang thun mong 'grub pa'i zhing sa/ kun khyab 'phrin las 'bar ba'i nyid byed/ phyogs bcu dus gsum rab 'byams srid zhi mtha' dag gi rnam dkar legs tshogs thams cad 'bad rtsol med par lhun grub ngang gis 'du ba'i gnas/ dga' ldan phun tshogs gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gtsug lag khang 'di'i lo rgyus kyi dbang du byas na/ rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i thugs rje can/ /mnyam med shākya seng ge dus 'khor lo/ /gsang bdag 'jam dpal phyag na pad+ma sogs/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug chos rgyal rigs ldan tshogs/ /'phags yul grub pa'i gtsug rgyan dus 'khor zhabs/ /bstan pa 'di la mkhas dang grub pa'i dpal/ /bgrang bar mi dpyod yang dag lam ston pa/ /kun gyi rgyan gyur 'gran pa'i zla bral ba/ /chos kyi rgyal po shes rab rgyal mtshan —160—

dpal/ /dol po ba zhes snyan pa'i 'brug sgra yis/ /phyogs kyi 'khor lo ma lus bgengs mdzad pa/ khyod ni sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin te/ /sangs rgyas kun yang khyed kyi rnam 'phrul lags/ /byang chub sems dpa' kun gyi yab kyang khyed/ /nyan thos rang rgyal 'phags tshogs ma lus pa'i/ /rten dang mgon skyabs bla ma khyed gcig pu/ /drag po 'jug sel dbyig gi snying po sogs/dregs ldan kun gyis mchod bstod bkur sti'i yul/ /rgyal ba khyed las gzhan du ma mchis te/ /'gro ba drug tu 'khor ba'i skye 'gro'i tshogs/ /kun gyi skyob pa gcig po'ang rgyal ba khyod/ /srid zhir gtogs pa'i skye bo thams cad la/ /mtha' dag legs lam stsal ba'ang khyod nyid lags/ /de ltar skyabs gnas rgya mtsho dkon mchog gsum/ /kun 'dus dus gsum sangs rgyas jo nang ba/ /kun gyi byed po 'dren mchog bla med des/ /srid gsum mtha' dag skyong ba'i dge legs stsol/ /de ltar na/ sgrub gnas thams cad kyi rgyal po/ ri khrod chen po dpal jo mo nang gi gnas kyi sgo chen por gyur pa 'di nyid la dang por phyi 'byung bas sgrub pa'i dge mtshan gyi dbang du byas na/ brtan cing brjid la mtho zhing lhun chags pa/ /lhun po bye ba phrag brgya'i dpal yon can/ /nags rgyal zhes bya ri'i dbang po'i 'dabs/ sa bsrung bu yi gdong gi dbyibs can yod/ /rgyab ri nor bu'i brag tshogs gtams pa ni/ /lha min g.yul 'joms lha tshogs dbugs 'byin mdzad/ /rgyal chen rnam mang thos pa 'gying pa'i sku/ /seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa'i rnam pa can/ /de yi mdun du rin chen char 'bab cing / /gter gyi bum pa —161—

'dra ba'i rtags mtshan dang / /mdun nas bltas na g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung / /rgyab bltas bang rim dang bcas mchod rten dbyibs/ /rin chen rdul brtsegs mkha' la rnyog pa 'dra/ /de dang nye ba'i ngos la dge mtshan ni/ /dpal gyi be'u la sogs bkra shis kyi/ /rtags brgyad po rnams yongs su tshang bar yod/ /sa gzhi shar dang dbang ldan phyogs su gzhol/ /nub dang lho yi phyogs su pags kyis mtho/ /rgyud sde kun las dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa yi/ /sa gzhi'i mtshan nyid mchog tu bsngags pa yin/ /byang gi phyogs su lu hi tar grags pa/ /rig byed gzhung las tshangs pa'i sras su bshad/ /chu klung kun gyi rgyal po grags ldan 'bab/ /'bab chu gzhan yang g.yas phyogs 'khyil bas 'gro /shar phyogs ri 'di blon po rin chen 'dra/ /nyi zla gza' skar thams cad 'char ba'i gnas/ /shar lho'i phyogs na nor bu rin chen brag /rnam mang chos dang nor gter du mas gang / /lho phyogs grub pa'i gnas chen kun kyi gtso/ /mtha' yas dngos grub bye ba'i gter chen bzhugs/ /bden bral ngos la 'khor lo rin po che/ /nye ba brtan cing rtsibs brgyad gsal bar snang / /chu bdag phyogs kyi ri bo mgyogs 'gro'i gtso/ /rnam dkar dge ba'i lam dang bcas te yod/ /nub byang khyim bdag rin chen go mtshon bcas/ /snying stobs sra zhing brtan pa dpa' bo'i tshul/ /byang phyogs shes rab mtshan ldan nags kyi ri/ /btsun mo dam pa'i rnam pa mchog tu gsal/ /dbang ldan mtshams na glang chen lus rgyas pa/ /'gying zhing gus pas tshur la 'ong ba'i tshul/ /mkha' la 'khor lo bcu drug rtsibs ldan dang / /sa gzhi la yang pad+ma rgyas pa'i tshul/ /g.yas kyi ri bo mtho —162—

zhing skyob 'dra dang / /g.yon phyogs dar dkar yol ba brkyang ba bzhin/ /rgyab ri mtho zhing gzengs mtho lhun re chags/ /rgya nag rtsis kyis dpyad nas 'byung ba bzhin/ /shar gyi stag dang lho yi g.yu 'brug dang / /nub kyi bya dang byang gi rus sbal sogs/ /mdor na rgyal pa'i bka' dang 'jig rten gyi/ /gtsug lag rnams las ji skad bshad pa yi/ /sa gzhi'i dge mtshan ji snyed bshad pa yi/ /sa gzhi'i dge mtshan ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /thams cad gnas mchog 'di la tshang bar bzhugs/ /gnas mchog dam pa 'dir ni sus 'dug kyang / /chags sdang la sogs nyon mongs shas chung zhing / /dge ba'i chos rnams gong nas gong du 'phel/ /gnyid rmugs gsal zhing rig pa dwangs pa'i gnas/ /zhen chags chung zhing nges 'byung 'phel ba'i gnas/ /gnod sems zhi zhing snying rje rgyas pa'i gnas/ /rnam g.yengs sangs shing zhi gnas brtan pa'i gnas/ /log lta mi 'byung lhag mthong ngang gis skye/ /gnas mchog 'di dang mtshungs pa gzhan yod min/ /phyogs 'dzin can gyi bsngags pa brjod pa dang / /the rang 'gong pos grags pa bsgrags pa dang / /dbang sdud nor sgrub la sogs rten 'brel gyis/ /'du 'tshog byung zhing grags pa tsam zhig la/ /rmongs pa'i 'gro rnams chu ltar rgyug bzhin du/ /zhing mchog yin par 'khrul dang 'di mi mnyam/ /gzhan du lo dang zla ba bsgoms pa pas/ /gnas mchog 'dir ni zhag dang za ma tsam/ /bsgoms pa'i phan yon lhag par che ba yin/ /gzhan du yun ring dge sbyor 'bad pa bas/ /sdig pa'i las spangs chos dang bla ma la/ /mos gus byas nas gnas 'dir nyal ba yang / /bla med byang chub mchog la shin tu —163—

nye/ /nya pa gdol pa ri dwags dman pa dang / /mtshams med byas pa la sogs sdig can yang / /rang nyid dad pa'am gzhan gyis bskul yang rung / /gnas 'di bskor zhing gtsug lag khang la lta/ khrus byas phyag dang bskor ba mchod pa 'bul/ /de yi sdig pa dag nas lha yul skye/ /skye bo gzhan dag smos kyang ci zhig dgos/ /gnas mchog 'di ni mthong ba don ldan yin/ /de yang ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi thugs rje'i 'od zer la brten nas 'dzam gling yangs pa'i rgyal khams 'dir/ skyes bu dam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon mod kyang / rgya bod la sogs pa 'dzam gling lho phyogs kyi dum bu 'dir/ nges pa'i don gyi gnad ma lus shing lus pa med pa phyin ci ma log cing ma 'khrul ba rgya cher gsungs pas/ skal ldan gyi skye bo gzhal du med pa tshim par mdzad pa ni/rgyal ba nyid kyis rnga bo che'i mdo dang / u dum ba ra'i me tog lhar dkon pa'i mdo sde la sogs pa/ mdo sde du ma zhig nas lung bstan pa'i/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po dus gsum sangs rgyas dol po pa shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba'i zhing khams thams cad du mtshan snyan pa'i 'brug sgras khyab pa/ mkhas grub kyi bstan 'dzin gza' skar bye ba phrag brgya'i dbus na mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ye shes yon tan 'phrin las 'od stong bdag po'i tshul gyis/ gzhan thams cad zil gyis mnan te bzhugs pa de yin pa gda'/ de nyid kyi ye shes chen po'i cho 'phrul las sprul pa ni/ rnga bo che'i le'u zhes bya ba/ nges don mthar thug ma sbas shing gsar bar bstan pa'i mdo sde chen po de nyid kyi/ tha ma'i tshig gis lung bstan pa/ 'dzam gling lho phyogs kyi —164—

rgyud 'dir shin tu phyi mar gyur pa'i dus su yang / li tsa bī gzhon nu/ 'jig rten kun gyis mthong na dga' ba/ dge slong blo 'chang ste/ shes rab rgyal mtshan ces bya bar gyur pa de nyid/ sngar yang shin tu phyi mar gyur pa'i dus der byung nas/ nga'i bstan pa gsal bar byed do zhes 'byung ba'i gnas gang du bstan pa gsal bar 'gyur ba'i chos gzhi gtsug lag khang gi gtso bo ni/ rtag brtan dam pa'i chos kyi gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal zhes bya ba 'di nyid yin te/ don la bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thugs rje'i bdag nyid can gyi bka' las lung bstan pa lags/ de yang rnga bo che'i mdo las/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po dol po sangs rgyas de nyid kyis/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyi ma ltar gsal bar mdzad cing / lo brgyad cu'i bar du nges don gyi bstan pa phyogs thams cad du dar bar gyur la/ de nas bar skabs der cung zad nges pa'i don gyi bstan pa mi gsal bar gyur pa na/ slar yang chos kyi rgyal po de nyid 'gro ba'i don du bshes gnyen dam pa'i tshul bzung ste/ sprul pa'i skus nges pa'i don gyi bstan pa gsal bar mdzad tshul lung bstan pa ni/ kye ma 'jig rten kun mthong dga'/ /bstan pa dge slong gzugs gyur nas/ /ring zhig bstan pa 'byin byed cing / /chos kyi rnga chen brdung bar 'gyur/ /de na mya ngan yongs 'das nas/ /de 'og 'jig rten stong par 'gyur/ /chos smra de ni 'das gyur nas/ /de 'dra gzhan ni 'ga' mi 'byung / /de 'dra'i dge slong rnyed dka' ste/ /rim gyis snang ba nyams par 'gyur/ /'di ltar de ni lho phyogs su/ /'byung pa'i tha ma gcig yin no/ /dam pa'i chos de nub pa'i dus su slar yang chos smra ba de 'byung par 'gyur —165—

ro/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'dir lho phyogs su 'byung ba zhes bshad pa ni/ 'dzam bu gling gi phyed lho ma chu bo si ti'i lho phyogs su 'byon pa'i don yin la/ de yang shin tu dus kyi tha mar/ de nyid 'byon par gsungs pa ni/ bdag cag gi rje btsun dam pa 'dis/ slar yang nges don gyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad pa lung bstan pa yin par gda'/ de la shing mo yos kyi lo/ dbo'i zla ba'i tshes bcu gcig gza' tshes sbyor ba byed pa thams cad shin tu bkra shis pa la sa chog mdzad/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang sangs rgyas byang sems dpag tu med pa nam mkha' la byon pa'i ltas dang / dpal ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas mngon sum du byon nas/ gnas de bdag gir mdzad pa'i bkod pa dang / phyi ltas shin tu ngo mtshar ba mang po dang bcas nga/ byung zhing / de rjes kyi nag pa zla ba'i tshes brgyad la/ gtsug lag khang gi rmangs dang por bting / nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od kyi bkod pa ngo mtshar can dang / me tog gi char chen po snyon med du mthong / de snga sa phyogs 'di kun na grog mo la sogs pa srog chags mang yang / de phyin chad nas srog chags ches dkon zhing / gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i sa rdo'i bya ba byed pa kun la yang / srog chags kyi rigs gtan nas med par song / gnas gzhi dgon sde chen po 'di nyid bzhengs pa'i dus skabs thams cad du/ las byed kyi skye bo thams cad kyang / gzhan gyis bskul ba la ma ltos par/ rab tu dga' zhing spro bas las la ngang gi 'jug pa dang / mtshan mo'i cha la skye bo thams cad nyal ba'i skabs su yang / sa rdo shing gsum gyi las ka byed mkhan mang po yod pa 'dra ba dang / phyis bris 'bur —166—

brdung gsum gyi rten bzhengs pa'i skabs su yang / nam gung las de dang de byed pa po mang du 'tshogs pa lta bu dang / sgra di ri ri yang nas yang du 'byung ba dang /rdo leb chen po mi mang pos 'degs dgos pa yang / mtshan mo phan tshun thag ring bar bskyal ba dang / bsnor te 'jog pa dang / ches cher shin tu lci ba'i khur chen po dag khye'u bu mo chung ngu res kyang theg pa dang / dgon pa dang nye bar lu ma bkod ma'i chu mig chen po sngar med gsar du brdol ba sogs/ mi'i 'gro ba so so skye bo'i mthong thos kyi spyod yul du yang / sde brgyad dregs pa can rnams dang / dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gyis 'phrin las kyi mthun 'gyur mdzad pa'i rtags bshad kyis mi lang ba yod de ye shes 'phags pa'i spyod yul la bsam gyis ga la khyab/ gtsug lag khang gi zhal sa rnams nam dgos dgos su gter nas thon pa lta bu sa rdo shing sogs dkon pa ltar snang ba thams cad kyang 'bad med lhun grub tu byung / sngar gyi de kha'i 'phros la/ hor zla drug pa chu stod kyi tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin par/ snga dro'i tsha ba thon pa nas/ nyi ma phyed yun la gtsug lag khang chen mo'i ka ba sum cu so drug po/ mi nyung dus dka' las med par tshugs pa dang / 'di'i thog gi shing thams cad kyang nyi ma gcig la khel/de skabs dpal mgon po'i 'khor rnams de 'dra ba'i las la zhugs pa'i tshul gsal bar gzigs pa yin pa yang gda'/ gsum pa nang gi gtsug lag khang rten gsum dang bcas pa/ ji ltar bzhugs pa'i dbang du byas na/ sa phyogs 'di nyid ri'i rtsa ba nas khri stegs yan chad/ e yig chos kyi 'byung gnas rtse mo shar du bstan pa'i rnam pa can/ de'i nang gi ngos yangs pa'i phyogs su spyir 167—

gnas gzhi 'di nyid dang / khyad par gtsug lag khang baX yig bde ba chen po'i tshul du bzhugs pa lags/ de la sngon 'o skol gyi ston pa'i bzhugs gnas/rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal la sogs pa shin tu gtso bor gyur pa thams cad dang mthun par/ dbus su gtsug lag khang chen po/ de'i mtha' la gtsug lag khang bcu drug gzhan yang ji ltar 'os par/ gtsug lag khang ches mang ba dang bcas te bzhugs pa yin pa las/ dbus kyi gtsug lag khang chen po 'di nyid rang la yang / nang tshan du lha khang ji snyed cig mchis pa las/ dri gtsang khang phyur bu/gtsug lag khang thams cad kyi gtso bo 'di nyid kyi dbang du byas na/ so so thar pa'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyob/ /'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub 'od srung dang / shwakya thub pa go taX lha yi lha/ /mi 'dul kha lo bsgyur ba bla na med/ / 'jig rten mgon po skyob pa'i mchogasangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun po ste/ /grags ldan rnams kyi so so thar/ /'di ni rab tu rgyas par ston/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bskal pa 'di'i sngon rol bskal pa dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa la/ bcom ldan 'das rnam gzigs 'jig rten du byon/ de'i rjes kyi drug bcu pa la/ gtsug tor can byon/ de rjes bzhi bcu pa la thams cad skyob byon/ bskal pa bzang po 'di nyid la/ mi rnams kyi tshe lo bzhi khri thub pa la/ bcom ldan 'das log par dad sel lam/ 'khor ba 'jig 'jig rten du byon/ gsum khri thub pa nas gser thub byon/ nyi khri thub pa nas 'od srung byon/ tshe lo brgya ba'i gnas skabs na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ston pa —168—

shākya thub pa 'jig rten du byon te/ de ltar na sangs rgyas bdun po de dag /sngon thugs bskyed pa'i gnas skabs nas bzung / 'gro ba'i don la mchog tu dpa' pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun zhes grags/ de yang spyir de dang 'dra ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas pa byon mod kyi/ bdun gyi grangs su bcad pa ni/ sa phyogs 'jig rten khams 'di'i dbang du byas/ dus kyang sangs rgyas gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa'i dbang du byas na/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun po 'di dag ni/ 'dul ba'i bstan pa bslab bya phra mo thams cad kyang gcig pa yin la/ gzhan dang gzhan dag ni/ gnad kyi dgongs don gcig tu zin yang bcas mtshams sna tshogs pa dag ni yul dus so so'i gdul bya rnams kyi bsam pa'i khyad par las mang nyung rgyas bsdus/ yangs dog ma nges pa sna tshogs shig yod pa'i rigs su gda'/ des na 'phags pa'i yul na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rnal ma yod pa'i phyogs su ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sku gzugs bzhengs pa dang / gsol ba 'debs pa la sogs pa'i srol ka shin tu dar ba yin/ phyogs 'dir yang de dar bar 'gyur ba'i mig ltas khyad par can bzhag pa'i phyir dang / don gyi gtso bo sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyi sku gzugs shin tu chung ba ma yin pa myongs gcig tu bzhugs pa der/ gnas skabs su yul phyogs thams cad bde zhing skyid pa dang / mthar thug mthong thos dran reg thams cad thar ba mchog gi sa bon thebs par 'gyur pa la gzhan pas kyang lhag par stobs che ba yin bar snang bas de la dgongs pa yin pa 'dug /de yang gtsug lag khang chen po 'di nyid kyi rten gtso thub pa'i dbang po 'di la sku —169—

rgyab mtho nyi shu rtsa gsum/ de'i g.yas phyogs su bzhugs pa bcom ldan 'das rnam gzigs/ sku'i g.yon gyi phyogs su bcom ldan 'das rin chen gtsug tor can/ de dag gi yang g.yas phyogs na/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad skyob/g.yon phyogs na log par dad sel te de rnams zhal shar gzigs su mdzad/de dag gi g.yas phyogs zhal byang gzigs na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gser thub dang / g.yon phyogs kyi zhal lho gzigs 'di/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srung yin te/ de ltar drug po 'di rnams la rgyab mtho bcu gnyis re yod/ sku rgyu'i dbang du byas na/ sku rgyu shin tu 'thug par yod cing / so so'i rgyab yol tshun chad kyang / gser dngul zangs gsum las grub par bzhugs pas/ sku rgyur zangs khal brgyad brgya lhag pa dang / gser zho stong phrag bdun tsam dang /gzhan yang de la dpags pa'i rgyu tshogs shin tu rgya che ba dang / yon rdzongs dga' ston sogs chos nas bshad tshod dang mthun pa/ skye bo mang po'i bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po spel ba'i slad du gnang bar gda'/ nang bzhugs kyi dbang du byas na/ gtso bo'i dbu gtsug na de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring srel 'khrul med 'phags pa'i yul nas gsar du byon pa/ rin po che dwangs ma'i kha dog thams cad zil gyis gnon par byed pa cig dang / bod yul gyi 'phel gdung rnam bzhir grags pa sogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung yid ches can shin tu mang ba dang / byang chub shing gi yal ga gcig me tog lo ma mang po dang / mkhas grub dam pa so so'i thugs dam kyi rten dang / dbu skra na bza' sogs byin rlabs gzi byin rgyas pa'i nang bzhugs rnam grangs sum cu rtsa bdun —170—

tsam dang / rgyud sde bzhi'i gzungs sngags kyi tshogs mtha' yas pa go rim ma 'khrul ba dang / rgya bod kyi gnas chen kun gyi sa rdo shing sogs rten 'brel gyi rdzas du mas gtams par bzhugs/ rnam gzigs la sogs pa'i sku brnyan drug po 'di rnams la'ang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phel gdung 'khrul med bcu re dang / byang chub shing gi lo ma sogs byin rlabs kyi rten gtso bo nyid dang phal cher cha 'dra bar bzhugs/ rab gnas skabs dge mtshan gyi dbang du byas na/sa pho rta'i lo khrums kyi zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi nas brtsams te/ tha skar gyi yar ngos tshes gsum gyi bar la/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa dang / bde mchog lha hi pa dang / gshin rje gshed nag po dang / rdo rje 'jig byed dang / mi g.yo bla med dang / phyag na rdo rje gtum po dang / phag mo lha so bdun ma dang / bdag med lha mo bco lnga dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor rnams zhal phye nas rab gnas tshar re re mdzad par gda'/ sa mo lug lo'i chu'i zla ba'i yar ngo'i nang du yang / sangs rgyas thod pa dang / ye shes dbang phyug ma dang / sems 'grel lugs kyi bde mchog ste/ dkyil 'khor de gsum gyi steng nas rab gnas tshar gsum/ lo de nyid kyi chu stod zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin/ dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor steng nas rab gnas rgyas pa gcig ste mdor na rab gnas tshar bcu gsum dang / skya ser skye bo yongs 'dus pa'i zhal gro dga' ston chen mo tshar gsum mdzad/ rab gnas kyi skabs thams cad du me tog gi char dang 'ja' 'od sogs nyin re bzhin du byung zhing / skabs 'gar sgra dang dri bzang gis khyab pa sogs lan mang du byung /—171—

rab gnas thog ma'i skabs/ yungs kar bum nang du lhung ba/ myu gu skyes nas zla ba phyed tsam nas me tog shar ba dang / bar ba'i skabs/ 'phags yul ma ga dha'i phyogs nas spru' pa'i rnal 'byor pas sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs spyan drangs te/ rab gnas dngos gzhi dang po'i ye shes spyan 'dren nyid kyi skabs phebs pa dang / rab gnas gsum pa'i skabs su/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos khra 'brug bzhengs dus/ zo thang nas spyan drangs pa'i dang por sku'i rnam pa rags rim rang byon la/ bal po'i bzo bos cung zad tsam sgros gtsang bar byas pa'i thub pa'i sku brnyan bla ma sman chu kha pas spyan drangs te/ shar phyogs nas byon pa sogs phyi nang gi ltas thams cad legs/ rten 'brel thams cad bzang ba'i phyogs su 'grig pa yin par 'dug jo bo phyogs las rnam rgyal 'di'i dbang du byas na/ ston pa'i rgyal tshab 'od srung chen po seng ge'i khri la 'khod pa nas lo brgya tsam myo// rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub chen po bzhengs/ dus de tsam na/lha'i bzo bos bzhengs pa'i sku gzugs 'phrul dang ldan pa mang du byung / 'phrul snang gi jo bo shākya mu ni la che ba dbyung ba'i gtam rgyud mi 'dra ba du ma yod kyang /dus de skabs ka byon par gda'/ dpal byang chub chen po bzhugs pa'i phyogs mtshams brgyad na/ gan dho la brgyad yod/ de dag re re na lha khang re re/ mdzad pa brgyad kyi nang nas mdzad pa re re'i sku brnyan bzhugs/ de thams cad lha'i bzos bos bzhengs pa yin par gda'/ jo bo phyogs las rnam rgyal 'di ni de'i nang nas/ glang po che nor skyong btul ba de yin/ lha sa 'phrul snang gi byams pa chos kyi 'khor lo dang / ra mo che na bzhugs pa'i jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje dang /—172—

phyogs las rnam rgyal 'di gsum zhal bzhin sogs bzo bkod dbyibs khyad par med pa lta bur bzhugs/ 'di yang dang por chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i thugs dam gyi rten mdzad cing pho brang du bzhugs pa yin/ de nas chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi ring la/ bsam yas kyi phyogs su phebs/ bad rngam pa'i lha khang du bzhugs pa las/ dus phyis chus gnod pa chen po byung ba'i skabs shigabad rngam pa dang hwa shang lha khang sogs mang po zhig la chu skyon byung / sku 'di re zhig ma rnyed/ klus spyan drangs pa yin nam zer ba yang byung ste/ phyis lo shas lon dus bsha' bud kyi non pa sogs ye med par lha khang gi shul nas rnyed/rim pas pho brang sno'u gdong sogs rgyud nas/ lcags mo bya'i lo la gtsug lag khang chen po 'dir phebs pa lags/ de rjes khri rgyab la sogs pa rje btsun nyid kyi zhal bkod mdzad nas bzhengs/ 'gro ba'i don du mnga' gsol mdzad de/byin rlabs kyi gzi byin mkha' dbyings gang bar bzhugs pa 'di lags/ 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal hor rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' sbyin bdag mdzad de spar rnams bzhengs pa rin po che du ma bsres pa'i mtshal gyi spar btab par 'dug /bod dbus gtsang gi rgyal khams su 'di lta bu tshar gsum las lhag pa ma byon par grags shing / gzhan gnyis po dus phyis kha thig tshang ba med par 'dug 'di yongs rdzogs ma tshang ba med pa/ glegs shing tshun chod rgya yul nyid du bcos pa'i tshad khang gi ri mo can cha lag thams cad kha thig tshang bar bzhugs/ de rjes logs bris kyi lha rnams dang / rgyab yol la bzhugs pa'i lha rnams 'di dang 'di lta bu'o zhes ngo sprad/ logs bris —173—

la/ dus kyi 'khor lo lha lnga/ bde mchog nag po zhabs lugs rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang bcas pa/ rdo rje shugs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor/rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ kun mkhyen chen po/ gur mgon lcam dral/ rnam thos sras/lha chen rnams kyi sku rgyab ngos la rgyal ba rigs drug sgrub pa po'i tshul du rje btsun nyid kyi sku 'dra dang bcas pa bzhugs/ de rjes sku gzhan tsho dang zab sku sogs kyang 'tsham pa bshad/ gtsug lag khang gi khyams 'di'i logs bris kyi dbang du byas na/ nges don mdo nyi shu zhes grags pa'i gleng gzhi so so'i mdo bkod dang / dus kyi 'khor lo rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud gsungs tshul dang / gzhan yang ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyi mdzad pa'i rnam grangs ci rigs pa dang bcas pa spel nas bkod pa yin pa 'dug ka ring gnyis ma gtogs pa'i ka ba sum cu so bzhi'i zhu'i ngos la/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khrungs rabs so bzhi slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i gzhung dang mthun par bkod/ yang mdo bkod kyi bar bar na bzhugs pa 'di rnams/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug dang / dpal ldan sham bha lar byon pa'i chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams kyi sku brnyan yin lags/ de nas zhing khams bzhi bcu po re re bzhin du ngo sprad/ seng ge bubs kyi ngos la/bstan pa'i gtso bo la 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug gsal byed chen po bzhi/ rmad byung slob dpon gnyis la sogs pa bzhugs/ dbus kyi bzhugs khri chen po 'di yang khri phal pa tsam ma yin par/ gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du ma khri 'di nyid kyi steng du bzhengs pa'i —174—

dga' ldan phun tshogs gling gi gnas bshad bzhugs/dbang bskur sogs 'gro don du ma mdzad pa'i shin tu byings che zhing bkra shis pa 'gran zla med pa yin/ 'di na dpal ye shes kyi mgon po mthu stobs bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ legs ldan chen po lcam dral gyi mgon khang byin rlabs kyi gzi brjid dpag tu med pa bzhugs/ 'di na dpal mgon lha chen dpal 'bar gyi sku brnyan sku tshad che zhing bzo bkod rnam grangs mang bar yod kyang / zhag bdun khongs su legs par tshar ba sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas pa yin/ sgo khang chen po la/ 'di na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i srung ma chen po rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ btsun mo sras dang blon po g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa'i bkod pa dang /'jig rten mtha' dag gi byed pa po'am skyong ba po phyogs skyong chen po bco lnga klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa bzhugs/ de la phyogs skyong bcu zhes bya ba kun la grags shing / bco lnga'i nges pa 'di ni rgyud gshin rje gshed dmar nag nas 'byung ba ltar/ rdo rje slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi bzhed pas gsal bar mdzad pa yin pa 'dug gseng sgo la/ 'di yang sgo khang yin pas/ chos 'dul ba nas sgo khang du 'khor ba'i 'khor lo cha lnga pa 'bri gsung ba ltar/ nye bar nyon mongs gsum/ bar du 'gro ba rgyud lnga/ tha ma rten 'brel bcu gnyis/ 'thob bya 'gog bden/ thob byed lam/ de ston pa po sangs rgyas dang bcas pa dang / de dag gi mthar cho 'phrul chen po'am bdud 'dul ba gang rung 'bri bar gsungs pa ltar/ 'dir bdud 'dul gyi bkod pa bzhengs/ gzhan yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud nas 'byung ba'i gshin rje gshed dang / rtsa ba'i mgon po dang bcas pa bzhugs/ steng khang bkod pa mtha' yas zhes bya ba 'di na/ 'o —175—

skol gyi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam thar shin tu ngo mtshar ba/ mngon par 'byung ba'i mdo dang / 'dul ba lung dang / las brgya pa dang / rtogs brjod brgya pa sogs las bsdus pa'i bkod pa bzhugs/ zhes brjod nas lo rgyus dang bstun ci rigs ci rigs 'di dang 'di'o zhes bshad do/ /lho phyogs ngos kyi lha khang 'di na/ legs ldan ye shes kyi mgon po lha chen dpal 'bar gyi sku'i bkod pa mi 'dra ba du ma dang / dpal lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma'i sku'i bkod pa mi 'dra ba du ma dang bcas pa shin tu bka' gnyan par bzhugs/ shar phyogs kyi 'di rgya gar lha khang zhes bya ba/'phags yul gyi rten byin rlabs tshe tshad bzhugs te 'di'i dkar chag logs su bya/ 'og min la 'di gtsug lag khang gi yang thog yin pas/ chos mtshungs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyi 'og min lha khang du mtshan btags/ mtshan don dang mthun pa'i phyir/ 'di ni steng phyogs kyi 'og min gyi bkod par gda'/ spyir 'og min zhes bya ba gsung rab nas rnam pa du ma gsungs te/ gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun gyi nang tshan gnas gtsang ma'i 'og min zhes bya ba yod de/ tha mal pa'i 'jig rten khams kyi nang tshan yin/ de'i steng na lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po'i gnas kyi 'og min zhes kyang bya/ gnas gtsang ma chen po zhes kyang bya/ stong gsum gcig tu sangs rgyas bye ba phrag brgya 'byung ba'i sprul gzhi/ sprul pa'i sku chen po de bzhugs pa'i gnas yin/ bkod pa 'di yang de'i bkod pa yin pa 'dug gzhan yang sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhing khams la yang 'og min gzhi dang snying po me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa zhes grags pa dang / 'og —176—

min stug po bkod pa'i zhing mchog ces bya ba/ nam mkha' dang mnyam par khyab cing longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhing khams yin pa cig kyang gsungs so/ /'di ni don zhags lha lnga/ 'di ni rgyung sde spyi'i lugs kyi rigs lnga yum lnga/ 'di ni dpal dus kyi 'khor lo/ 'di rnams dus 'khor nyid nas gsungs pa'i rigs bdag rgyal ba rigs drug gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad/ 'jam dbyangs dang spyan ras gzigs kyi yum gnyis gnyis/ steng gi cha la mdzad pa bcu gnyis mdor bsdus dang bcas pa'i bkod pa lags/ 'di phyogs na ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rigs la/ bcu gcig zhal 'khor nor bzang dang rta mgrin gnyis/spyan ras gzigs mgrin sngon/ jo bo ha ri ha ri ha ri la zhon pa/ 'phags pa seng ge sgra/ jo bo bde ldan/ spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin nor bu/ spyan ras gzigs ha la ha la/ spyan ras gzigs 'jigs pa brgyad skyob/ dbang du byed pa'i spyan ras gzigs dmar po rigs gnyis/ yang ha la ha la phyag bzhi pa gcig spyan ras gzigs rgyal po rol ba rnams dang / 'di na sgrol ma lha lnga/'di na kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po dol po pa chen po/ 'gro lding gi slob dpon lha'i 'byung ldan/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje/ sbyin bdag gi tshul du rje btsun nyid kyi sku brnyan rnams bzhugs/ 'di'i rten gyi gtso bo 'di bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa bzo bkod legs shing / sku rgyan sogs bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa/ nang bzhugs rten byin rlabs can du ma dang bcas pa bzhugs pa yin/ me pho stag lo shin tu than pa che ba'i skabs/ 'di'i —177—

rab gnas mdzad pa'i nyin mo nas brtsams zhag mang por char pa gshin la che bar babs/ than pa'i 'jigs pa las grol bas/ tshe dpag med bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs mar mtshan gsol ba lags/ rjes su yang 'di la sku khrus gsol zhing mchod pa phul bas/ char dkon pa'i dus su yang char ci rigs pa 'bab pa'i byin rlabs kyi ltas mngon gyur pa bzhugs/ gdung ldebs kyi 'di dag ni zhi ba dam pa rigs brgya yin par 'dug ka ba brgyad kyi ngos 'di rnams mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad yin lags/ yang 'di na rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i lha khang bzhugs pa yin/ rten 'di rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma sngo ljang kun khyab tu grags pa/ rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs kyi lugs yin/ sku tshugs bzang zhing /'phra rgyan rin po che sna tshogs pas mdzes pa/ nang bzhugs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs/ 'di bzhengs pa'i lo/ bstan pa la bar du gcod pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sprin bzhin dengs pa zhig byung bas/ bdud 'dul sgrol mar mtshan gsol ba yin/ 'di ni 'chi ba blu ba'i sgrol ljang / sgrub thabs slob dpon klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i lugs yin/ sku rgyu'i tshogs snga ma 'di dang 'dra ba rang yin na'ang / rgyu tshogs 'phel ba'i tshul gyis/ snga ma las sku tshad che ba'i cho 'phrul bstan pa dang / 'di'i rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe/phyogs thams cad nas rnyed bkur longs spyod sprin stibs pa bzhin byung bas/'dod dgu 'byung ba'am/ dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba'i sgrol mar mtshan gsol/'di yang bzo sgros gtsang zhing / gzhan kun pas zil dang / gzi byin che ba/rgyan sprod sogs thams cad nas rgyu tshogs 'gangs che bar bzhugs/ 'di ni /78—

yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma ste/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'di nyid kyi rtog pa nas 'byung ba bzhin gyi sku brnyan lags/ 'di yang bzo sgros gtsang zhing tshugs bzang bas/ rgyan sprod sogs sku rgyu phun sum tshogs pa/ 'di'i nang bzhugs la de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel 'khrul med bcu tsam bzhugs/'di da lta yin phugs lha khang la sogs pa dgos pa 'dug rgyud ris kyi da rngazang du byas na/ 'di ni bcom ldan 'das ma u rgyan sgrol mar grags pa gnas kyi dbang phyug ma yin/ 'di rnams mtshan yin dang mthun par rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i rigs sna tshogs pa lags/ 'di rnams sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi bkod pa yin/ 'di ni dpal saX pu ṭa'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs mdzad bsdus pa de lags/ gzhan yang lha tshogs ci rigs dang bcas pa bzhugs/ bde yangs 'di la chos bzang zhes bya zhing / mtha' skor 'di la bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis/ chos rgyal rigs ldan la sogs pa'i sku brnyan gyis mdzes par byas pa 'di lags shing / dbus kyi bzhugs khri rdo rje gdan zhes bya ba 'di na/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan grwa dar ba'i dus kyi bkod pa dang / slob dpon pu khyo ā ka ra gup+ta/ slob dpon rat+na ā ka ra gup+ta/slob dpon a bha ya a pa ra gup+ta/ tsa mi sangs rgyas grags pa ste rdo rje gdan pa'i mtshan can bzhi po'i sku brnyan rnams bzhugs/ mtha' skor gyi gtsug lag khang bcu drug la/ 'di ni dpal chen po he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog gi bzhugs gnas yin pa'i phyir/ dpal chen lha khang zhes bya/ de la sgo khang 'di na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rabs bdun gtsug lag gi nang du 'byon pa'i bkod pa —179—

yin/ khyams 'di'i logs bris kyi dbang du byas na/ lho'i ldebs la zhing skyong yab yum bdun cu rtsa gnyis mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho nas gsungs pa ltar dang /gtsang khang gi phyi'i g.yas kyi ngos chen la/ 'khor lo sdom pa zhal phyag 'bum pa'i bkod pa dang / g.yon ngos la shrī badz+ra ste ra wa thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag lugs ro langs brgyad kyis bskor ba dang / g.yin zhal shar gzigs dang nub gzigs kyi ldebs la bzhugs pa 'di rnams dpal 'khor lo bde mchog dang rdo rje phag mo'i rigs kho na yin cing / thams cad kyang rgyud kyi rgyal po mngon brjod bla ma'am/ a bhi dha na las gsungs pa kho na yin pa 'dug lags/seng g.yab kyi nang du gtso mo rdo rje phag mo/ gzhan grub thob kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba 'di dang 'di zhes bya ba bzhugs zhes so sor brda sprad/ gtsang khang 'di nyid na/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa'i sku brnyan byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa 'di/ slob dpon chen po nag po spyod pa pa'i bzhed dgongs dang mthun par bzhengs/ 'di ni rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod du grags pa yin te/ 'di ni phag dkar shes rab gsal byed yin/ rnal 'byor ma rgyud rnams la 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma rnams byin rlabs 'jug pa'i sgo yin pas/ 'dir yang sku brnyan lhag por bzhengs pa nyid byin rlabs 'jug pa'i sgor gyur pa lags/ logs bris la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dpa' po dpa' mo drug cu/ slob dpon spyod pa'i rdo rje dang bcas pa sogs dang / sked ris la dur khrod chen po brgyad/ lha khang nyid kyi nang yang phyogs mdog tu bsgyur ba sogs/ gzhal med khang gi mtshan nyid tshang bar —180—

bzhugs/ 'di ni phyogs dang 'brel ba'i dbang du byas nas/ dbang ldan lha khang du mtshan gsol/ 'di'i bar khang gi bsrung ma ni/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu yum dang bcas pa bzhugs/ lha khang 'di'i rten gyi gtso bo ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs gshin rje gshed nag po'i rgyud nas 'byung ba ltar/ dpal gshin rje gshed zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sku brnyan bdud dpung zil gyis gnon pa 'di lags/ logs bris la khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal/ thub dbang gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga/ dpal mgon po seng zhon gtso 'khor khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi rgyud gsungs pa'i gleng gzhi'i bkod pa/ gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga la sogs pa bzhugs/khyad par gnas 'dir byang shar dbang ldan 'gyung ba'i gnod pa mtha' dag bzlog pa'i phyir du lha chen po dbang ldan drag po dbang phyug nyid/ btsun mo ri'i lha mo/ 'khor 'byung po tshogs kyi mnga' bdag bzhi dang bcas pa bzhugs/steng gi lha khang 'di na/ dpal chen po yang dag 'khor bcas dang / rdo rje gzhon nu phur bu'i lha tshogs/ gshin rje gshed phyag rgya zil gnon/ rta mgrin yang gsang lha dgu/ dpal mgon po ma ning la sogs pa/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i lha tshogs rnams bzhugs/ shar sgo bar ma'i steng gi shar phyogs sman bla'i lha khang ni/ phug gi lha lang 'di na bcom ldan 'das sman pa'i rgyal po'i lder bzo rten gyi gtso bor bzhugs pa 'di lags shing / logs bris la bde bar gshegs pa brgyad/ byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug mkhan po bo dhi satwa/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po la sogs pa bzhugs/ mdo na —181—

phyogs skyong bcu/ gnod spyin gyi ded dpon bcu gnyis/ rgyal chen bzhi/ mgon po bang la sogs pa bzhugs/ chos bzang rdo rje'i gdan gyi bde yangs chen po'i shar sgo/ them skas g.yas g.yon steng gsum gyi ngos la/ khro bo chen po bcu/zad par chen po bcu/ phyogs skyong ba bcu/ gza' mchog chen po bcu/ klu rgyal chen po bcu/ 'byung po chen po bcu ste/ dpal dus kyi snyen ra lo nas gsungs pa'i sde drug srung ma drug cu la sogs pa bar chad sel ba'i lha khyad par can rnams bzhugs/ shar lho'i lha khang 'bar 'dzin du grags pa 'di na/ bar khang 'dir srung ma ming po gsum dang sring mo bzhi/ phug gi lha khang dngos gzhi 'di na/ rten gtso bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo mgon po pus btsugs ma dang / las thams cad sgrub pa'i lha drang srong chen po me lha zhabs 'bring gi tshul du bzhugs/logs bris la rnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud gsungs pa'i bkod pa/ gshin rje gshed rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud gsungs pa'i bkod pa/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dug sel ma/ ri khrod ma/ 'od zer can/ mi g.yo bla med lha lnga/ rje btsun nyid kyi skyes rabs 'phreng ba la sogs pa bzhugs/ lha khang steng ma 'di na bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po/ rdor sems la sogs pa sems dpa' bcu druga'aphags pa'i gnas brtan chen po bcu drug /hwa shang dharma ta/ rgyal chen bzhi la sogs pa mang po bzhugs/ gzhal yas khang zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang 'di nyid kyi dbang du byas na/ dang por sgo khang 'di na/ byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad ldem sku'i tshul du gtsug lag khang gi nang du 'byon pa'o/ /'khyams 'di la rgyud sde tha dad nas gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo mang —182—

du bzhugs pa lags/ de yang g.yas bskor du byas/ na dang por mngon byung mgon po/ / gzhin rje gshed rnam par rgyal ba/ 'jam dpal chos dbyings gsung dbang / rdo rje bdud rtsi/ gdan bzhi ye shes dbang phyug ma/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rdo rje sems dpa'/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba/ 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs/ phyag rdor stod 'grel lugs kyi bde mchog dus 'khor zhal bcu gnyis pa/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ mahā ma ya/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ rdo rje phag mo phag gdong chen mo/ kha sbyor rdor sems/ sdom pa 'byung ba/ dpal sdom pa chen po/ bde mchog lha yi lugs/ dgyes pa rdo rje thod pa can/ dgyes rdor mtshon cha can/ phyag chen thig le/ bde mchog 'jam rdor/ gshin rje gshed dgra nag dpal zla gsang thig le/ dpal nag po chen po rgyud mgon rnams bzhugs/ gzhan 'khor tshogs dang lha mgron bkod pa du ma yod cing / seng g.yabs kyi ngos la/ thub pa'i dbang po/ 'od srung la sogs pa bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun/ nyi ma gung pa dang bcas pa bzhugs pa yin la/ sgo stod kyi 'di grub thob chen po zhi ba sbas pa dang / kun mkhyen dus gsum sangs rgyas dang / rje btsun nyid do/ /dbus kyi gtsang khang chen po 'di kha che lugs kyi thog 'bubs lugs su byas/ gtsang khang gi dbus su dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i blos blangs ngo mtshar gzi 'od dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ rigs ldan sprul pa'i skus byin gyis rlabs shing / dngos su bzhengs par grags pa mchod pa'i yo byad dang bcas pa 'di lags/ logs bris la mchod pa'i lha mo bcu gnyis/ gsang ba'i mchod pa yum bzhi dang bcas pa dang /— 183—

zhal ba phyogs mdog rtsig pa dang ri/thun pa'i sked ris sogs/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i tshul du yod/ bskor khang 'di la rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma dang tshe dpag med kyi lha tshogs bzhugs/ /gsung khang du grags pa'i gtsug lag khang 'di nyid na/ lha khang phug na bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa phyag bzhi ma'i sku brnyan/logs bris phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang bcas pa/ 'khyams 'di'i g.yas logs na/ yum chen mo phyag gnyis pa la 'khor phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi skor ba dang / bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po la byang sems nye ba'i sras brgyad la sogs pas bskor ba/ shar nub kyi ngos rnams la rigs lnga'i lha tshogs mang po dang / byang gi ngos la rje btsun dbyangs can ma'i zhing khams/ bya rgyud las 'byung ba'i nag po chen po'i zhing khams/ 'di bi kra ma shi la'i gtor ma slob dpon kun gyi thog ma/ sku sgrub snying por grags pa des mdzad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga kun las btus pa'i nang nas 'byung ba yin/ yang ma cig nags rgyal gyi zhing khams cig 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs las 'byung ba ltar/ gur mgon yum can lha lnga ma rnams bzhugs/ gsung rab bzhus sa pa'i dbang du byas na/ bka' 'gyur ro 'tshal gser ma yongs rdzogs tshar gnyis/ skya pod cha tshang gcig sogs bka' 'gyur yongs rdzogs tshar bzhi dang / thor bu pa shin tu mang ba bzhugs/ /dga' ldan byams pa'i lha khang 'di'i dbang du byas na/ gtsang khang phug na rje btsun byams pa'i 'bur dod/ logs bris la yang rgyal ba ma pham pa nyid —184—

kyi sku brnyan brgya phrag mang po dang / 'byams 'di la rje btsun byams pa'i sku brnyan gnyis/ sgrol ma dkar mo gnyis/ gzhan nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs sgrub thabs dang bstod pa rnam dag gtsug nor nas 'byung ba ltar/ sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gi lha tshogs dang / bka' srung mgon po lho nub pa dang / lha mo tshwa kā rnams bzhugs/theg mchog he ru ka'i lha khang 'di'i dbang du byas na/ lha khang phug gi rten gtso 'di rtsa ba'i he ru ka zhes bya ba yin/ de yang gang la ngos 'dzin na/dgyes pa rdo rje phyag gnyis pa dang / drag po gdan can dang / dur khrod na dgyes pa'i he ru ka dang / mnyam sbyor he ru ka phyag gnyis pa dang / gzhan yang zla gsang thig le dang / dgra nag gi rgyud dang / rdo rje rtse mo nas gsungs pa la sogs pa'i he ru ka rnams sku'i rnam 'gyur gcig par byung ba de la zer ba yin/logs bris la he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i star cig bdag med ma'i star cig /go ri la sogs pa 'khor gyi lha mo'i star gcig rnams bzhugs/'khyams la rdor sems yum can/ bde mchog lhan skyes bzhugs pa/ grub thob brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi dang bcas pa yin/ sngon bal po'i bzo bo gcig gis bod yul du bod skad du brtsams nas/ slob dpon rdo rje gdan pa la kha 'phangs pa'i lugs de ma yin/ grub thob brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi rgya gar gyi slob dpon dpa' bo 'od gsal gyi bzhed pa ltar/ nor ba spangs pa dang / ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa bcas pa dang bzhugs/ grub brgya lugs rnam dag de yin/ /kun gzigs 'jam dbyangs lha khang 'di'i dbang du byas na/ rten gyi spre185—
